# The Old Republic: Revan (novel, read in full): feats, scaling, quotes and story notes

## Appendix Q. Exhaustive per-character quote harvest (script-generated, every paragraph or sentence that names the character)

Method: harvest.py walked every non-blank paragraph from the Prologue to the Epilogue (L63-L6294). Each entry is either (a) an OWN LINE, a paragraph whose speech is attributed to the character by "Name said"/"said Name", by an action beat starting with the name, or by A/B dialogue alternation (labelled), quoted in full; or (b) a paragraph naming the character by name or alias (quoted whole if under 420 characters, otherwise only the sentences that name them). POV is the scene's viewpoint character, so POV narration is that character's perception, not neutral fact. Version tags are rule-based (line range plus keyword flags). PAST-ERA REF flags mark lines that may be about Darth Revan or the Mandalorian Wars Revan; check those before using them as a statement about the post-KOTOR version. Pronoun-only references ("he", "the Jedi", "the Sith") are not harvested; the curated sections (2-4) cover the important ones by hand. Text is rendered from the damaged source (U+FFFD restored to ' " and an em dash), so the verifier treats every quote or dash character as equivalent.


### Q.0 Hand-curated pronoun-only and epithet-only lines (115 quotes)

The harvest below is name- and alias-based, so any sentence that refers to a character only as "he", "she", "the Jedi", "the Sith Lord", "the Emperor's servant", "the Mandalorian", "the droid", "the captain" and so on is missing from it. This subsection adds those lines by hand. Every line is significant, does NOT name the character, was assigned to that character by reading the context, and is not already quoted in this file. Format: chapter, source line, `[PRONOUN/EPITHET]`, version tag (per the header version key), verbatim quote (U+FFFD replacement characters rendered). Added 2026-10-19 and verified by `_revan-work/verify.py`.

- Ch19 · L3999 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «Scourge laughed out loud at what Revan was clearly implying.»
- Ch19 · L4013 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"We share a common goal," Revan admitted. "We both want to stop the Emperor from invading the Republic. But I am not proposing an alliance." He paused. "I do not need your help to escape. The Force has shown me that my freedom is drawing near."»
- Ch19 · L4017 · POV Revan · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «As Revan suspected, his jailer had never experienced a vision through the Force. It wasn't unusual: the phenomenon was much rarer in those who followed the dark side. Their focus was internal—they used the Force as a tool, rather than seeing themselves as instruments of the Force's will. They were not accustomed to opening themselves up to the Force for guidance and direction.»
- Ch19 · L4019 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (action beat) · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"The Force has shown me that my future lies beyond these walls," Revan lied.»
- Ch19 · L4023 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"Have you ever felt a premonition of danger through the Force?" Revan asked, trying to help him understand. "Sensed a threat before it was revealed?"»
- Ch19 · L4039 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"That was a memory, not a vision," Revan reminded him. "But the Force does sometimes speak to us through our dreams."»
- Ch19 · L4043 · POV Revan · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «Revan chose his next words carefully, his dulled wits sensing an opportunity. He knew his best chance—perhaps his only chance—of escape was with the Sith's help. But he could not be the one to suggest the alliance; the Sith Lord had to think it was his idea.»
- Ch19 · L4049 · POV Revan · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «The Sith was already obsessed with him. He hungered to tap into Revan's understanding of the Force, and the Jedi knew he dominated the red-skinned being's conscious and unconscious thoughts. It would only be natural for Revan to sometimes be the subject of the Sith Lord's dreams.»
- Ch19 · L4051 · POV Revan · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «Hopefully, the Sith would come to believe that his ordinary dreams were actually visions granted by the Force. If all went well, he would come to believe there was a greater power trying to draw them together. He might decide of his own accord that Revan was the key to defeating the Emperor, spurring him to help the Jedi escape.»
- Ch19 · L4053 · POV Revan · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «It was a long shot, but Revan had nothing else to hope for.»
- Ch19 · L4055 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «Revan knew from experience it would be at least a week before he returned.»
- Ch19 · L4057 · POV Revan · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «For most prisoners this would have been an effective tool, but Revan was able to endure the long periods alone by meditating on the Force. At times like these he would try to reach out to Bastila, hoping at least to let her know he was still alive.»
- Ch19 · L4061 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"Meetra," Revan gasped as the features shifted sharply into focus. They held for an instant, and then vanished.»
- Ch19 · L4063 · POV Revan · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «Revan knew this was more than some mere recollection of a lost friend. It had been too intense and powerful to be a memory. It was almost as if in describing the nature of Force visions to the Sith, he had triggered one of his own.»
- Ch20 · L4075 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «She knew the storm-ravaged world had to be the world Canderous had spoken of; the one Revan had seen in his dreams. The dark side was powerful here. It was strong enough to send a shiver down her spine, but the sensation was infinitely better than the awful nothingness of Nathema.»
- Ch20 · L4077 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «As she brought the ship in to land, she knew with a sudden and unshakable certainty that Revan was somewhere on this world.»
- Ch20 · L4251 · POV Meetra · SPEECH BY Meetra Surik (the Exile) · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «Meetra wasn't foolish enough to admit she was looking for Revan. Without knowing who had taken him or why, even bringing him up would be too great a risk. Thanks to T3"s holorecording, however, she knew what the Sith who had captured him looked like. Hopefully, if she could find his abductor, he might lead her to Revan.»
- Ch20 · L4261 · POV Meetra · DIALOGUE · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «She flicked a switch and it displayed a still image she had copied from T3"s holorecording. The image was carefully cropped to remove all traces of Revan or the Ebon Hawk, leaving only a close-up of the Sith who had taken him.»
- Ch21 · L4345 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «Back in his private quarters, Scourge tried to push the last words of his most recent conversation with Revan from his mind, but they kept returning.»
- Ch21 · L4347 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «It had been almost a week since he'd walked out on Revan, abandoning him to suffer the torments of his solitary confinement. They had been talking about visions: how the Force could speak to you if you listened; how it could show you visions of your possible future.»
- Ch21 · L4351 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «Revan was smart. Even as Scourge used him to learn about the Force, the Jedi was trying to manipulate Scourge into helping him escape. It was possible everything he'd said had been nothing but lies. It was also possible he had been telling the truth. Maybe he really had seen something that gave him hope of escape.»
- Ch21 · L4353 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «Scourge knew he should tell Nyriss about this latest development, but so far he had kept silent on the matter. If she knew, there was a strong chance she would simply decide to execute Revan rather than allow him any opportunity to escape.»
- Ch21 · L4355 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «If Revan died, did any real chance of stopping the Emperor die with him?»
- Ch21 · L4355 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «Revan, on the other hand, had already proved he was both eager and willing to stop the Sith from invading the Republic.»
- Ch21 · L4359 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «Especially when all of this was predicated on an alleged Force vision of Revan's that might not actually have existed.»
- Ch21 · L4539 · POV Meetra · DIALOGUE · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"You're here because of Revan," he said, his voice filled with wonder. "You've come to rescue him."»
- Ch21 · L4543 · POV Meetra · DIALOGUE · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"I didn't figure it out," he said. "Revan told me."»
- Ch21 · L4551 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «The instant the blue-bladed lightsaber had materialized in the human female's hand, Scourge realized she was a Jedi. And he could only think of one reason a Jedi would come to Dromund Kaas in search of him—she was here to rescue Revan.»
- Ch21 · L4559 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"What do you mean Revan told you?" she demanded.»
- Ch21 · L4563 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «Actually, Scourge still wasn't sure he understood. Not fully. The female Jedi's presence was proof that Revan was telling the truth about his Force vision. He had hinted to Scourge that his freedom was close at hand; he must have had a premonition of her arrival.»
- Ch21 · L4567 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"If you spoke to Revan, then you know where he is," the woman said.»
- Ch21 · L4571 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Lord Scourge · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"Revan is a prisoner," Scourge told her.»
- Ch21 · L4577 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «Nothing about this situation was simple. As he spoke to the Jedi, Scourge was still trying to understand why Revan had mentioned his vision to him at all.»
- Ch21 · L4579 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «At the time he'd thought the prisoner was simply trying to manipulate him, to trick him into helping him escape. Now, however, it seemed as if Revan's words had been a warning—almost as if he knew Scourge would find himself in this situation.»
- Ch21 · L4581 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «It made no sense to give any kind of warning to an enemy. However, if Revan believed that he and Scourge were destined to become allies, then his words did make sense. Was it possible he had seen a vision of Scourge working with him?»
- Ch21 · L4583 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «He had sometimes sensed that Revan was trying to recruit him to his side; the feeling had been even stronger in their last conversation.»
- Ch21 · L4583 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «He'd dismissed it as desperation to escape, but what if Revan knew the events he had foreseen were drawing near?»
- Ch21 · L4585 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"Tell me where Revan is," the woman said. "Tell me where he's being held and I will let you walk away."»
- Ch21 · L4593 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"Come with me and I will take you and your droid to see Revan," he said, deactivating his blade. "He will tell you the truth."»
- Ch21 · L4603 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"Revan told me you were coming," he tried to explain. "I think the Force gave him a vision of us working together."»
- Ch21 · L4615 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"That is because I finally understand what Revan meant. He wants us to unite against a common foe."»
- Ch21 · L4619 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"Our Emperor is planning an invasion of the Republic. Revan wants to stop him. So do I."»
- Ch21 · L4625 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «The Jedi lowered her lightsaber, but didn't deactivate it. "Then why did you take Revan prisoner on Nathema?"»
- Ch21 · L4635 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «He paused and looked steadily at Meetra. "You walk the path of the light; I have chosen to follow the dark side. But we both know the horrors of Nathema are a blight upon the galaxy. Revan knows this, as well. That is why he wants us to work together."»
- Ch21 · L4649 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"What about Revan?" the Jedi asked.»
- Ch21 · L4653 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"You have until tomorrow," the Jedi told him. "Return with proof and we can work together to free Revan."»
- Ch22 · L4811 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «She had sensed that his offer to work together was sincere, though she wondered how much of that was Revan's doing.»
- Ch22 · L4811 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «It was easy to understand how Scourge could be drawn to him; Revan's command of the Force was greater than that of anyone else she had ever met.»
- Ch22 · L4815 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «She didn't trust him, but if he could prove that he and Revan were on the same side she would work with him. The risk of betrayal was one she was willing to take if it gave her a chance to rescue her friend.»
- Ch22 · L4847 · POV Meetra · SPEECH BY Meetra Surik (the Exile) · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"No wonder he's willing to work with Revan," Meetra muttered. "He's just sick of waiting."»
- Ch22 · L4861 · POV Meetra · DIALOGUE · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"He says it's time for you to take us to see Revan."»
- Ch22 · L4873 · POV Meetra · DIALOGUE · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"If she's holding Revan, why can't you take us to him?"»
- Ch22 · L4875 · POV Meetra · SPEECH BY Lord Scourge · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"When I first made the offer, I was hoping Revan could convince you that we should work together," Scourge explained. "Going to see him now would only be an unnecessary risk."»
- Ch22 · L4883 · POV Meetra · SPEECH BY Lord Scourge · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"You can't fight your way through Nyriss's entire army of followers," Scourge said. "Even with my help. She has hundreds of guards and dozens of acolytes trained in the dark side. If we're going to break Revan out, we need a distraction. Something to draw the attention of the guards away while we sneak in."»
- Ch23 · L4895 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «Though he appeared calm on the outside, Scourge's heart was pounding as he mounted the steps to the Emperor's citadel. He was playing a dangerous game, but there were no other options. Time was the enemy; if they had any hope of getting Revan out of her dungeon alive, they had to act before Nyriss realized Scourge had betrayed her.»
- Ch23 · L4905 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «Scourge was going to present the evidence in person. If the Emperor suspected he was lying—or if he was simply powerful enough to see the truth—escape would be impossible. He was putting himself at great risk for the sake of the cause—something he never would have considered before he met Revan.»
- Ch23 · L4971 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «As she led him down the twisting corridors of the citadel, Scourge made a mental note of their path. When he and Revan finally struck at the Emperor, they would need to know as much of the layout of the citadel as possible.»
- Ch23 · L4985 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «Thinking about that power gave Scourge pause. Like Revan, the Emperor understood the Force in ways Scourge never would. It was possible he experienced the same kinds of visions as the Jedi; it was also possible he could peer into Scourge's mind and instantly know the truth of everything he was saying. Meeting him face-to-face could be tantamount to suicide.»
- Ch24 · L5149 · POV Meetra · SPEECH BY Meetra Surik (the Exile) · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"Take me to Revan now," Meetra said. "I'll take my chances on fighting our way out."»
- Ch24 · L5189 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «Security guards, acolytes, and even civilian staff lay strewn about the halls and corridors; the Emperor's Guard had spared no one. Meetra understood there had been no other way to free Revan, but she still felt revulsion at the wholesale slaughter. When she noticed the body of a young Twi'lek slave lying on the floor with her throat cut, she forced herself to look away.»
- Ch24 · L5199 · POV Meetra · DIALOGUE · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"Right. Take us to Revan."»
- Ch24 · L5219 · POV Revan · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «At first Revan thought the distant explosions were an unusual side effect of some new drug combination his captors were trying on him. But when the alarms started blaring, his addled mind realized the facility was under attack.»
- Ch24 · L5227 · POV Revan · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «The young man was a dark-skinned human. He was holding a blaster out at arm's length, pointing it at Revan. His hand was visibly trembling.»
- Ch24 · L5231 · POV Revan · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «Even in Revan's clouded state, the situation was obvious. In the wake of the attack, someone had ordered them to kill the prisoner.»
- Ch24 · L5233 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"Squeeze the trigger and it will be the last action you ever take," Revan warned.»
- Ch24 · L5239 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «Since his incarceration, Revan had been held under strict quarantine.»
- Ch24 · L5241 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"Set the weapon down if you want to live," Revan told the young man. Through the veil of drugs, he strained to reach out with the Force, amplifying the other's fear and confusion.»
- Ch24 · L5245 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"I promise to spare you," Revan said. "I give you my word as a Jedi."»
- Ch24 · L5249 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"Nyriss has sent you on a suicide mission," Revan told them.»
- Ch24 · L5255 · POV Revan · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «Another explosion from above, this one much closer, caused the guard to nearly drop his weapon. He fumbled it briefly before seizing it with both hands and quickly bringing it up again to point at Revan.»
- Ch24 · L5257 · POV Revan · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «Revan briefly contemplated making a grab for the blaster, but the drugs slowed him physically as much as mentally. Instead he remained still and calm.»
- Ch24 · L5261 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"Just walk away from all this," Revan told them. "It's your only real chance of survival."»
- Ch24 · L5271 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"Nyriss is already dead," Revan said, trying a different tactic as he tried to apply even more pressure through the Force. "Do you hear the explosions? The alarms? My friends are coming to liberate me.»
- Ch24 · L5273 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (continued speech) · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"You say you're trapped in here. What do you think my friends will do if they find you standing over my corpse?"»
- Ch24 · L5277 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"Surrender to me and I will guarantee your safety," Revan said. "I give you my word as a Jedi."»
- Ch24 · L5279 · POV Revan · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «The young man's head turned quickly back and forth, from Revan to his friend outside the cell and then back to Revan again. Then he dropped the blaster as if it were on fire.»
- Ch24 · L5281 · POV Revan · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «Revan calmly stepped out of the cell and got his first look at the other guard: another human male, perhaps a few years older than the first. Both guards were frozen with fear, watching his every move intently. Each time the alarm whooped overhead, they flinched.»
- Ch24 · L5283 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"I will not harm you," Revan assured them.»
- Ch24 · L5285 · POV Revan · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «Both men seemed to relax a little, and Revan tried to project calm, soothing waves through the Force to further ease their minds.»
- Ch24 · L5293 · POV Revan · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «And then Meetra descended into view, dressed in some type of dancer's outfit. Seeing Revan, her face broke into a wide grin.»
- Ch24 · L5297 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"It's been a long time," Revan whispered, wrapping his arms around her.»
- Ch24 · L5299 · POV Revan · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «After a moment she broke the embrace, and Revan noticed her nose had crinkled up against the powerful odor wafting off him.»
- Ch24 · L5307 · POV Revan · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «Revan spun Meetra to the side and stepped in front of her, an instinctive but foolish move. Meetra was a Jedi; she knew how to handle herself. And unarmed he was no match for the Sith.»
- Ch24 · L5309 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Meetra Surik (the Exile) · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"It's okay," Meetra said, placing a hand on Revan's shoulder. "Scourge is here to help us."»
- Ch24 · L5311 · POV Revan · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «It took Revan's foggy mind a moment to process what she was saying. Once he figured it out, he couldn't help but laugh out loud.»
- Ch24 · L5321 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"No," Revan said. "I promised to protect them."»
- Ch24 · L5325 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"I gave them my word," Revan said. A rush of dizziness swept over him, and he reeled.»
- Ch24 · L5329 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"They keep me drugged," Revan said. "I just need a minute."»
- Ch24 · L5335 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «"This will help," he said, injecting it into Revan's arm. "But it will take a few minutes."»
- Ch24 · L5339 · POV Revan · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «She nodded at Scourge, who pulled a package from the large pouch on his hip. He tossed it to Revan, who didn't even try to catch it, but just picked it up off the floor.»
- Ch24 · L5347 · POV Revan · NARRATION · CAPTIVE Revan (drugged, amnesiac; ~3,951 BBY): «Revan smiled. His mind felt like it was floating blissfully away, but he wasn't sure if the euphoria was triggered by thoughts of his family or the drugs still working their way out of his system.»
- Ch24 · L5359 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Lord Scourge · REVAN REBORN (memories restored, ~3,951 BBY): «"What's happening?" Scourge demanded as Revan collapsed on the floor.»
- Ch24 · L5361 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Meetra Surik (the Exile) · REVAN REBORN (memories restored, ~3,951 BBY): «"I—I don't know," Meetra said, her hands fumbling to check Revan's pulse as he lay motionless on the ground.»
- Ch24 · L5375 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Lord Scourge · REVAN REBORN (memories restored, ~3,951 BBY): «"Get Revan out of the way," Scourge said to Meetra.»
- Ch24 · L5377 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · REVAN REBORN (memories restored, ~3,951 BBY): «As she dragged the Jedi's unconscious body into the nearby cell, one of the guards drew his weapon, while the other rushed over and picked his discarded blaster up from where Revan had kicked it aside.»
- Ch24 · L5417 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · REVAN REBORN (memories restored, ~3,951 BBY): «Just then, Revan emerged from the cell. He had pulled the hood of his Jedi robe up to cover his head, and he wore the red-and-gray mask, hiding his face.»
- Ch24 · L5419 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · REVAN REBORN (memories restored, ~3,951 BBY): «A dozen bolts of lightning sprang from Nyriss's hand, arcing across the room to incinerate her enemies. Instead of leaping back into the cell to avoid the deadly attack, Revan stepped forward to intercept it.»
- Ch24 · L5423 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · REVAN REBORN (memories restored, ~3,951 BBY): «"I am Revan reborn," he said to Nyriss. "And before me you are nothing."»
- Ch24 · L5425 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · REVAN REBORN (memories restored, ~3,951 BBY): «Nyriss's eyes went wide as Revan unleashed the power of her own attack against her. She tried to throw up another Force shield, but the bolts ripped it apart and continued on unabated. The lightning engulfed her, the intense heat consuming her instantly, leaving only a pile of charred ash.»
- Ch24 · L5427 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · REVAN REBORN (memories restored, ~3,951 BBY): «Scourge slowly clambered to his feet as Revan helped Meetra up. In the corner, the upended astromech let out a plaintive whistle and awkwardly managed to rock himself back into an upright position.»

- Ch26 · L5729 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · REVAN REBORN (memories restored, ~3,951 BBY): «"It's complicated," Revan answered with a cryptic smile. "Jedi scholars have devoted centuries to understanding the ways of the Force, and we have only scratched the surface."»

- Ch5 · L1027 · POV Revan · NARRATION · pre-KOTOR II Exile (mentioned): «The Mandalorians had taken the bait, and once they were in range Meetra gave the order to engage the mass-shadow generator. - Ch5 · L1031 · POV Revan · NARRATION · pre-KOTOR II Exile (mentioned): «Revan's and Meetra's ships had both been safely beyond the range of the superweapon, though whether that was by luck or design Revan honestly couldn't say.»

- Ch5 · L1037 · POV Revan · NARRATION · pre-KOTOR II Exile (mentioned): «But Revan wasn't interested in the opinions of some anonymous Jedi Archivist; he only cared for the facts—particularly what happened to Meetra after the battle. And here the report was severely lacking.»

- Ch5 · L1069 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE · pre-KOTOR II Exile (mentioned): «"I'm still a Jedi, and Meetra's sentence is a matter of record," he reminded her, suddenly serious. "I have a right to know the truth of what happened. All of it."»
- Ch5 · L1073 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Revan · pre-KOTOR II Exile (mentioned): «"It was a desperate act during a desperate time," Revan said. - Ch5 · L1085 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Revan · pre-KOTOR II Exile (mentioned): «Revan sensed there was something she wasn't saying. "What does that mean? Meetra was a powerful Jedi. Why didn't the Council try to redeem her?"»
- Ch5 · L1093 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE · pre-KOTOR II Exile (mentioned): «"Meetra was much closer to the mass-shadow generator than you were.»
- Ch5 · L1107 · POV Revan · NARRATION · pre-KOTOR II Exile (mentioned): «Revan was too busy trying to process all he had learned to react to her comment. - Ch5 · L1111 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Jedi Council and Atris · pre-KOTOR II Exile (mentioned): «"Haven't you done enough already?" Atris demanded. - Ch5 · L1117 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE · pre-KOTOR II Exile (mentioned): «Revan shrugged, knowing a philosophical argument wasn't going to get him any closer to finding Meetra. If you know where she is, you have to tell me."»
- Ch5 · L1119 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Jedi Council and Atris · pre-KOTOR II Exile (mentioned): «"I haven't spoken to her since her trial," Atris answered through gritted teeth, and Revan knew she was telling the truth. - Ch5 · L1127 · POV Revan · NARRATION · pre-KOTOR II Exile (mentioned): «Despite what he'd said to her, he couldn't help but feel responsible for Meetra.»
- Ch5 · L1127 · POV Revan · NARRATION · pre-KOTOR II Exile (mentioned): «Most of his specific memories of Meetra were gone; he could recall only disjointed bits and pieces.»
- Ch5 · L1131 · POV Revan · NARRATION · pre-KOTOR II Exile (mentioned): «He'd come to the Temple in search of an old friend and confidante, hoping she could help him understand the dreams that plagued his nights. - Ch7 · L1395 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Canderous Ordo / Mandalore the Preserver · pre-KOTOR II Exile (mentioned): «"We're a little short on bodies," Canderous repeated. "What about that other Jedi who helped you during the war? Not Malak. The one they call the Exile."»
- Ch7 · L1397 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Revan · pre-KOTOR II Exile (mentioned): «"Meetra," Revan said.»
- Ch7 · L1405 · POV Revan · NARRATION · pre-KOTOR II Exile (mentioned): «It was also possible he was fully aware of Meetra's actions, and respected her even more for making the ruthless but tactically brilliant decision to sacrifice thousands of her own people to achieve victory.»
- Ch7 · L1405 · POV Revan · NARRATION · pre-KOTOR II Exile (mentioned): «In either case, Revan didn't want to get into the tragic tale of Meetra's banishment and her severance from the Force.»
- Ch17 · L3515 · POV Bastila · NARRATION · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «It had been the Exile—Meetra Surik—who had taken up the fight against the rogue Jedi.»

- Ch17 · L3525 · POV Bastila · NARRATION · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «Worst of all, Meetra was an integral part of Revan's lost past—a past he had felt compelled to go in search of, even though it meant leaving his pregnant wife behind.»

- Ch17 · L3549 · POV Bastila · OWN LINE (attribution) · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «"Or maybe he just knew I'd need his help," Meetra added quickly, perhaps aware she had in some way offended her host.»

- Ch17 · L3579 · POV Bastila · NARRATION · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «Meetra nodded her appreciation, but didn't speak.»

- Ch17 · L3605 · POV Bastila · OWN LINE (attribution) · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «"And you never saw anyone during that time?" Meetra asked. "No refugees? No looters?"»

- Ch17 · L3613 · POV Bastila · NARRATION · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «Bastila sensed that despite all Meetra had done to stop Darth Traya, she was haunted by guilt and remorse. She was still looking for redemption.»

- Ch17 · L3631 · POV Bastila · OWN LINE (attribution) · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «"There must be some part of his programming that compels him to seek Revan out," Meetra muttered. "If I had known that, I would have been more careful."»

- Ch17 · L3645 · POV Bastila · OWN LINE (attribution) · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «"The Jedi are already searching for HK," Meetra assured her. "Don't worry about him."»

- Ch17 · L3709 · POV Bastila · OWN LINE (attribution) · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY) + PAST-ERA REF: «"What if your fears are right?" Meetra asked, her voice grim. "The mask could bring back his memories. But what if it does more? What if it unleashes the power of the dark side in him?"»

- Ch20 · L4121 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «Meetra decided to walk to Larvit's store, rather than hire a speeder. Wandering the streets of Kaas City on foot would give her a better feel for the planet and its people, making it easier to fit in.»
- Ch20 · L4123 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «With a start Meetra realized that the unfortunate slaves were likely descended from prisoners who'd been taken by the Sith a thousand years earlier during the Great Hyperspace War.»

- Ch20 · L4141 · POV Meetra · OWN LINE (attribution) · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «"Sorry," Meetra said. "I didn't realize it was a big deal."»
- Ch20 · L4145 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «Meetra nodded and let her hand drop, but she remained vigilant.»
- Ch20 · L4149 · POV Meetra · OWN LINE (attribution) · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «"Does it matter?" Meetra replied.»

- Ch20 · L4171 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «Meetra wasn't about to fall for such an obvious ploy. - Ch20 · L4193 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «Ten minutes later Meetra walked out of his establishment with twelve thousand, five hundred Imperial credits and an appointment to meet someone called Sechel in two days.»

- Ch20 · L4213 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «Multiple escape attempts were met with public execution—a slow and agonizing death according to what Meetra had seen in the official records from Nathema.»

- Ch20 · L4227 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «Meetra made a mental note not to underestimate him; what he lacked in physical prowess he probably more than made up for with intellect and cunning.»

- Ch20 · L4241 · POV Meetra · OWN LINE (attribution) · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «"I see Larvit does not believe in discretion when it comes to discussing business matters," Meetra grumbled.»

- Ch20 · L4253 · POV Meetra · OWN LINE (continued speech) · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «"Does this Sith have a name?"»

- Ch20 · L4267 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «There was no doubt in Meetra's mind that Sechel knew exactly who the Sith Lord was, but she thought there was more benefit to playing along than calling him on his lie.»
- Ch20 · L4273 · POV Meetra · OWN LINE (attribution) · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «"Not a friend, exactly," Meetra said evasively. "But certainly not an enemy. He has information about a private matter that I wish to discuss."»

- Ch20 · L4281 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «Meetra hesitated. She didn't know the exact nature of the relationship between Sechel and the mysterious Sith. If they were friends, he wouldn't simply tell her where to find him. Not without warning him first.»

- Ch20 · L4291 · POV Meetra · OWN LINE (attribution) · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «"It's in his best interest," Meetra said. "I'm sure you can be very convincing."»
- Ch20 · L4295 · POV Meetra · OWN LINE (action beat) · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «Meetra sighed wearily. "How much?"»
- Ch20 · L4299 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «Sechel proved to be a much shrewder negotiator than Larvit; he knew he had all the leverage. In the end they settled on four thousand credits, much closer to his opening offer than Meetra had originally intended.»
- Ch20 · L4311 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «There was no mistaking the sudden suspicion in Sechel's voice, and Meetra knew she had misplayed her hand.»
- Ch20 · L4331 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «The slave bowed and backed away, obviously relieved at what he perceived to be a more normal reaction from a patron of the club. - Ch21 · L4465 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «Meetra was wary of a trap even before she felt the warning premonitions through the Force.»
- Ch21 · L4469 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «It was possible the Sith had come alone, but Meetra estimated the vehicle could hold as many as six adult humanoids.»

- Ch21 · L4511 · POV Meetra · DIALOGUE · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «The four soldiers opened fire. - Ch21 · L4519 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «The other two soldiers had ripped off their night-vision goggles and opened fire again. Meetra deflected the bolts with her lightsaber.»

- Ch21 · L4525 · POV Meetra · DIALOGUE · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «At last, Meetra turned to face the Sith. Now that she had a chance to focus her attention more closely, she recognized him from T3"s holovid. Apparently Lord Scourge had decided to show up after all.»
- Ch21 · L4529 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «He held his weapon in front of him in a standard defensive posture, staring at Meetra with a look of utter disbelief on his face.»

- Ch21 · L4535 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «Meetra wasn't about to attack someone who didn't seem to want to do her any harm; that went against everything she believed in. But she wasn't going to let her guard down, either.»
- Ch21 · L4635 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «He paused and looked steadily at Meetra. "You walk the path of the light; I have chosen to follow the dark side. - Ch22 · L4807 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «Meetra sat still and silent on the floor of the cave, her legs crossed and her hands held at chest height, palms facing each other. - Ch22 · L4819 · POV Meetra · OWN LINE (attribution) · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «"I told you he'd come back," Meetra said. "He's alone," she added before T3 could ask the obvious question.»

- Ch22 · L4869 · POV Meetra · OWN LINE (attribution) · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «"She's on the Dark Council," Meetra said, recalling the name from the data disks. "She's the one who brought you into the conspiracy."»

- Ch24 · L5109 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «Meetra didn't like the idea of pretending to be Scourge's newly purchased slave, but the Sith had assured her it was the best way for her to infiltrate Nyriss's stronghold without drawing unwanted attention.»

- Ch25 · L5549 · POV Meetra · OWN LINE (alternation) · POST-KOTOR II Meetra (~3,951 BBY): «"Of course," she said, a lump forming in her throat. "It would be my honor."»

To save the Empire—to save our entire species—we formed an alliance, vowing to work together to bring the Emperor down."»
- Ch12 · L2637 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Nyriss · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"If the Emperor suspected the members of the Dark Council of allying against him, he would kill us all. We had to take steps to protect ourselves. To throw off suspicion, we had to distance ourselves from the separatists who openly oppose the Emperor."»
- Ch12 · L2639 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Lord Scourge · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"That's why you staged the fake assassinations against yourself," Scourge said. "If the separatists were targeting you, the Emperor would be less likely to suspect you were working with them."»
- Ch12 · L2643 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"The plan was to have my own people "investigate" the attempts on my life and place the blame accordingly. But then the Emperor sent you, and the plan had to change. Your arrival meant the Emperor suspected this was bigger than a simple separatist uprising. It wouldn't be enough to implicate a radical fringe group of terrorists."»
- Ch12 · L2647 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Nyriss · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «I could not afford to be caught in a lie if you or the Emperor looked deeper into the matter.»
- Ch12 · L2647 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Nyriss · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «Allowing Xedrix to take the blame will confirm the Emperor's suspicion that the separatists were working with someone on the Dark Council.»
- Ch12 · L2655 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Nyriss · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"You already suspected something was wrong," Nyriss told him. "Why else would you have tried to interrogate Sechel? If I simply kill you, though, it might raise the Emperor's suspicions even farther. He sent you to investigate the assassinations; it would be better if you were the one to tell him Darth Xedrix was responsible."»
- Ch12 · L2659 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «Scourge narrowed his eyes. This was too easy. Even if he swore allegiance to Nyriss, she couldn't just let him walk out of the room. The risk that he might report her to the Emperor was too great. She had to have some other way to protect herself, some angle he hadn't considered.»
- Ch12 · L2671 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"Even with all the evidence pointing in your direction, it's possible the Emperor would still believe you over a member of the Dark Council, but honestly, he would probably kill us both just to be safe.»
- Ch12 · L2671 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «And I don't think you're the type to martyr yourself out of loyalty to the Emperor."»
- Ch12 · L2675 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Nyriss · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"Now I must persuade you to truly believe in our cause," Nyriss said. "It's not enough to secure your silence through threats and blackmail. When we finally move against the Emperor, I want you on our side."»
- Ch12 · L2679 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Nyriss · PRE-NATHEMA Tenebrae/Lord Vitiate (lore, hearsay): «"Have you ever heard tales of the Emperor's childhood?"»
- Ch12 · L2691 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · NATHEMA ritual (lore): «"Once it went by another name, but that name has long been forgotten—just like the planet itself. The Emperor erased Nathema from the history books and the astrogation charts to hide all evidence of his crimes."»
- Ch12 · L2695 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · NATHEMA ritual (lore): «"Through the lost rituals of the ancients, he used the dark side to conquer death and make himself immortal. But his immortality came with a cost. Telling you what happened is not enough. You must see for yourself. Only then will you understand the price the Emperor was willing to pay. Only then will you understand why he must be stopped."»
- Ch12 · L2707 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Nyriss · NATHEMA ritual (lore): «"Patience, Lord Scourge," Nyriss said. "It will take several days before we are ready to leave. The journey is long, and we must be certain the Emperor never finds out. Traveling to Nathema is punishable by death."»
- Ch14 · L3045 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE · PRE-NATHEMA Tenebrae/Lord Vitiate (lore, hearsay): «"His name was Lord Dramath the Second. A thousand years ago his father, the original Lord Dramath, ruled over a planet called Medriaas. He was overthrown by another Sith named Lord Vitiate, who renamed the planet Nathema. With his father's death, the younger Lord Dramath fled. He hid on Rekkiad with a handful of loyal followers, and when he died they buried him here with the datacron."»
- Ch15 · L3171 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · PRE-NATHEMA Tenebrae/Lord Vitiate (lore, hearsay): «He wanted to know more about the Emperor's mysterious past.»
- Ch15 · L3171 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · PRE-NATHEMA Tenebrae/Lord Vitiate (lore, hearsay): «And if it turned out that Nyriss was telling the truth—if the Emperor really was mad enough to start another war with the Republic—then maybe Scourge should consider taking her side.»
- Ch15 · L3187 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Nyriss · PRE-NATHEMA Tenebrae/Lord Vitiate (lore, hearsay): «"Nothing I tell you can prepare you for what you will see on Nathema," Nyriss warned him. "But I will tell you the history of the Emperor and his homeworld."»
- Ch15 · L3193 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · PRE-NATHEMA Tenebrae/Lord Vitiate (lore, hearsay): «She settled herself more comfortably, and as she spoke, her voice took on the singsong tone of children's storyteller. "The Emperor's name was Tenebrae," she began. "They say he was born with eyes as black as the void of empty space, and that he never cried, even as an infant. No animal would come near him, and when he began to talk, his voice carried a weight and power that should not come from a child.»
- Ch15 · L3197 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · PRE-NATHEMA Tenebrae/Lord Vitiate (lore, hearsay): «"The father flew into a rage, attacking the boy's mother. Tenebrae stopped him, feeding on his father's anger and hate to call upon the dark side. He snapped his father's neck with a mere thought, killing him instantly. His mother died more slowly. Tenebrae made her suffer for months as punishment for betraying the family, torturing her with the Force as he honed his powers.»
- Ch15 · L3205 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Nyriss · PRE-NATHEMA Tenebrae/Lord Vitiate (lore, hearsay): «"I cannot guarantee the truth of this story," Nyriss admitted. "Those who witnessed the events no longer live to verify them. But if you had ever met the Emperor in person, you would not be so hesitant to accept the tale as fact."»
- Ch15 · L3209 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Nyriss · PRE-NATHEMA Tenebrae/Lord Vitiate (lore, hearsay): «"Tenebrae's father was named Lord Dramath. He heard rumors, but they came from a remote and insignificant territory. He had long forgotten the simple commoner who had borne him a son, and he considered the plight of a few small villages beneath his notice. Had Dramath acted more swiftly, the Emperor might have been stopped. But it took almost four years before he decided to go see Tenebrae for himself.»
- Ch15 · L3211 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Nyriss · PRE-NATHEMA Tenebrae/Lord Vitiate (lore, hearsay): «But Tenebrae had no intention of serving—or of dying.»
- Ch15 · L3211 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Nyriss · PRE-NATHEMA Tenebrae/Lord Vitiate (lore, hearsay): «When they met face-to-face, Tenebrae proved the stronger.»
- Ch15 · L3213 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Nyriss · PRE-NATHEMA Tenebrae/Lord Vitiate (lore, hearsay): «"It took Tenebrae three more years to gain control of the rest of Nathema. Dramath's firstborn son fled rather than face his formidable half brother, but other powerful Sith sought to seize the empty throne. All fell before the dark prodigy, and with each victory he grew more powerful and more ruthless.»
- Ch15 · L3215 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Nyriss · PRE-NATHEMA Tenebrae/Lord Vitiate (lore, hearsay): «"At thirteen he presented himself to Marka Ragnos, the Lord of all Sith and the ruler of the Sith Council. Impressed by the teenager's ambition and power, Marka Ragnos granted him the title of Lord Vitiate. His position as ruler of Nathema officially recognized, Lord Vitiate returned to his home to conduct his research into the depths of the dark side's power.»
- Ch15 · L3217 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Nyriss · PRE-NATHEMA Tenebrae/Lord Vitiate (lore, hearsay): «When Marka Ragnos fell, Lord Vitiate did not join in the mad rush to claim his position.»
- Ch15 · L3221 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Nyriss · PRE-NATHEMA Tenebrae/Lord Vitiate (lore, hearsay): «Remember, he was not the Emperor back then.»
- Ch15 · L3221 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Nyriss · PRE-NATHEMA Tenebrae/Lord Vitiate (lore, hearsay): «He was merely Lord Vitiate, ruler of a single planet of no particular importance.»
- Ch15 · L3223 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Nyriss · PRE-NATHEMA Tenebrae/Lord Vitiate (lore, hearsay): «"And the Sith Lords were driven by fear. Many thought the Jedi would soon wipe them all out. They were desperate for anything they could use as a weapon against the servants of the light side. Lord Vitiate played upon these fears, convincing those who answered his call to set aside their suspicions of him and of one another to join in a single glorious cause.»
- Ch15 · L3225 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Nyriss · PRE-NATHEMA Tenebrae/Lord Vitiate (lore, hearsay): «"Once they arrived on Nathema, they quickly fell under Lord Vitiate's control. He dominated their minds, crushed their resistance. He turned them into slaves to his will, forcing them to participate in the most complex ritual of Sith sorcery ever attempted. Calling on the dark side, Lord Vitiate devoured them. He fed on their power, absorbing it into himself, utterly obliterating all traces of his victims.»
- Ch15 · L3227 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Nyriss · PRE-NATHEMA Tenebrae/Lord Vitiate (lore, hearsay): «Lord Vitiate sacrificed millions, stealing their life force to make himself immortal.»
- Ch15 · L3227 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Nyriss · PRE-NATHEMA Tenebrae/Lord Vitiate (lore, hearsay): «Their deaths also made him stronger than any Sith who had come before, and he ceased to be known as Lord Vitiate.»
- Ch15 · L3227 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Nyriss · PRE-NATHEMA Tenebrae/Lord Vitiate (lore, hearsay): «On that day, the Emperor was truly born."»
- Ch15 · L3231 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · PRE-NATHEMA Tenebrae/Lord Vitiate (lore, hearsay): «"The Emperor seized what was his by right," he said. "The strong take from the weak. That is our way. Doing it on a scale of millions doesn't change anything—it just proves he deserves to be our Emperor."»
- Ch15 · L3273 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «The Emperor had consumed everything. Life, sound, color, even the Force—nothing remained. This wasn't about conquest or domination or destroying an enemy—all concepts Scourge embraced.»
- Ch15 · L3281 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «Scourge finally understood why Nyriss and the others wanted to take the Emperor down.»
- Ch15 · L3281 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · NATHEMA ritual (lore): «After seeing the horrors of Nathema, he truly believed the Emperor might declare another war against the Republic, exposing them to the Jedi and leading to the eventual extinction of their species.»
- Ch15 · L3291 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Lord Scourge · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"Could the Emperor have sent someone to follow us?" Scourge asked.»
- Ch16 · L3349 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · NATHEMA ritual (lore): «Anywhere else in the galaxy he would have been able to sense the survivors through the Force. Here on Nathema, however, the aftermath of the Emperor's grim ritual blinded his abilities.»
- Ch16 · L3383 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"Five years ago. The Emperor sentenced Revan to death."»
- Ch16 · L3387 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Nyriss · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"I don't know," Nyriss admitted. "But he couldn't have escaped the citadel's dungeons unless the Emperor allowed it. It stands to reason that he wouldn't still be alive unless he was working for the Emperor."»
- Ch16 · L3467 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · NATHEMA ritual (lore): «Nyriss wanted to know how he had escaped the dungeons of the citadel. She wanted to know about his relationship with the Emperor. She wanted to know why he had come to Nathema. On all those counts, Scourge had come up empty. Revan was resisting him, true, but at some times it almost seemed as if Revan himself didn't know—as if the information had been wiped from his mind.»
- Ch16 · L3479 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"The Emperor has the ability to dominate and enslave the minds of those who serve him," she explained.»
- Ch16 · L3479 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"I suspect that instead of executing Revan as he publicly proclaimed, the Emperor turned him into a puppet of his will and sent him back to the Republic to gather information."»
- Ch16 · L3481 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Lord Scourge · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"If he's been gathering intel on the Republic for five years, the Emperor must be closer to launching his invasion than we thought," Scourge noted, alarmed at how close their mad ruler had already come to exposing them to the Jedi.»
- Ch16 · L3483 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Nyriss · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «Nyriss shook her head. "The Emperor is more patient and careful than any being in the galaxy. He has lived for nearly a thousand years; he might live for ten thousand more. He leaves nothing to chance. If necessary, he will spend decades, maybe even centuries, preparing. No, we still have time. And Revan may still be of use to us."»
- Ch16 · L3487 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «His memories are lost, but so is his knowledge of and loyalty to the Emperor.»
- Ch16 · L3487 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «Whatever was done to him, it freed him from the Emperor's domination.»
- Ch16 · L3487 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «If we can learn how this happened, we might be able to use it to bring the Emperor down.»
- Ch16 · L3487 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «Remember that all those who have direct access to the Emperor—the Emperor's Voice, the Emperor's Hand, the soldiers in the Imperial Guard—are under his spell.»
- Ch16 · L3493 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"The Emperor is not the only one who can be patient," she replied.»
- Ch18 · L3855 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · NATHEMA ritual (lore): «They had known it was only a matter of time until the Jedi found them, and the ruler of Nathema—a Sith named Lord Vitiate—had preyed upon his people's fear.»
- Ch18 · L3855 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «Transcripts of Vitiate's public speeches were filled with graphic warnings of what the Jedi would do once they arrived.»
- Ch18 · L3855 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «Vitiate had consciously and carefully driven the people into a state of panic, knowing they would blindly follow anyone who offered hope.»
- Ch18 · L3857 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · NATHEMA ritual (lore): «Vitiate was quick to fulfill that role, and he put out a call for all the other surviving Dark Lords to join him on Nathema in a ritual that he promised would lead the Sith to salvation.»
- Ch18 · L3859 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «At the same time he was doing this, Vitiate also had top historians and scientists secretly trying to determine the location of a planet called Dromund Kaas—the long-lost homeworld of the original Sith species.»
- Ch18 · L3863 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «The team Vitiate assigned to search out Dromund Kaas had operated in total secrecy, sequestered day and night in a research lab as they studied the ancient star maps and astrogation charts.»
- Ch18 · L3865 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · NATHEMA ritual (lore): «The final entry in the team leader's project log detailed her efforts to prepare her findings so they could be presented to Vitiate in person. Lord Vitiate publicly proclaimed the commencement of his great ritual just three days later.»
- Ch18 · L3869 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · NATHEMA ritual (lore): «The ritual had obviously destroyed Nathema, snuffing out all life on the world. Lord Vitiate had offered his people hope, and instead had brought them a fate worse than death—utter eradication of life, existence, and even the Force.»
- Ch18 · L3871 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · NATHEMA ritual (lore): «Meetra was no expert on dark side sorcery, but it was safe to assume Vitiate not only survived the ritual, but emerged more powerful than ever. And with the destruction of everyone on Nathema—including his research team—he alone would have known the location of Dromund Kaas.»
- Ch18 · L3873 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «The plan was both horrifying and brilliant. In addition to becoming more powerful than Meetra could imagine, Vitiate could blame the extinction of his homeworld on the Jedi, further panicking the remaining Sith worlds. Then he could have offered them a glimmer of hope, promising to lead all those who swore loyalty to him to a place where the Jedi would never find them.»
- Ch18 · L3875 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «If Vitiate had been as cunning as Meetra imagined him to be, he wouldn't have led his followers directly to Dromund Kaas.»
- Ch18 · L3875 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «By the time they finally reached Dromund Kaas, they would likely have worshiped Vitiate as a god—all-powerful and all-knowing.»
- Ch18 · L3877 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «Fascinating history, to be sure, but Meetra didn't know how it could help her find Revan. Vitiate's grand plan had taken place over a thousand years earlier. Surely Vitiate himself was long dead, and even if he had led the Sith to Dromund Kaas, there was no guarantee they were still there.»
- Ch18 · L3881 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «From the census records, it was clear that humans were—or had been—part of the Sith Empire. If Vitiate's followers had settled on Dromund Kaas, she should be able to pass among them by posing as a mercenary, a role she knew well from the years she had spent living as the Exile in the Outer Rim.»
- Ch19 · L3901 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · NATHEMA ritual (lore): «By that time Revan had already told them everything—as much as he could remember, at least. He had revealed that the Jedi had wiped away most of his early memories, including all traces of what had happened to him in the Emperor's dungeons. He had confessed that he had come to Nathema in the hopes of reclaiming his lost past, following the same trail he had embarked on years before.»
- Ch19 · L3903 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «He couldn't tell Nyriss anything about what she really asked. And though she still suspected he had been dominated by and then broken free of the Emperor's will, the scientists she had brought in to study him had been unable to find anything useful with all their testing and research.»
- Ch19 · L3907 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «And it confirmed what he already suspected: the Emperor's plan to launch another invasion against the Republic at this point in time was tantamount to suicide.»
- Ch19 · L3947 · POV Revan · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «His efforts had been well rewarded. Over the past three years he had learned much about the Sith society the Republic believed to be extinct. He knew they were ruled by an Emperor; he knew they controlled hundreds of worlds.»
- Ch19 · L3949 · POV Revan · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «About a year earlier, he had learned the name of the female who had overseen the first few interrogations. Her name was Nyriss, and she was one of the Emperor's handpicked advisers.»
- Ch19 · L3951 · POV Revan · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «At one point his captor had let slip that the Emperor was secretly planning an invasion against the Republic. More important, he had revealed that he and Nyriss—along with many other Sith—were determined to stop him.»
- Ch19 · L3973 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"Nyriss still refuses to take any real action against the Emperor," he grumbled.»
- Ch19 · L3979 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Revan · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"Nyriss is driven by fear," Revan explained, speaking in the slow, monotonous cadence Scourge had never really gotten used to. "Openly striking against the Emperor puts her life at risk. Her own immediate survival is more important to her than the fate of your Empire."»
- Ch19 · L3983 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Revan · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"I was betrayed by Malak," Revan reminded him. "Nyriss is afraid the same thing could happen to her. If she steps forward as leader, she can no longer hide in the shadows with the others. She will be exposed, and it would only take one ambitious rival to betray her to the Emperor and bring everything crashing down."»
- Ch19 · L3987 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Lord Scourge · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"If all the conspirators are too afraid to step forward, the Emperor will never be stopped," Scourge muttered. "Eventually he will lead us into a war we cannot win, and the Jedi will wipe us out in retaliation. Ultimately doing nothing is the most dangerous choice of all."»
- Ch19 · L3995 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «A year earlier Scourge would have laughed at his foolishness; after all, what had Revan accomplished besides becoming a prisoner? Now, however, he understood that though the Jedi had failed, at least he had made the effort. At least he'd had a chance to succeed. Nyriss, it seemed, wasn't even going to make the attempt. She had failed to stop the Emperor before she had even begun.»
- Ch19 · L4013 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Revan · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"We share a common goal," Revan admitted. "We both want to stop the Emperor from invading the Republic. But I am not proposing an alliance." He paused. "I do not need your help to escape. The Force has shown me that my freedom is drawing near."»
- Ch19 · L4051 · POV Revan · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «Hopefully, the Sith would come to believe that his ordinary dreams were actually visions granted by the Force. If all went well, he would come to believe there was a greater power trying to draw them together. He might decide of his own accord that Revan was the key to defeating the Emperor, spurring him to help the Jedi escape.»
- Ch21 · L4355 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «If Revan died, did any real chance of stopping the Emperor die with him?»
- Ch21 · L4355 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «When the Jedi said Nyriss would never step forward to lead the others against the Emperor, the words rang true.»
- Ch21 · L4357 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «They shared a strong commitment to a common goal; alliances had been forged on far less. But agreeing to work with the Jedi wouldn't just mean freeing him from his cell. It would mean a betrayal of Nyriss, and Scourge wasn't ready to take on both her and the Emperor quite yet.»
- Ch21 · L4583 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «What if he had witnessed this confrontation in the cave, and he had been trying to make Scourge understand that they had to become allies to stop the Emperor?»
- Ch21 · L4589 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «Nyriss would never move against the Emperor; he knew that now. He had come to accept that neither she nor any of the other Dark Council members who had plotted with her would ever actually dare to strike.»
- Ch21 · L4591 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «If anyone was going to stop the Emperor from his mad invasion of the Republic, it would have to be Scourge. But he couldn't do it alone.»
- Ch21 · L4619 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"Our Emperor is planning an invasion of the Republic. Revan wants to stop him. So do I."»
- Ch21 · L4623 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"The Emperor is mad. He wants to repeat the mistakes of the Great Hyperspace War; he wants to plunge us into a conflict that will end with our extinction."»
- Ch21 · L4633 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · NATHEMA ritual (lore): «"That was the Emperor's homeworld. To give himself greater power, he unleashed a ritual that devoured everything. When I saw what happened there, I understood the true depths of his insanity. I realized his mind was so twisted and disturbed that he was not fit to rule, and I swore to find a way to stop him."»
- Ch21 · L4661 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Lord Scourge · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"Save your anger for the Emperor," Scourge called back over his shoulder. "He is the real enemy."»
- Ch22 · L4761 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «If things ever went bad, he would need something to bargain with, and what better bargaining chip than detailed records of everything Nyriss and her co-conspirators had been involved in ever since they'd started plotting against the Emperor?»
- Ch22 · L4813 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «But if he had recruited Scourge as an ally, it had been out of necessity rather than choice. The Sith was wholly consumed by the dark side. He had no respect for life, no desire to serve any needs but his own. Even if what he said about wanting to stop the Emperor was true, his motivations were survival and self-preservation.»
- Ch22 · L4823 · POV Meetra · DIALOGUE · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"I have what you need," he said, holding up several data disks. "This will prove what I said about trying to stop the Emperor. You will see that we are on the same side."»
- Ch22 · L4843 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «It only took half that time for T3 to decrypt and verify the authenticity of the data. As promised, it confirmed what the Sith had said—he really was plotting to overthrow the Emperor. However, it wasn't just Scourge. Several members of the Dark Council, the Emperor's circle of handpicked advisers, had joined together in a conspiracy to remove him from the throne.»
- Ch22 · L4845 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «Yet after more than a decade, they had made no real progress. Instead, the disks cataloged a litany of power plays and double crosses among the various leaders of the conspiracy. They spent so much time plotting against one another that the idea of them actually working together to defeat the Emperor seemed ludicrous.»
- Ch22 · L4887 · POV Meetra · SPEECH BY Lord Scourge · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"I do," Scourge said, smiling. "I'm going to get the Emperor to help us."»
- Ch23 · L4895 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «Though he appeared calm on the outside, Scourge's heart was pounding as he mounted the steps to the Emperor's citadel. He was playing a dangerous game, but there were no other options. Time was the enemy; if they had any hope of getting Revan out of her dungeon alive, they had to act before Nyriss realized Scourge had betrayed her.»
- Ch23 · L4901 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «The Emperor was the only Sith on all of Dromund Kaas with the will to take the kind of quick and decisive action required. Convincing him that Nyriss was a traitor would be simple enough with the files he'd acquired from Sechel. The trick was making the Emperor believe Scourge had been an unknowing pawn in her plans.»
- Ch23 · L4903 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «T3 had doctored the data disks, removing all evidence of Scourge's part in the conspiracy. Scourge would claim that he came forward as soon as he learned of the plot—but there was no guarantee the Emperor would believe him.»
- Ch23 · L4905 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «Scourge was going to present the evidence in person. - Ch23 · L4907 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «At the top of the stairs he was stopped by a pair of Sith soldiers clad in red armor—two of the famed Imperial Guard. - Ch23 · L4911 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"I must see the Emperor immediately."»
- Ch23 · L4915 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"Only those on the Dark Council can speak with the Emperor," the second soldier told him, her tone curt and official.»
- Ch23 · L4921 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Lord Scourge · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"The Emperor is in danger," Scourge insisted. "I must speak with him."»
- Ch23 · L4933 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «The design of the citadel reminded Scourge of Nyriss's stronghold; not surprising, given that she had built her edifice in the same style to honor the Emperor. - Ch23 · L4937 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Lord Scourge · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"You are taking me to the Emperor?" Scourge asked.»
- Ch23 · L4939 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"You may speak with one of the Emperor's advisers."»
- Ch23 · L4949 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Lord Scourge · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"I am a Lord of the Sith," Scourge reminded him. "And an agent of Darth Nyriss. I order you to take me to the Emperor."»
- Ch23 · L4957 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Lord Scourge · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"That is for the Emperor's ears alone. I must speak to him in person."»
- Ch23 · L4959 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Captain Yarri · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"The Emperor does not like to be disturbed."»
- Ch23 · L4971 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «As she led him down the twisting corridors of the citadel, Scourge made a mental note of their path. When he and Revan finally struck at the Emperor, they would need to know as much of the layout of the citadel as possible.»
- Ch23 · L4975 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Captain Yarri · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"The throne room lies beyond," Captain Yarri told him. "There you will find the Emperor." She turned to face him. "I will give you one last chance to reconsider."»
- Ch23 · L4983 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «Scourge expected them to search him, or at least instruct him to turn over his weapons. But Yarri and the others simply stood at attention, waiting for him to enter. - Ch23 · L4985 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «Thinking about that power gave Scourge pause. Like Revan, the Emperor understood the Force in ways Scourge never would. It was possible he experienced the same kinds of visions as the Jedi; it was also possible he could peer into Scourge's mind and instantly know the truth of everything he was saying. - Ch23 · L4989 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «As powerful as the Emperor might be, he was not omniscient. - Ch23 · L4991 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «Captain Yarri and the other guards were still patiently waiting. No doubt they were used to seeing this kind of hesitation in those who were about to meet with the Emperor.»
- Ch23 · L4999 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «After a few more steps, the pedestal swiveled around, turning the throne so that it faced him. And for the first time in his life, Scourge set eyes upon the Emperor.»
- Ch23 · L5001 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «The figure before him appeared unremarkable. The Emperor was clad in unadorned black robes, the raised hood effectively hiding his face. Yet Scourge could feel the power of the dark side emanating from him with such intensity that it caused a faint rippling of the air.»
- Ch23 · L5003 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «The Emperor rose to his feet, and the durasteel doors swung shut behind Scourge with a booming crash. Scourge's step faltered briefly at the sound, but he continued forward.»
- Ch23 · L5007 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"Rise, Lord Scourge," the Emperor told him, "and speak your piece."»
- Ch23 · L5009 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «Scourge stood up to address the Sith looming above him. The Emperor had thrown back his hood to reveal his face; his eyes were as black as the Void itself.»
- Ch23 · L5011 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · NATHEMA ritual (lore): «Staring into the hollow darkness of the Emperor's gaze, Scourge's mind flashed back to Nathema, and he shivered at the memory.»
- Ch23 · L5017 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"Your service has been noted," the Emperor assured him.»
- Ch23 · L5019 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «There was something strange about the Emperor's voice. It didn't sound like the voice of a single being. It had an unusual echo and resonance, almost as if a great multitude were speaking his words in perfect symphony.»
- Ch23 · L5021 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · NATHEMA ritual (lore): «A grim theory passed unbidden through Scourge's mind: was it possible all those that had been consumed by the ritual on Nathema still existed in some form within the Emperor himself?»
- Ch23 · L5023 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «Scourge pushed such thoughts away; he needed to focus. One wrong word and the Emperor might see through his lies.»
- Ch23 · L5027 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «He paused, waiting for the Emperor to ask what he'd found. After a few seconds he realized the inquiry was not coming.»
- Ch23 · L5031 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"You should speak to Darth Nyriss if you seek to be rewarded for your actions," the Emperor said. There was no change in his tone, but the implied threat was clear: This is beneath me and you are wasting my time.»
- Ch23 · L5039 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «The Emperor had no physical reaction to the revelation; he stayed as still and calm as death itself. But the air around Scourge seemed to grow colder.»
- Ch23 · L5043 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"I would stake my life on them, my lord Emperor."»
- Ch23 · L5047 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «Scourge felt a shiver trace its way down his spine, and he knew that far more than his life was at risk. The Emperor was no longer a member of the Sith species; his power and immortality had transformed him into a being unique in the galaxy. When he spoke of life and death, it had far deeper meaning than the mere physical existence of the lesser beings that served him.»
- Ch23 · L5053 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «There was a long silence, and Scourge had the distinct impression that the Emperor was somehow communicating with someone outside the room.»
- Ch23 · L5055 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «A few seconds later the doors to the throne room opened and Captain Yarri strode in, accompanied by a Sith wearing the same dark robes as the Emperor.»
- Ch23 · L5059 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"Keep Lord Scourge in custody until this matter is settled," the Emperor intoned.»
- Ch23 · L5061 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Lord Scourge · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"Forgive me, Lord Emperor," Scourge said, speaking quickly but trying to keep his tone humble. "But Nyriss is expecting my return. If I am absent, she will grow suspicious."»
- Ch23 · L5063 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «The Emperor's dark eyes seemed to flicker with annoyance, and Scourge feared he had gone too far. The best he could hope for as punishment for his insolence would be a quick and relatively painless death.»
- Ch23 · L5065 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «However, when the Emperor spoke again it was not to pass judgment on him.»
- Ch23 · L5069 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Lord Scourge · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"Thank you, Lord Emperor," Scourge said with a bow.»
- Ch23 · L5071 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «"If your information proves false, however," the Emperor added, "you will suffer a fate more terrible than anything you can imagine."»
- Ch23 · L5073 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «As he spoke, the dark circles of his eyes seemed to fill with a swirling red mist, and for a brief instant the Emperor gave Scourge a glimpse of his true self.»
- Ch23 · L5075 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · PRE-NATHEMA Tenebrae/Lord Vitiate (lore, hearsay): «Scourge cried out in anguish as the Emperor's mind brushed against his, then he collapsed to the floor, shaking like a child. And beneath the formless terrors lurked the unbearable Void, the pure emptiness of total annihilation.»
- Ch23 · L5081 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «Only then did Scourge notice that the Emperor had retaken his seat on the throne, and that the pedestal had spun around to face away from him.»

- Ch24 · L5133 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «Scourge had spoken to the Emperor just that morning; Meetra imagined it would take at least another day or two before he assembled his forces to strike at Nyriss.»

- Ch25 · L5599 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Lord Scourge · NATHEMA ritual (lore): «"Impossible," Scourge declared. "The Guard are bound to the Emperor's will at the end of their training by a powerful ritual. They would never betray him!"»

- Ch25 · L5611 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «Two days earlier she would have been right. However, everything had changed when Scourge met the Emperor in person.»

- Ch25 · L5623 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Lord Scourge · NATHEMA ritual (lore): «"Nathema was just the beginning," Scourge agreed. "He will destroy world after world, his power and madness growing in concert until he alone is left, Emperor over an empty and lifeless galaxy."»

- Ch27 · L5945 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «The fact that Revan hadn't come to their aid told Scourge that the Jedi had gone to confront the Emperor, conjuring up images from Scourge's vision of him lying broken and beaten on the floor at the Emperor's feet.»
- Ch27 · L5953 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «Yarri's blade nearly caught him again, narrowly missing his cheek, and Scourge swore out loud. If he didn't stay focused on the fight, his vision of the Emperor killing him wouldn't even have a chance to come true.»
- Ch28 · L5977 · POV Revan · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «As Meetra and Scourge battled the Guard, Revan charged toward the Emperor.»
- Ch28 · L5979 · POV Revan · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «His opponent stood perfectly still, focusing and channeling his power. At the last possible instant, the Emperor unleashed a wave of energy that swept Revan off his feet and sent him flying backward.»
- Ch28 · L5983 · POV Revan · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «The Emperor stood in the exact same position as before; it was as if he hadn't even moved. Revan began to sense the oppressive presence of the dark side weighing down on him. The Emperor was trying to crush his will: to dominate and enslave his mind as he had before. This time, however, Revan was ready.»
- Ch28 · L5987 · POV Revan · NARRATION · POST-NATHEMA Emperor (base): «There was brilliant flash as the air between the two combatants lit up. The energy unleashed was powerful enough to send Revan staggering. The Emperor, unprepared and with much of his strength diverted to his effort to dominate Revan's mind, was sent flying backward.»
