Scourge waited while they launched their first volley of flash and stun grenades, followed by a round of suppressing fire as the soldiers took cover positions near the door. From inside came the sound of blaster carbines as the separatists returned fire.»
- Ch8 · L1563 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Moving quickly but calmly, Scourge crossed the rooftop to the hatch built into the center. A few seconds later it swung open and a pair of separatists emerged—snipers coming to the roof to take a position on the attackers below.»
- Ch8 · L1565 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge hacked down the first with his lightsaber, then grabbed the second by the scruff of his collar and yanked him off his feet. The young human looked at him with abject horror, his panic so great that he never even thought to raise his weapon.»
- Ch8 · L1569 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge turned and raced back to the open hatch. He could hear frenzied shouts and blasterfire. An instant later an explosion rocked the entire building, followed by several seconds of silence. Another round of blasterfire and shouting confirmed that Murtog's team had breached the entrance.»
- Ch8 · L1571 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge leapt through the hatch leading into the warehouse's upper floor.»
- Ch8 · L1573 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge registered all this without conscious thought; his primary focus was on the twenty-odd humans struggling into their combat gear to join the battle downstairs. Unfortunately for them, that was never going to happen.»
- Ch8 · L1575 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Like a red wind, Scourge swept through their ranks, slashing left and right, hewing off limbs and decapitating bodies. Violent bursts of the Force picked his victims up and tossed them around like rag dolls, breaking bones and shattering skulls.»
- Ch8 · L1577 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge's savage and sudden assault, and the bloody carnage he left in his wake, sent them into a panic.»
- Ch8 · L1579 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge drank in their terror and confusion, and felt the growing power of the dark side.»
- Ch8 · L1581 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge let them go; they wouldn't get past Murtog's team.»
- Ch8 · L1581 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «But Scourge didn't need to see them to hunt them down.»
- Ch8 · L1583 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «It was over in minutes. Only then, standing alone amid the bodies, did Scourge notice that the sounds of battle from below had ended.»
- Ch8 · L1585 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Most were separatists, but Scourge noticed three or four wearing Nyriss's colors.»
- Ch8 · L1587 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge shook his head, knowing it was a waste of time. The greatest fear of any separatist organization was betrayal from within. Only the two or three top people would know anything useful, and they would never have allowed themselves to be taken alive.»
- Ch8 · L1595 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge had to clench his teeth to keep from screaming with rage. He had given specific orders, and Murtog and Sechel had willfully disobeyed them.»
- Ch8 · L1599 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «As he drew near the offices, he saw both Sechel and Murtog huddled at a comm terminal. Surprisingly, there were no other members of Murtog's team nearby. Scourge approached cautiously, probing with the Force to see if he could detect any immediate threat.»
- Ch8 · L1607 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"I gave you two an order!" Scourge barked as he came up behind them.»
- Ch8 · L1613 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge didn't say anything, his eyes fixed on Sechel with a piercing glare.»
- Ch8 · L1617 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Do you take me for a fool?" Scourge asked softly, his hand casually falling to the hilt of his lightsaber.»
- Ch8 · L1619 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Sechel's smile faded, and Scourge caught a hint of fear in his eyes.»
- Ch8 · L1623 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge let the hand drop from his weapon. Now was not the time to settle this. But it was one more thing Sechel would answer for once he finally got a chance to speak with him alone.»
- Ch8 · L1631 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Darth Xedrix," Scourge gasped.»
- Ch8 · L1639 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Can you get anything more?" Scourge asked.»
- Ch8 · L1643 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (action beat) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Tell your team to load up every terminal and datafile they find," Scourge instructed Murtog. "Nyriss won't be pleased if we leave something important behind."»
- Ch8 · L1655 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · pre-immortality Scourge: «"My mistress received your message," she said to Scourge. "She wishes to speak to you at once."»
- Ch8 · L1661 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge glanced from the slave to Sechel and Murtog, wondering if they knew anything more than he did. They only shrugged.»
- Ch8 · L1663 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Let's go," Scourge said with a brisk nod.»
- Ch8 · L1669 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The slave opened the door and slipped to the side to allow Scourge, Murtog, and Sechel to crowd into the small room where Nyriss sat at her computer terminal, looking as if she hadn't moved since the last time Scourge had seen her there. She flicked off the terminal, spun in her chair, and stood up.»
- Ch8 · L1675 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Despite the compelling evidence, Scourge wasn't fully convinced. Xedrix was human, which didn't sit well with some of the Sith pureblood families in the nobility of the Empire. Yet whatever petty prejudices he had endured in his life were insignificant compared with all he had achieved.»
- Ch8 · L1677 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Darth Xedrix was the longest-serving member of the Dark Council, having joined a full decade before Nyriss. He had risen to the penultimate position in the Empire, and while Scourge could understand his desire to eliminate Nyriss or other potential rivals, it was hard to imagine that he would be bold enough to challenge the immortal, all-powerful Emperor.»
- Ch8 · L1687 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"I'm surprised the Emperor instructed you to deal with this," Scourge remarked. "I'd have expected him to order the Imperial Guard to arrest Xedrix."»
- Ch8 · L1691 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Darth Xedrix has allied himself with separatists," Scourge insisted. "He's a traitor to the Empire! It is our duty to report him."»
- Ch8 · L1693 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Sechel · pre-immortality Scourge: «"I don't think that would be the best plan," Sechel cautioned, ignoring Scourge and addressing Nyriss directly. "We have little evidence, and your rivalry with Xedrix is well known. If we come forward with these accusations, he will simply deny them. The Emperor is unlikely to act without first gathering more proof. This will give Xedrix a chance to cover up his involvement, or go into hiding."»
- Ch8 · L1697 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «It was obvious her mind was made up, and Scourge could follow the logic of her arguments. Yet he still felt uncomfortable not reporting Xedrix to the Emperor.»
- Ch8 · L1703 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Nyriss · pre-immortality Scourge: «"We would need a particularly skilled and accomplished assassin," Nyriss said. She looked at Scourge. "Do you think you can get close enough to Xedrix?"»
- Ch8 · L1705 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge carefully considered all the variables before he replied.»
- Ch8 · L1707 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge might be able to find some other way to infiltrate Xedrix's inner circle, but as Nyriss had pointed out they needed to act quickly. There wasn't time for a prolonged undercover mission.»
- Ch8 · L1717 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · pre-immortality Scourge: «It was obvious whom she was referring to, but Scourge was still reluctant. "Asking me to kill a member of the Dark Council is not as simple as you make it sound."»
- Ch8 · L1721 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"You misunderstand," Scourge said, choosing his words carefully. "The human traitor deserves to die. But he is a Dark Lord of the Sith. Alone, what chance will I have against him?"»
- Ch8 · L1725 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (action beat) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Fighting a battle I can't win isn't brave," Scourge shot back. "It's stupid."»
- Ch8 · L1729 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"You already have enough sycophants," Scourge replied, glaring at Sechel.»
- Ch8 · L1731 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Nyriss flashed one of her ghastly grins, sending a chill down Scourge's spine. Somehow he kept himself from shuddering.»
- Ch8 · L1735 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Sechel and Murtog bowed and left without a word. Scourge was pleased to see they were chastened by their sudden exclusion. Nyriss didn't speak until the Twi'lek servant had closed the door behind them.»
- Ch8 · L1739 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge's thoughts jumped back to the slaughter at the separatist warehouse; he remembered the energy and exhilaration he'd felt. He could sense his power was growing. His connection to the dark side had never been stronger. But butchering poorly prepared soldiers was not the same as facing highly trained Sith. "Xedrix won't come alone. He'll have me outnumbered."»
- Ch8 · L1747 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Nyriss paused, waiting for Scourge's response. He wasn't eager to offer one without carefully considering everything he had learned.»
- Ch8 · L1749 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «He believed what Nyriss had told him about his own abilities: He had felt the truth of it in his most recent battles. But he wasn't ready to trust her. If Xedrix was really as weak as she claimed, she wouldn't need Scourge's help to eliminate him.»
- Ch8 · L1751 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The truth was, Scourge wanted to kill Xedrix.»
- Ch8 · L1753 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge was still too young, too unknown.»
- Ch8 · L1757 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Nyriss smiled again, but this time Scourge didn't find it so unnerving. Instead, he found himself wondering if it would be her he replaced when he finally ascended to his rightful position.»
- Ch10 · L2029 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge had been waiting inside the cave on Bosthirda for nearly an hour when he finally heard the faint sound of a speeder landing outside. A few minutes later he heard footsteps coming down the passage. He smiled. Unlike his previous missions for Nyriss, this time he was not plagued with doubts and uncertainties. The anticipation of the coming kill kept him well focused on the task at hand.»
- Ch10 · L2033 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge crouched in the shadows, wrapped in a cloak of the dark side that both made him invisible to the Force and helped to ward off the chill of the subterranean air.»
- Ch10 · L2035 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «He was several centimeters taller than Scourge, but much thinner.»
- Ch10 · L2039 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Yet Scourge could sense the Councilor's enormous power. Darth Xedrix was still a member of the Dark Council, and underestimating him would be a fatal mistake.»
- Ch10 · L2041 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The moment the tall human passed Scourge's hiding place, Scourge leapt, igniting his lightsaber as he flew through the air. For a moment he thought his first strike would find its mark, and he was almost disappointed at the thought of ending Xedrix's life so easily. But at the last instant the human's own blade materialized seemingly out of nowhere to intercept the blow.»
- Ch10 · L2043 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «They exchanged a quick flurry of thrusts and parries. Scourge tried and failed to draw on his foe's fear and anger—Xedrix was too controlled, and it felt more like fighting a droid. Scourge forcibly thrust his own fears away and reached deep inside himself to find the fury he needed.»
- Ch10 · L2049 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The two apprentices launched themselves at Scourge, unleashing their rage as they drew on the power of the dark side, unaware that their anger was feeding their opponent, as well.»
- Ch10 · L2051 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The female came in high, her lightsaber slashing at Scourge's head. At the same time the human male came in low, looking to chop at his enemy's legs.»
- Ch10 · L2053 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge ducked under the woman's blows, spinning to the side as he parried the lightsaber at his knees. The pair came at him again, once more coordinating their attacks, this time trying to flank him on either side. Scourge lunged forward, splitting the attack by diving into a forward roll that took him between his two opponents.»
- Ch10 · L2057 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The man was slower to react. By the time Scourge was back on his feet, the acolyte was only just starting to turn around. The Sith Lord delivered a quick kick to the back of the man's knee; the man pin-wheeled his arms as he fought to regain his balance.»
- Ch10 · L2059 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge saw the opening and delivered what would have been a lethal blow had the woman not thrown herself between them and parried the blow. Her move was reckless and foolhardy, but Scourge hadn't been expecting it, and her impulsive reaction saved her companion. It also exposed her weakness.»
- Ch10 · L2061 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The female was the more dangerous opponent, but she obviously cared for her partner. She was willing to put herself in harm's way to defend him—a flaw Scourge could easily exploit.»
- Ch10 · L2063 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «He abruptly changed tactics, shifting from the conventional defensive positions of the Soresu form to the acrobatic attack sequences of Ataru. Taking two quick steps to gain speed, Scourge leapt at the nearby cavern wall, planted both feet on its vertical surface, then pushed off hard to launch himself in a spinning flip over the man's head.»
- Ch10 · L2065 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «His opponent tried to turn and pivot to keep Scourge in front of him, but the furious burst of action was too fast for his lightsaber to track. He was late bringing his blade up to protect his head, once again exposing himself to a lethal strike.»
- Ch10 · L2067 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «This time when the woman moved in to protect her partner, Scourge was ready.»
- Ch10 · L2067 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «When Scourge suddenly redirected his blade mid-leap to strike at her instead, she instinctively stepped back to absorb the impact with her own weapon.»
- Ch10 · L2069 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge landed beside their prone forms. He brought his heavy boot crashing down on his fallen foe's face, relishing the wet crunch of cartilage and bone beneath his heel. Her body spasmed, the muscles locked in the seizures of her death throes.»
- Ch10 · L2071 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The man had scrambled to his feet, but instead of throwing himself at Scourge, he only stared at the woman's twitching corpse. Scourge could taste his horror and fear; they gave him a fresh burst of energy. He lashed out with the Force, striking the man in the chest hard enough to send him stumbling back several steps into the cavern wall.»
- Ch10 · L2073 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The man struck the rough-hewn rock hard enough to knock the lightsaber from his hand, leaving him unarmed. With a casual flick of his wrist, Scourge sent his own lightsaber spiraling toward his defenseless foe. At the last second, the man threw up his hands in a vain effort to protect himself, but the glowing blade easily sliced through his palms and throat before ricocheting back to Scourge's waiting grasp.»
- Ch10 · L2075 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «As the human's corpse crumpled to the ground, Scourge was already turning to face his last remaining foe. Darth Xedrix was standing motionless in the center of the cavern, watching the action with a cool, detached reserve. His lightsaber was still drawn, but he held it casually at his side, the blade pointed toward the floor.»
- Ch10 · L2077 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · pre-immortality Scourge: «"I know you," he said, his voice echoing off the chamber's stone walls. "Nyriss's new pet. Lord Scourge." He wrinkled his features in distaste. "Why do you purebloods always choose such ludicrous names for yourselves? Do you think it's intimidating?"»
- Ch10 · L2079 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge didn't reply. Instead he raised his blade and began a slow, cautious advance.»
- Ch10 · L2081 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Xedrix · pre-immortality Scourge: «Xedrix laughed. "Are you really that stupid, Scourge? Has Nyriss actually convinced you that you have the strength to stand against a member of the Dark Council? Has she promised you riches and power if you defeat me?"»
- Ch10 · L2083 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"She didn't need to promise me anything," Scourge answered. "You are a traitor to the Empire. It is my honor and duty to kill you."»
- Ch10 · L2087 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge stopped, suddenly aware that he didn't feel any fear emanating from his foe. There was no anger, either. He didn't get any sense of emotion coming from Darth Xedrix at all, and he realized the old man was consciously shielding himself from Scourge's awareness.»
- Ch10 · L2089 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge concentrated his focus, reaching out with the Force to pierce the veil Xedrix had wrapped around himself, only to find nothing but a swirling maelstrom of dark side energy.»
- Ch10 · L2091 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge broke into a run, charging at his enemy the instant he understood the nature of the trap. Xedrix had kept him talking while he gathered his power for a single, lethal attack.»
- Ch10 · L2093 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Xedrix raised his left hand and unleashed his power in a storm of purple lightning. Scourge instinctively used the Force to throw up an invisible barrier to shield himself. The bolts arced through the air, ripping through the shield to engulf Scourge in electric agony.»
- Ch10 · L2099 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Ignoring the terrible pain, Scourge somehow forced himself to his feet. Xedrix raised an eyebrow in mild surprise.»
- Ch10 · L2101 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Is that what you call the attempts on her life?" Scourge gasped. "A warning?"»
- Ch10 · L2105 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge shook his head, trying as much to shake off the residual effects of the lightning as to deny Xedrix's words.»
- Ch10 · L2109 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (action beat) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Why did you let me live?" Scourge wanted to know.»
- Ch10 · L2113 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (alternation) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"You want me to betray Nyriss?"»
- Ch10 · L2117 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge didn't answer. Instead, he was thinking back on everything that had happened since he'd first entered Nyriss's service. Nyriss had admitted to hiring the mercenaries to test him, but even after that, he'd still suspected Sechel of plotting to kill him. Had the conniving adviser merely been following Nyriss's orders all along?»
- Ch10 · L2121 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Everything Xedrix said made perfect sense, but on some deep, primal level Scourge felt he was being twisted and manipulated. The old human's words seemed to slither into the cracks and crevices of Scourge's mind, burrowing into his thoughts.»
- Ch10 · L2127 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «What if he's not toying with me? Scourge suddenly wondered. What if he tried to kill me but failed?»
- Ch10 · L2131 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge reached out with the Force again, trying once more to catch a glimpse beneath Xedrix's veil. To his surprise he sensed something this time. Fear. Desperation. And almost no trace of the dark side burning inside his enemy.»
- Ch10 · L2133 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «All the pieces clicked into place. Nyriss was right: Xedrix was a shell of what he had once been. The entire time Scourge had been battling the two apprentices, Xedrix had been gathering his strength for a single surprise attack. When his apprentices fell, he'd stalled for even more time by taunting Scourge. And he still hadn't been able to gather enough power to kill his enemy.»
- Ch10 · L2135 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «When he saw that Scourge had survived, he'd realized his only chance of survival was to trick him into switching sides.»
- Ch10 · L2135 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «He'd tried to use the faint echo of the Force to dominate Scourge's mind, augmenting it with persuasive words in a form of temporary hypnosis.»
- Ch10 · L2141 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge marched forward with grim determination. Xedrix brought his lightsaber up, but Scourge used his own blade to slap it aside with ease. The strength of the blow sent the weapon tumbling from the old man's frail grasp, the blade extinguishing as the hilt clattered onto the stone at their feet.»
- Ch10 · L2143 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Xedrix · pre-immortality Scourge: «Xedrix staggered backward. He no longer pretended power: he looked desperate and afraid. "Please, Lord Scourge, I'll give you anything you want. Slaves. Wealth. Power."»
- Ch10 · L2145 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (action beat) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Power?" Scourge snorted in contempt. "You can't give what isn't yours."»
- Ch10 · L2151 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Knowing that Nyriss would want proof of his death, Scourge reached down and grasped a fistful of the old man's hair with his free hand. Then he slowly drew his lightsaber across the Dark Councilor's throat, the glowing blade cauterizing the wound as he neatly severed the head.»
- Ch10 · L2159 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Despite the possible consequences, Scourge decided it was finally time for his private talk with Sechel.»
- Ch12 · L2503 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · pre-immortality Scourge: «"I wasn't told to expect you back yet, Lord Scourge," the guard at the gate said.»
- Ch12 · L2505 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Maybe Darth Nyriss didn't think you needed to know my schedule," Scourge replied, his tone dripping with acid.»
- Ch12 · L2507 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The guard nodded and buzzed Scourge in.»
- Ch12 · L2509 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge moved quickly down the stronghold's halls, hoping his rebuke had shocked the guard into not reporting his arrival.»
- Ch12 · L2513 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge entered the room, silently locking the door behind him, then crept through the darkness to the bed where Sechel lay sleeping beneath the covers. Reaching out, he placed his gloved hand firmly over Sechel's mouth.»
- Ch12 · L2515 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Sechel woke with a start, thrashing and loosing muffled cries into Scourge's palm. The Sith Lord pressed down harder and leaned in close.»
- Ch12 · L2519 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Feeling the adviser nod, Scourge slowly drew his hand away.»
- Ch12 · L2521 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Sechel · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Lord Scourge?" Sechel asked softly. "Is that you? It's hard to see in the dark."»
- Ch12 · L2523 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"No light," Scourge warned, knowing someone might see the glow from beneath the door and decide to investigate.»
- Ch12 · L2525 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Sechel · pre-immortality Scourge: «"I trust your mission went well," Sechel said. Scourge couldn't see the expression on the adviser's face, but he detected the faintest tremor in his voice.»
- Ch12 · L2527 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"You're going to answer my questions," Scourge said.»
- Ch12 · L2531 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Meekness will not save you tonight," Scourge said. "The truth is your only hope of surviving this interrogation."»
- Ch12 · L2537 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge jammed his hand over Sechel's mouth, cutting off his words. Then he drew the edge of his blade slowly along the base of one of the fleshy tendrils dangling from Sechel's cheek.»
- Ch12 · L2539 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The smaller man screamed in agony, but his cries were swallowed up in Scourge's glove. Scourge kept a steady pressure on the blade so that the fine edge sliced cleanly through the tendril, severing it. Blood began to weep from the wound.»
- Ch12 · L2541 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge waited until Sechel's spasms had stopped before he pulled his hand away. To his credit, Sechel was smart enough to limit further reaction to a soft whimper.»
- Ch12 · L2543 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"When I ask a question, I want a direct and immediate answer," Scourge said. "So I will ask again: Is Nyriss using me?"»
- Ch12 · L2547 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (alternation) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Was Darth Xedrix really working with the human separatists?"»
- Ch12 · L2551 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge analyzed the response, focusing on the tone, pitch, and inflection. Sechel was speaking the truth.»
- Ch12 · L2555 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «When Sechel hesitated, Scourge responded by slamming his hand over his mouth again. Ignoring the muffled pleas, he lowered his blade to the adviser's face and severed another tendril.»
- Ch12 · L2567 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The answer was spoken sullenly and resentfully, but Scourge could sense the truth behind the attitude.»
- Ch12 · L2577 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge sighed and clamped his hand over Sechel's mouth yet again. But before he could bring the blade to bear, the door swung open with such force it nearly broke free from its hinges.»
- Ch12 · L2583 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge tossed the knife aside and slowly stood up from the bed. His heart was pounding, and he had to fight against the urge to go for his lightsaber. He'd known there were risks in coming after Sechel; now all he could do was hope his actions hadn't cost him his life.»
- Ch12 · L2587 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «She nodded and turned away. Scourge didn't even look back at Sechel as he followed Nyriss out into the hall.»
- Ch12 · L2589 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Darth Nyriss was silent until they reached her private chamber. Scourge was surprised to find that her Twi'lek slave was not present. It seemed that whatever was about to be said could not be trusted even to the Twi'lek's faithful ears.»
- Ch12 · L2593 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"I thought I would get to ask the questions," Scourge replied.»
- Ch12 · L2597 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"I am loyal to the Emperor," Scourge declared.»
- Ch12 · L2601 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (alternation) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"What do you mean?"»
- Ch12 · L2605 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"For a thousand years the Empire has thrived under his rule," Scourge countered.»
- Ch12 · L2611 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"No," Scourge said, shaking his head. "Impossible."»
- Ch12 · L2619 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Every Sith knew the story; it was taught to them at an early age. And while the official stance was that the Empire was slowly gathering its strength to one day strike back at their enemies, the truth was far different. Scourge and Nyriss both understood the folly of that path; they understood that the Empire could survive only as long as the Jedi remained unaware that the Sith still lived.»
- Ch12 · L2623 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"You're lying," Scourge insisted. "Attacking the Republic makes no sense. The Emperor is not a fool."»
- Ch12 · L2625 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Nyriss · pre-immortality Scourge: «"No," Nyriss admitted. "He is no fool. He is arrogant. He is powerful. And he is mad." She looked directly at Scourge. "Some of us on the Dark Council learned of his plan. To save the Empire—to save our entire species—we formed an alliance, vowing to work together to bring the Emperor down."»
- Ch12 · L2627 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (alternation) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Was Darth Xedrix part of this alliance?"»
- Ch12 · L2631 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (alternation) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Yet you betrayed him."»
- Ch12 · L2635 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (alternation) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"If he was your ally, why did he have to die?"»
- Ch12 · L2639 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"That's why you staged the fake assassinations against yourself," Scourge said. "If the separatists were targeting you, the Emperor would be less likely to suspect you were working with them."»
- Ch12 · L2649 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"And you get to eliminate a longtime rival," Scourge added.»
- Ch12 · L2653 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Why tell all this to me?" Scourge asked.»
- Ch12 · L2659 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge narrowed his eyes. This was too easy. Even if he swore allegiance to Nyriss, she couldn't just let him walk out of the room. The risk that he might report her to the Emperor was too great. She had to have some other way to protect herself, some angle he hadn't considered.»
- Ch12 · L2669 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (action beat) · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge nodded in appreciation. He couldn't help but admire how thoroughly Nyriss had entangled him in her web. "Let me guess—the files Sechel recovered from the UDM manufacturing plant and the separatist base will implicate me, as well?"»
- Ch12 · L2673 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"So where do we go from here?" Scourge asked.»
- Ch12 · L2677 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (alternation) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"And how do you intend to convince me?"»
- Ch12 · L2681 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (action beat) · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge shook his head. "I don't even know what planet he's from."»
- Ch12 · L2685 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge was interested despite himself.»
- Ch12 · L2701 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"How do I know this isn't a trap?" Scourge demanded. "Another elaborate trick to manipulate me into doing your bidding?"»
- Ch12 · L2707 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Nyriss · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Patience, Lord Scourge," Nyriss said. "It will take several days before we are ready to leave. The journey is long, and we must be certain the Emperor never finds out. Traveling to Nathema is punishable by death."»
- Ch12 · L2713 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge nodded, silently wondering if the adviser would try to seek revenge for the brutal interrogation.»
- Ch15 · L3171 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge knew that Nyriss was watching him carefully.»
- Ch15 · L3171 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «And if it turned out that Nyriss was telling the truth—if the Emperor really was mad enough to start another war with the Republic—then maybe Scourge should consider taking her side.»
- Ch15 · L3179 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The shuttle was clearly built for speed; there was no armor to speak of, and at first glance it was easy to miss the single blaster turret mounted under the cockpit. Scourge was no expert on starship weaponry, but he guessed it would only be effective at close range.»
- Ch15 · L3203 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"This sounds more like a legend than a history," Scourge remarked.»
- Ch15 · L3207 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (alternation) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"What about Nathema's ruler? The boy's father? You claimed he was a Sith Lord. Surely he didn't sit back doing nothing while a child conquered his people village by village?"»
- Ch15 · L3229 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge wondered if Nyriss expected him to be horrified by the tale. If so, she was about to be disappointed.»
- Ch15 · L3235 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «She didn't say anything else for the remainder of the trip, leaving Scourge to wonder in silence why she was so confident he would come around to her side.»
- Ch15 · L3251 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Still mute, Scourge followed her down the shuttle's boarding ramp and out onto the world itself.»
- Ch15 · L3255 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «There wasn't even any wind, and the air tasted stale in Scourge's mouth. The temperature was neither cold nor hot, but he felt himself starting to shiver.»
- Ch15 · L3259 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «She led him along the deserted streets as Scourge stared in fascinated horror, trying to grasp the magnitude of what he was witnessing. The buildings seemed to be almost fully intact; there was none of the damage and destruction normally associated with millions of simultaneous deaths. However, there were other signs of what had happened here.»
- Ch15 · L3261 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Mangled speeders and shuttles were strewn about, the remains of vehicles in motion that had crashed to a halt when their pilots were taken by the ritual. And everywhere Scourge looked there were small piles of clothes: jackets, slacks, and boots that had survived what their owners had not. Normally these remains would have been picked over by scavengers, but on Nathema even the vermin and insects were extinct.»
- Ch15 · L3263 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Where are the droids?" Scourge asked.»
- Ch15 · L3269 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge glanced upward and noticed something else unusual. The sun shining down on them from above—a star that had appeared bright orange as they'd approached the planet—was now a pale shade of brown. In fact, everything around them was either brown or gray, as if the colors had been leached out.»
- Ch15 · L3271 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge was well acquainted with death. He had no trouble understanding massacres and mass slaughter. Death and destruction unleashed powerful emotions like fear, suffering, and hatred; they fueled the power of the dark side. But what had happened on Nathema was different, and it disturbed him in a deep and profound way.»
- Ch15 · L3273 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The Emperor had consumed everything. Life, sound, color, even the Force—nothing remained. This wasn't about conquest or domination or destroying an enemy—all concepts Scourge embraced.»
- Ch15 · L3281 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge finally understood why Nyriss and the others wanted to take the Emperor down.»
- Ch15 · L3283 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «By the time they reached the shuttle, Scourge's stomach was churning. He had lived his whole life attuned to the Force; having it stripped away had left him physically ill. The shuttle shook as they took to the air, and he fought against the urge to vomit.»
- Ch15 · L3285 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «As they broke the atmosphere of the cursed world, some semblance of normalcy returned. Scourge felt the Force rushing in to fill the emptiness inside him; he felt its power invigorating him and restoring his strength. At the same time, he also felt something else: the presence of someone strong in the Force—someone who was neither Nyriss nor him.»
- Ch15 · L3287 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Nyriss suddenly began punching away at the shuttle's controls, scanning the system for another vessel, and Scourge knew she felt it, too.»
- Ch15 · L3291 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Could the Emperor have sent someone to follow us?" Scourge asked.»
- Ch15 · L3295 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «From her voice it was clear she was as puzzled as he was. If the ship hadn't followed them here, the odds against it showing up at the same time they were here were astronomical. But Scourge understood the ways of the Force too well to believe in coincidence. There had to be some connection between them and the unexpected visitor.»
- Ch15 · L3299 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge realized they had two options. The first was to make a quick jump to hyperspace in an effort to escape before being noticed.»
- Ch16 · L3341 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge had no desire to return to Nathema, but he didn't raise any objection when Nyriss redirected their shuttle back toward the planet's surface in pursuit of the damaged freighter. They had to find out who was on that vessel, why they were here, and if they were still alive.»
- Ch16 · L3347 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Anybody alive in there?" Scourge asked.»
- Ch16 · L3357 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Disembarking, Scourge got his first good look at the ship. It was an unusual shape—flat and circular, like a disk. He approached it cautiously, his heart pounding. Normally he relied on the Force to warn him of potential danger; without it he felt vulnerable and almost helpless. It was a feeling he most definitely did not like.»
- Ch16 · L3361 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge steeled himself and continued his advance until he reached the strange ship's underbelly. He pushed the access panel on the hull, and the boarding ramp slowly descended. He wasn't surprised to find it unlocked; most ships had emergency overrides on their security systems in case of a crash, in order to allow rescue workers to get inside and help the injured.»
- Ch16 · L3363 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge activated his lightsaber. The familiar hum and hiss of the blade springing to life sounded weak and distant, and the crimson blade appeared faded—even his weapon was not immune to the effects of the dead planet. But he suspected it would still get the job done if he encountered any resistance.»
- Ch16 · L3369 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Coming closer, Scourge put two fingers on the side of the man's neck, checking for a pulse. He had barely registered the faint flutter of life when his gaze fell on the hilt hooked to the man's belt: a lightsaber. Instinctively he tried to reach out with the Force to get some sense of the man's power, but he felt only the emptiness of Nathema.»
- Ch16 · L3373 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The weight of the unconscious man made it difficult to move any faster than a brisk walk, but Scourge pressed the pace.»
- Ch16 · L3373 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge strode past her and onto the ship, where he tossed the unconscious man roughly onto the floor.»
- Ch16 · L3377 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · pre-immortality Scourge: «"A Republic spy?" Scourge's brain took the news and jumped to the next logical conclusion. "If the Jedi know we exist, they will come for us. They will try to finish the extermination of our species that they began in the Great Hyperspace War!"»
- Ch16 · L3389 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"How is that possible?" Scourge countered. "The Jedi are our sworn enemies."»
- Ch16 · L3397 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"I've never interrogated a Jedi," Scourge said after a moment. He smiled. "I'm looking forward to it."»
- Ch16 · L3453 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «After four hours of questioning the prisoner, Nyriss ordered Scourge to take a break. They left him in his cell, tied to his chair, neither of them speaking until they were outside in the hall and the door to his cell had closed behind them.»
- Ch16 · L3457 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge considered the question carefully before answering. Early in his training, he had shown a knack for torture and interrogation, skills the instructors had encouraged during his years at the Academy. He was an expert in the field; he knew that wringing information out of an unwilling source was about far more than just inflicting pain.»
- Ch16 · L3461 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Effective interrogation was an art, and Scourge had an innate ability to parse fact from fiction. He knew what questions to ask and in what order; he understood when to ratchet up the intensity and when to pull back. He knew how to use the threat of pain and the reward of mercy to control his subjects.»
- Ch16 · L3467 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Nyriss wanted to know how he had escaped the dungeons of the citadel. She wanted to know about his relationship with the Emperor. She wanted to know why he had come to Nathema. On all those counts, Scourge had come up empty. Revan was resisting him, true, but at some times it almost seemed as if Revan himself didn't know—as if the information had been wiped from his mind.»
- Ch16 · L3469 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · pre-immortality Scourge: «"We might be wasting our time," he finally admitted. "His pain threshold is high, but we're already at the limits of what a human can endure. If I press any harder, we risk killing him." Scourge had seen it happen many times. Unskilled or overeager interrogators could easily push their subjects too far. In his mind this was the ultimate failure: you couldn't get answers from a corpse.»
- Ch16 · L3471 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «With difficult subjects you had to be patient. It might take multiple sessions over several days to get anything useful. But even knowing this, Scourge didn't hold out much hope for his chances with Revan.»
- Ch16 · L3481 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"If he's been gathering intel on the Republic for five years, the Emperor must be closer to launching his invasion than we thought," Scourge noted, alarmed at how close their mad ruler had already come to exposing them to the Jedi.»
- Ch16 · L3491 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · pre-immortality Scourge: «What she said made sense, but Scourge knew it would be far more difficult and complicated than she made it sound. "It might take years before you understand what happened to him," he warned her.»
- Ch19 · L3893 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge typed in the access code to unlock the door leading to the underground holding cells built beneath Nyriss's stronghold. He didn't acknowledge the guards standing watch as he stepped through, and they made no move to stop him. He had passed the checkpoint hundreds of times, and they had stopped bothering with Murtog's official security protocols long ago.»
- Ch19 · L3897 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The image showed Revan seated in a familiar position, his legs crossed and his hands resting palms-up on his thighs. His eyes were closed, his face calm—though Scourge knew that had as much to do with the medication as the meditation.»
- Ch19 · L3899 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The prisoner had not left his cell for even a single moment since his capture. There was a refresher in the corner, a small sink and a bed against one wall. In the beginning they had brought in a chair to strap him to for his interrogation sessions, but after the first few months Scourge convinced Nyriss that torturing Revan was an unproductive waste of both time and resources.»
- Ch19 · L3905 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «After six months Nyriss had lost interest in her Jedi prisoner. Her attention moved on to other plots and intrigues, though she kept him alive just in case. But while Nyriss ignored Revan, Scourge had become obsessed with him.»
- Ch19 · L3907 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The Jedi's command of and connection to the Force was unlike anything Scourge had sensed in anyone else.»
- Ch19 · L3907 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «After years of studying him, Scourge had come to understand why the Jedi had such a fearsome reputation among the Sith.»
- Ch19 · L3909 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «However, it was more than the Jedi's raw power that interested Scourge. Unlike all the instructors at the Academy, or even Nyriss herself, Revan had experienced both the light and dark sides of the Force. He had a unique perspective on its strengths and weaknesses, and Scourge was eager to learn from his experience.»
- Ch19 · L3911 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «It hadn't been easy, of course. Revan had regarded him as an enemy at first: Scourge was the being who tortured him for information. But over time that had slowly changed. Revan was held in almost total seclusion. The guards were forbidden to speak with him, and once Nyriss all but forgot about him, the weekly visits from Scourge were his only source of conversation or contact.»
- Ch19 · L3913 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge understood that long periods of solitary confinement could be even harder to endure than the brutal physical suffering of the interrogations. Loneliness and isolation would eat away at the mind and the spirit; it was inevitable that Revan would forge a relationship with the only person he ever had any contact with.»
- Ch19 · L3915 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «It was a slow and subtle process, and even now they still regarded each other with suspicion and mistrust. But eventually the instinctive need for interaction had caused Revan to open up. He would give carefully guarded answers to Scourge's questions about his beliefs and philosophies, or let slip bits and pieces of his knowledge of the Force.»
- Ch19 · L3917 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «No matter how long they spoke, Revan was careful to say very little, but over the years the tiny drops of wisdom had accumulated into a great reservoir for Scourge to draw on. Nyriss may have had no further use for Revan, but Scourge was going to exploit this invaluable resource for all it was worth.»
- Ch19 · L3919 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge unlocked the door to Revan's cell. The Jedi was still wearing the same brown robes he had been captured in; the clothes—like the prisoner himself—had not been properly cleaned in three years. Scourge winced at the stale, pungent scent wafting off the human, but it was a small price to pay, considering how much he had already gained from their regular visits.»
- Ch19 · L3963 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The Jedi had opened his eyes, but he still seemed to be lost in thought. Scourge wondered if they had altered his medication recently. Every few months they had to switch him to a new formula as his body became more resistant to the daily dose of drugs meant to keep him docile and helpless. For the first few days after each switch, Revan seemed even more out of it than usual.»
- Ch19 · L3969 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge would never admit it to anyone, of course, but he also enjoyed them. He had developed a great respect and even admiration for Revan; ironic, given how much his opinion of Nyriss had gone down in the last few months.»
- Ch19 · L3979 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Revan · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Nyriss is driven by fear," Revan explained, speaking in the slow, monotonous cadence Scourge had never really gotten used to. "Openly striking against the Emperor puts her life at risk. Her own immediate survival is more important to her than the fate of your Empire."»
- Ch19 · L3981 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"There are powerful allies who could be persuaded to help her," Scourge replied. "All they need is someone to step up and take charge. All they need is a leader to spur them to action."»
- Ch19 · L3985 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge nodded, remembering how Nyriss had done the same thing to eliminate Darth Xedrix. At the time he had believed her when she said it was for the good of the cause, but now he suspected it had just been an excuse to remove a rival from the Dark Council.»
- Ch19 · L3987 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"If all the conspirators are too afraid to step forward, the Emperor will never be stopped," Scourge muttered. "Eventually he will lead us into a war we cannot win, and the Jedi will wipe us out in retaliation. Ultimately doing nothing is the most dangerous choice of all."»
- Ch19 · L3991 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge grimaced. Sometimes he grew tired of Revan's preaching against the dark side. In this case, however, the Jedi was at least partially correct. Nyriss wouldn't think twice about sacrificing an ally or a follower, but she would never consider sacrificing herself.»
- Ch19 · L3995 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «A year earlier Scourge would have laughed at his foolishness; after all, what had Revan accomplished besides becoming a prisoner? Now, however, he understood that though the Jedi had failed, at least he had made the effort. At least he'd had a chance to succeed. Nyriss, it seemed, wasn't even going to make the attempt. She had failed to stop the Emperor before she had even begun.»
- Ch19 · L3999 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge laughed out loud at what Revan was clearly implying.»
- Ch19 · L4029 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"It is said that Naga Sadow had visions of the Sith crushing the Republic during the Great Hyperspace War," Scourge countered. "We both know that never came to pass."»
- Ch19 · L4037 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Like the vision that brought you here," Scourge asked. "The dream of Dromund Kaas and its storm-covered sky?"»
- Ch19 · L4041 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (alternation) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"And what does your vision show you? How do you make your great escape from this dungeon?"»
- Ch21 · L4345 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Back in his private quarters, Scourge tried to push the last words of his most recent conversation with Revan from his mind, but they kept returning.»
- Ch21 · L4349 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The Jedi had implied that he had witnessed something to do with his eventual release from Nyriss's prison, but Scourge knew better than to take anything the captive said at face value.»
- Ch21 · L4351 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Revan was smart. Even as Scourge used him to learn about the Force, the Jedi was trying to manipulate Scourge into helping him escape. It was possible everything he'd said had been nothing but lies. It was also possible he had been telling the truth. Maybe he really had seen something that gave him hope of escape.»
- Ch21 · L4353 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge knew he should tell Nyriss about this latest development, but so far he had kept silent on the matter. If she knew, there was a strong chance she would simply decide to execute Revan rather than allow him any opportunity to escape.»
- Ch21 · L4355 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «He had hinted at an alliance between them, and as ridiculous as it might have seemed at first, Scourge couldn't help but see some merit in the idea.»
- Ch21 · L4357 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «They shared a strong commitment to a common goal; alliances had been forged on far less. But agreeing to work with the Jedi wouldn't just mean freeing him from his cell. It would mean a betrayal of Nyriss, and Scourge wasn't ready to take on both her and the Emperor quite yet.»
- Ch21 · L4367 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Why are you here?" Scourge asked.»
- Ch21 · L4369 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Sechel · pre-immortality Scourge: «"I have news you will be interested in," Sechel replied, smiling in a way that made Scourge want to strangle him.»
- Ch21 · L4371 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (alternation) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Did Nyriss send you?"»
- Ch21 · L4375 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"What is this about?" Scourge demanded.»
- Ch21 · L4379 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (alternation) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"No."»
- Ch21 · L4383 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Get to the point," Scourge said through gritted teeth.»
- Ch21 · L4387 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (alternation) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"A human? Why?"»
- Ch21 · L4391 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"If she found you, then she already knows where to find me," Scourge said.»
- Ch21 · L4395 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Maybe you'd better come in and tell me the whole story," Scourge said, relenting and stepping aside.»
- Ch21 · L4399 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Do you think I need to get you alone to inflict pain?" Scourge asked, casually reaching out with the Force to give Sechel's windpipe a quick squeeze.»
- Ch21 · L4403 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (action beat) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"That won't bring you back if you're dead," Scourge pointed out. "Now stop playing games and tell me exactly what happened."»
- Ch21 · L4407 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (alternation) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"A holoimage?"»
- Ch21 · L4411 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (alternation) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"And you have no idea why?"»
- Ch21 · L4415 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Please do," Scourge said grimly.»
- Ch21 · L4419 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge was always careful on his missions, but nobody was perfect. "It's possible," he admitted grudgingly.»
- Ch21 · L4427 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Why are you telling me this?" Scourge asked abruptly.»
- Ch21 · L4443 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge didn't speak right away. He ran over everything Sechel had told him, trying to determine if he was being set up. The mere fact that Sechel hadn't simply turned the woman away was enough to make Scourge wary of the meeting.»
- Ch21 · L4445 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «If someone really was looking to do him harm, it was doubtful that Sechel would warn him simply because they both served Nyriss. But if he suspected the woman was tied to something in Scourge's past—some dark secret or inconvenient truth—bringing it to light was an effective way to make Scourge look bad.»
- Ch21 · L4447 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «If she turned out to be someone looking for revenge, it would prove that Scourge had been sloppy in the past, planting seeds of doubt about him in Nyriss's mind. And even if she wasn't, the situation was still likely to create some kind of mess for Scourge to clean up. That alone might be enough to convince Sechel to help her.»
- Ch21 · L4449 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Simply refusing the meeting wasn't an option, however. Now that he knew she was out there, Scourge had to take action. Whatever the motive behind her search for him, he had to face her. It was the only way to unravel the mystery.»
- Ch21 · L4451 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Sechel knew all this, of course. That was why he'd suggested sending Murtog along. On the surface it appeared the best way to deal with a possible enemy, but Scourge knew what he really wanted was to have somebody else there who would report back on the meeting if the truth turned out to be embarrassing.»
- Ch21 · L4457 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Sechel · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Of course, Lord Scourge," Sechel said with a mocking bow. "I'm always happy to be of service."»
- Ch21 · L4467 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Sechel had given her a time and location for the meeting; he'd even told her the name of the man from the holovid—Lord Scourge. But she still didn't trust him.»
- Ch21 · L4483 · POV Meetra · DIALOGUE · pre-immortality Scourge: «"We'll give them every chance to surrender," she assured him. "But be ready for this to get ugly. Hopefully it won't come to that," she added. "Maybe Lord Scourge is curious enough about why I'm here to hear me out before he tries anything."»
- Ch21 · L4501 · POV Meetra · DIALOGUE · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Lord Scourge," she called out. "Is that you? I only want to talk."»
- Ch21 · L4525 · POV Meetra · DIALOGUE · pre-immortality Scourge: «At last, Meetra turned to face the Sith. Now that she had a chance to focus her attention more closely, she recognized him from T3"s holovid. Apparently Lord Scourge had decided to show up after all.»
- Ch21 · L4551 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The instant the blue-bladed lightsaber had materialized in the human female's hand, Scourge realized she was a Jedi. And he could only think of one reason a Jedi would come to Dromund Kaas in search of him—she was here to rescue Revan.»
- Ch21 · L4563 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Actually, Scourge still wasn't sure he understood. Not fully. The female Jedi's presence was proof that Revan was telling the truth about his Force vision. He had hinted to Scourge that his freedom was close at hand; he must have had a premonition of her arrival.»
- Ch21 · L4565 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The revelation was what had stayed Scourge's blade. He wasn't willing to do battle with her until he had carefully considered all the implications and alternatives.»
- Ch21 · L4569 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «She was still poised in a combat-ready stance, as was Scourge—neither willing to make the first move, but each ready to respond to an attack by the other.»
- Ch21 · L4571 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Revan is a prisoner," Scourge told her.»
- Ch21 · L4577 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Nothing about this situation was simple. As he spoke to the Jedi, Scourge was still trying to understand why Revan had mentioned his vision to him at all.»
- Ch21 · L4579 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «At the time he'd thought the prisoner was simply trying to manipulate him, to trick him into helping him escape. Now, however, it seemed as if Revan's words had been a warning—almost as if he knew Scourge would find himself in this situation.»
- Ch21 · L4581 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «It made no sense to give any kind of warning to an enemy. However, if Revan believed that he and Scourge were destined to become allies, then his words did make sense. Was it possible he had seen a vision of Scourge working with him?»
- Ch21 · L4583 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «What if he had witnessed this confrontation in the cave, and he had been trying to make Scourge understand that they had to become allies to stop the Emperor?»
- Ch21 · L4587 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «He realized his adversary was misinterpreting his reluctance to fight as fear. She was as confused about this as he was. Yet the more Scourge thought about it, the clearer it became.»
- Ch21 · L4591 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «If anyone was going to stop the Emperor from his mad invasion of the Republic, it would have to be Scourge. But he couldn't do it alone.»
- Ch21 · L4601 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge understood her reluctance. Under normal circumstances she would be a fool to accompany him. But this situation was as far from normal as he could imagine.»
- Ch21 · L4607 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (action beat) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"I didn't know who you were," Scourge pointed out. "You wouldn't tell Sechel any of the details of who you were or why you were looking for me."»
- Ch21 · L4637 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The Jedi considered his words carefully, then deactivated her blade. But Scourge could tell she still wasn't wholly convinced.»
- Ch21 · L4641 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge nodded. Her caution was a good thing; if she'd believed him too easily he would have had to question her judgment.»
- Ch21 · L4651 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"He is safe for the moment," Scourge assured her. "But I cannot free him without help."»
- Ch21 · L4655 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge tucked the hilt of his lightsaber back into his belt and walked slowly past the Jedi and her droid toward the entrance of the cave. They stepped aside at his approach, keeping a safe distance between them.»
- Ch21 · L4661 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Save your anger for the Emperor," Scourge called back over his shoulder. "He is the real enemy."»
- Ch22 · L4669 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge knew he had to act quickly. With long, rapid strides he marched from the cave to the waiting speeder and took to the air, heading back to Kaas City.»
- Ch22 · L4671 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «He'd promised the Jedi he would return to the cave within one day, but that wasn't his biggest concern. Sechel had set up the meeting and maneuvered Scourge into taking Murtog with him; no doubt he was eagerly waiting for the security chief's report on what happened. He had to find Sechel and deal with him before the adviser became suspicious.»
- Ch22 · L4673 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Sechel would most likely be at the Nexus Room, enjoying a selection of fine wines while waiting for Murtog to call in. As a Sith Lord, Scourge had access to the facility, but he didn't want to confront Sechel in a public setting.»
- Ch22 · L4679 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"I have a message for Sechel," Scourge told him.»
- Ch22 · L4683 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · pre-immortality Scourge: «As the slave turned to enter the club, Scourge reached out a hand and grabbed him by the shoulder. "I did not say I wish to speak with him," he hissed, "I said I had a message."»
- Ch22 · L4687 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Wait until I leave," Scourge explained slowly, as if he were talking to a simpleton. "Then tell Sechel that Murtog needs to meet him. He'll know where." He stared down at the slave. "Do you understand?"»
- Ch22 · L4691 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (action beat) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Do not tell him I was here," Scourge instructed. "Do not mention me at all. Simply deliver the message. If you fail me, I will have them flay the flesh from your bones."»
- Ch22 · L4693 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «They both knew it was not an idle threat; by right Scourge could inflict any punishment he chose on a disobedient slave. Of course, the young man would also be punished if anyone discovered he had lied to a member of the club, but Scourge had far more important things to worry about than the fate of an insignificant slave.»
- Ch22 · L4697 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge turned and left the club. Once outside, he ducked around a nearby corner where he could watch the door.»
- Ch22 · L4701 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge followed him at a safe distance, careful not to draw attention to himself. Sechel didn't head back to Nyriss's stronghold; as Scourge expected he had a private location where he could conduct business he didn't want others to know about.»
- Ch22 · L4703 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «He continued for several blocks, then stopped at a small two-story apartment building in one of Kaas City's residential districts. He punched in the security code to unlock the door and slipped inside. Scourge waited a few seconds, then approached the building.»
- Ch22 · L4707 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The interior was little more than a hall giving access to the various apartments. There were four doors on the lower level, but Scourge ignored them—Sechel would never lower himself to rent a ground-floor unit. There was no turbolift, but in the back of the building there was a staircase leading up to the second level.»
- Ch22 · L4709 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge made his way up. The suites on the top floor were obviously larger: instead of four doors there were only two. Scourge picked one of the doors at random and pressed the buzzer. He waited for nearly a minute, but there was no reply. Either the unit wasn't occupied, or the resident was not at home.»
- Ch22 · L4711 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «He tried the buzzer on the other door. A few seconds later he heard footsteps approaching, then the door slid open. From Sechel's expression it was clear he was caught off guard at finding Scourge instead of Murtog waiting for him on the other side.»
- Ch22 · L4713 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Before he could react, Scourge jabbed out with his hand, driving his fingers into Sechel's throat.»
- Ch22 · L4715 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The other Sith dropped to his knees, gasping for air. Scourge stepped inside the apartment and closed the door behind him.»
- Ch22 · L4719 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Make any sound louder than a whisper and your life will end in unbearable agony," Scourge warned him.»
- Ch22 · L4721 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The adviser held up his hand and nodded to show he understood. Scourge waited patiently for him to catch his breath.»
- Ch22 · L4727 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Dead," Scourge replied.»
- Ch22 · L4731 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"How much did Nyriss know about the meeting?" Scourge demanded, ignoring Sechel's question.»
- Ch22 · L4739 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge nodded. Sechel guarded his cards closely; he wouldn't mention anything to Nyriss until he had decided how best to turn the situation to his advantage.»
- Ch22 · L4741 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"What about Murtog?" Scourge asked. "Would he say anything? Would he tell Nyriss where he was going?"»
- Ch22 · L4745 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"How long until she begins to miss him?" Scourge asked.»
- Ch22 · L4749 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Three days," Scourge muttered. "We'll have to move fast."»
- Ch22 · L4753 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Sechel had obviously sensed Scourge's urgency; he must have assumed something had gone very, very wrong at the meeting. He thought Scourge was in trouble. He wrongly believed the Sith Lord had come here looking for help, and it was making him arrogant.»
- Ch22 · L4755 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (action beat) · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge decided it was time to clarify the situation. "I want your files."»
- Ch22 · L4761 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «It would have been a pointless endeavor; Scourge knew him too well.»
- Ch22 · L4767 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Sechel knew the lengths Scourge was willing to go in pursuit of information; the scars on his cheek reminded him every time he looked in a mirror. And this time he couldn't count on a timely interruption to put an end to the torture.»
- Ch22 · L4771 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge, who had no intention of letting Sechel out of his sight, followed right behind him.»
- Ch22 · L4773 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «With Scourge watching closely over his shoulder, he punched in the access code.»
- Ch22 · L4775 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Slowly," Scourge warned.»
- Ch22 · L4779 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (alternation) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"A wise decision."»
- Ch22 · L4783 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Is this everything?" Scourge demanded.»
- Ch22 · L4787 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge had no way to tell if Sechel was bluffing. But he was willing to take the risk.»
- Ch22 · L4793 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Sechel had become a liability. Scourge couldn't leave him behind, and taking him with him was far more trouble than it was worth.»
- Ch22 · L4795 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The smaller Sith struggled to break the hold as Scourge began to apply pressure to the vertebrae in his neck. There were literally hundreds of ways he could have killed Sechel, but given their history he wanted their final moments to be up close and personal.»
- Ch22 · L4797 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Sechel tried to kick him, but Scourge had positioned himself so that the flailing foot of the other Sith only struck feebly against his thigh. He took a deep breath, braced his left arm, and yanked hard with his right hand. There was a surprisingly loud pop, and Sechel's body spasmed once before going completely limp.»
- Ch22 · L4799 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Releasing his grip to let the body slump to the floor, Scourge gathered up the data disks and left the apartment, the door automatically sliding shut behind him.»
- Ch22 · L4811 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «She still wasn't sure what to make of Lord Scourge.»
- Ch22 · L4811 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «It was easy to understand how Scourge could be drawn to him; Revan's command of the Force was greater than that of anyone else she had ever met.»
- Ch22 · L4813 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «But if he had recruited Scourge as an ally, it had been out of necessity rather than choice. The Sith was wholly consumed by the dark side. He had no respect for life, no desire to serve any needs but his own. Even if what he said about wanting to stop the Emperor was true, his motivations were survival and self-preservation.»
- Ch22 · L4821 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «She scrambled to her feet as Lord Scourge marched confidently into the cave, ready to respond at the first hint of aggression.»
- Ch22 · L4825 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge stepped forward and extended his hand, offering her the disks. She hesitated for only a moment before coming close enough to take them from his grasp. She returned to T3, carefully retracing her steps so as not to turn her back on the red-skinned Sith.»
- Ch22 · L4829 · POV Meetra · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"They might be encrypted," Scourge told her.»
- Ch22 · L4839 · POV Meetra · DIALOGUE · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Work fast, T3," she said. She looked up at Scourge. "We'd be more comfortable if you weren't hovering over us.»
- Ch22 · L4843 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «It only took half that time for T3 to decrypt and verify the authenticity of the data. As promised, it confirmed what the Sith had said—he really was plotting to overthrow the Emperor. However, it wasn't just Scourge. Several members of the Dark Council, the Emperor's circle of handpicked advisers, had joined together in a conspiracy to remove him from the throne.»
- Ch22 · L4849 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «By the time Scourge returned, she had made her decision.»
- Ch22 · L4859 · POV Meetra · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"What's he saying?" Scourge asked.»
- Ch22 · L4871 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge nodded.»
- Ch22 · L4875 · POV Meetra · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"When I first made the offer, I was hoping Revan could convince you that we should work together," Scourge explained. "Going to see him now would only be an unnecessary risk."»
- Ch22 · L4883 · POV Meetra · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"You can't fight your way through Nyriss's entire army of followers," Scourge said. "Even with my help. She has hundreds of guards and dozens of acolytes trained in the dark side. If we're going to break Revan out, we need a distraction. Something to draw the attention of the guards away while we sneak in."»
- Ch22 · L4887 · POV Meetra · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"I do," Scourge said, smiling. "I'm going to get the Emperor to help us."»
- Ch23 · L4895 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Though he appeared calm on the outside, Scourge's heart was pounding as he mounted the steps to the Emperor's citadel. He was playing a dangerous game, but there were no other options. Time was the enemy; if they had any hope of getting Revan out of her dungeon alive, they had to act before Nyriss realized Scourge had betrayed her.»
- Ch23 · L4897 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Soon—maybe tomorrow, maybe even today—Nyriss would begin to wonder about Sechel and Murtog's absence. It wouldn't take her long to learn that they had been working with Scourge, and from there she would easily fill in the blanks.»
- Ch23 · L4901 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The Emperor was the only Sith on all of Dromund Kaas with the will to take the kind of quick and decisive action required. Convincing him that Nyriss was a traitor would be simple enough with the files he'd acquired from Sechel. The trick was making the Emperor believe Scourge had been an unknowing pawn in her plans.»
- Ch23 · L4903 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «T3 had doctored the data disks, removing all evidence of Scourge's part in the conspiracy. Scourge would claim that he came forward as soon as he learned of the plot—but there was no guarantee the Emperor would believe him.»
- Ch23 · L4905 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge was going to present the evidence in person. If the Emperor suspected he was lying—or if he was simply powerful enough to see the truth—escape would be impossible. He was putting himself at great risk for the sake of the cause—something he never would have considered before he met Revan.»
- Ch23 · L4917 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · pre-immortality Scourge: «"My name is Lord Scourge; I serve Darth Nyriss. I am here on her behalf."»
- Ch23 · L4921 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"The Emperor is in danger," Scourge insisted. "I must speak with him."»
- Ch23 · L4925 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «He disappeared inside the Citadel and didn't return for several minutes. The entire time passed in silence; the remaining guard saw no reason to speak to Scourge, and he knew better than to say anything more to her. Simple lies were the most effective, and Scourge had no intention of saying anything more than was absolutely necessary.»
- Ch23 · L4933 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The design of the citadel reminded Scourge of Nyriss's stronghold; not surprising, given that she had built her edifice in the same style to honor the Emperor. The interior was a virtual maze of corridors with gray and forbidding stone walls, punctuated by heavy wooden doors leading off to antechambers and side rooms.»
- Ch23 · L4937 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"You are taking me to the Emperor?" Scourge asked.»
- Ch23 · L4945 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge stopped in his tracks, causing the soldier walking behind to stumble into him. The Sith Lord angrily shoved him back. In response, the two guards who had been at his side whipped out their electrostaffs.»
- Ch23 · L4949 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"I am a Lord of the Sith," Scourge reminded him. "And an agent of Darth Nyriss. I order you to take me to the Emperor."»
- Ch23 · L4953 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (alternation) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"These are exceptional circumstances."»
- Ch23 · L4957 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (alternation) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"That is for the Emperor's ears alone. I must speak to him in person."»
