- Ch23 · L4961 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (alternation) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"He will want to hear what I have to say."»
- Ch23 · L4965 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The calm, almost casual way she spoke the simple threat was far more effective than providing gruesome details. But Scourge wasn't about to back down now.»
- Ch23 · L4971 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «As she led him down the twisting corridors of the citadel, Scourge made a mental note of their path. When he and Revan finally struck at the Emperor, they would need to know as much of the layout of the citadel as possible.»
- Ch23 · L4983 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge expected them to search him, or at least instruct him to turn over his weapons. But Yarri and the others simply stood at attention, waiting for him to enter. The fact that they showed no concern over letting an armed Sith Lord speak to the Emperor face-to-face without any kind of preparation was a testament to the Emperor's unfathomable power.»
- Ch23 · L4985 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Thinking about that power gave Scourge pause. Like Revan, the Emperor understood the Force in ways Scourge never would. It was possible he experienced the same kinds of visions as the Jedi; it was also possible he could peer into Scourge's mind and instantly know the truth of everything he was saying. Meeting him face-to-face could be tantamount to suicide.»
- Ch23 · L4987 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «No, Scourge thought. If that were the case, he would have sensed Nyriss's betrayal long ago.»
- Ch23 · L4989 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «As powerful as the Emperor might be, he was not omniscient. He was, however, intelligent and cunning enough to have held on to his throne for over a thousand years—an unprecedented reign among the conniving and cutthroat politics of the Sith. Which meant Scourge would have to be very careful not to say anything that might give him away.»
- Ch23 · L4993 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Steeling himself, Scourge stepped inside.»
- Ch23 · L4997 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The throne sat on an elevated circular pedestal, several meters in diameter. As Scourge walked forward, he noticed that the throne was facing away from him, its high back effectively blocking any view of its occupant.»
- Ch23 · L4999 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «After a few more steps, the pedestal swiveled around, turning the throne so that it faced him. And for the first time in his life, Scourge set eyes upon the Emperor.»
- Ch23 · L5001 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The figure before him appeared unremarkable. The Emperor was clad in unadorned black robes, the raised hood effectively hiding his face. Yet Scourge could feel the power of the dark side emanating from him with such intensity that it caused a faint rippling of the air.»
- Ch23 · L5003 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The Emperor rose to his feet, and the durasteel doors swung shut behind Scourge with a booming crash. Scourge's step faltered briefly at the sound, but he continued forward.»
- Ch23 · L5007 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Vitiate / the Emperor · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Rise, Lord Scourge," the Emperor told him, "and speak your piece."»
- Ch23 · L5009 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge stood up to address the Sith looming above him. The Emperor had thrown back his hood to reveal his face; his eyes were as black as the Void itself.»
- Ch23 · L5011 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Staring into the hollow darkness of the Emperor's gaze, Scourge's mind flashed back to Nathema, and he shivered at the memory.»
- Ch23 · L5015 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Three years ago I went to serve Darth Nyriss at your request," Scourge began. "I discovered that Darth Xedrix was a traitor. He had allied himself with separatists to kill Nyriss, and I executed him for his crimes."»
- Ch23 · L5021 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «A grim theory passed unbidden through Scourge's mind: was it possible all those that had been consumed by the ritual on Nathema still existed in some form within the Emperor himself?»
- Ch23 · L5023 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge pushed such thoughts away; he needed to focus. One wrong word and the Emperor might see through his lies.»
- Ch23 · L5025 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"I continued to serve Darth Nyriss after Xedrix's death," Scourge explained. "And I continued to investigate the separatists."»
- Ch23 · L5033 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (action beat) · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge swallowed hard, his mouth dry once more. "That is not why I have come before you. Among Sechel's effects I found these datafiles."»
- Ch23 · L5039 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The Emperor had no physical reaction to the revelation; he stayed as still and calm as death itself. But the air around Scourge seemed to grow colder.»
- Ch23 · L5047 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge felt a shiver trace its way down his spine, and he knew that far more than his life was at risk. The Emperor was no longer a member of the Sith species; his power and immortality had transformed him into a being unique in the galaxy. When he spoke of life and death, it had far deeper meaning than the mere physical existence of the lesser beings that served him.»
- Ch23 · L5053 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «There was a long silence, and Scourge had the distinct impression that the Emperor was somehow communicating with someone outside the room.»
- Ch23 · L5057 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «They approached Scourge, and the robed Sith held out his hand expectantly. Scourge handed him the disks.»
- Ch23 · L5059 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Vitiate / the Emperor · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Keep Lord Scourge in custody until this matter is settled," the Emperor intoned.»
- Ch23 · L5061 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Forgive me, Lord Emperor," Scourge said, speaking quickly but trying to keep his tone humble. "But Nyriss is expecting my return. If I am absent, she will grow suspicious."»
- Ch23 · L5063 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The Emperor's dark eyes seemed to flicker with annoyance, and Scourge feared he had gone too far. The best he could hope for as punishment for his insolence would be a quick and relatively painless death.»
- Ch23 · L5069 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Thank you, Lord Emperor," Scourge said with a bow.»
- Ch23 · L5073 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «As he spoke, the dark circles of his eyes seemed to fill with a swirling red mist, and for a brief instant the Emperor gave Scourge a glimpse of his true self.»
- Ch23 · L5075 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge cried out in anguish as the Emperor's mind brushed against his, then he collapsed to the floor, shaking like a child. The touch lasted less than a second, but in that time he witnessed indescribable horrors that dwarfed anything the dark side could conjure even in his worst nightmares. And beneath the formless terrors lurked the unbearable Void, the pure emptiness of total annihilation.»
- Ch23 · L5077 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «It was over as quickly as it had begun, the awful vision retreating into his subconscious like a repressed memory as Scourge picked himself up off the floor. Neither Captain Yarri nor the robed Sith made any move to help him.»
- Ch23 · L5081 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Only then did Scourge notice that the Emperor had retaken his seat on the throne, and that the pedestal had spun around to face away from him.»
- Ch23 · L5083 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The dark-robed Sith stayed behind as Yarri led Scourge out of the throne room and into the hall beyond.»
- Ch23 · L5085 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"I see why you tried to talk me out of this," Scourge muttered as they made their way back toward the citadel's main entrance.»
- Ch23 · L5089 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"What about Nyriss?" Scourge asked. "What will the Emperor do to her?"»
- Ch23 · L5093 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"I'd rather not be there when it happens," Scourge said. "When will you make your move?"»
- Ch24 · L5109 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Meetra didn't like the idea of pretending to be Scourge's newly purchased slave, but the Sith had assured her it was the best way for her to infiltrate Nyriss's stronghold without drawing unwanted attention.»
- Ch24 · L5113 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge had also insisted she wear a slave's shock collar around her neck. It was nonfunctional, of course—she'd had T3 carefully inspect it to make sure—but she still rankled at the idea of adorning herself with a symbol so closely linked to the galaxy's most vile practice.»
- Ch24 · L5115 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «However, as distasteful as it was, she knew Scourge was right. Every slave on Dromund Kaas was forced to wear the collar; without it, no one would believe their story. T3 was accompanying them, as well, similarly equipped with a nonfunctioning restraining bolt.»
- Ch24 · L5117 · POV Meetra · DIALOGUE · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Welcome back, Lord Scourge," a guard stationed just inside the main entrance said as the trio passed by. "Darth Nyriss was just asking about you."»
- Ch24 · L5123 · POV Meetra · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"They didn't include me in their plans," Scourge said with a shrug. "I've been scouring the slave markets for the past few days, looking for a worthy purchase."»
- Ch24 · L5125 · POV Meetra · DIALOGUE · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Of course, my lord," the guard said with a slight bow. He snuck a quick peek at Meetra, a knowing glint in his eye and a faint smile on his lips, before turning his attention back to Lord Scourge. "I will inform Darth Nyriss that you have not seen the others," he said.»
- Ch24 · L5131 · POV Meetra · DIALOGUE · pre-immortality Scourge: «Once they were out of sight and earshot of the guards, Scourge stopped and turned to address them. "This could complicate things," he said. "Nyriss wouldn't have asked after the others if she wasn't growing concerned. I had hoped to avoid her until the Emperor made his move, but if I put off seeing her now it will look suspicious."»
- Ch24 · L5133 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge had spoken to the Emperor just that morning; Meetra imagined it would take at least another day or two before he assembled his forces to strike at Nyriss.»
- Ch24 · L5137 · POV Meetra · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Ridiculous!" Scourge spat. "I would never be so insulting as to bring one of my personal slaves into a meeting with someone of Nyriss's rank."»
- Ch24 · L5141 · POV Meetra · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"I could bring you if I was presenting you to Nyriss as a gift," Scourge said. "But then there would be no reason for me to keep you close by."»
- Ch24 · L5147 · POV Meetra · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Then what do you suggest?" Scourge demanded.»
- Ch24 · L5151 · POV Meetra · OWN LINE (alternation) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"I didn't bring you here so you could throw your life away. And I have no intention of becoming a martyr."»
- Ch24 · L5155 · POV Meetra · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"The Imperial Guard," Scourge gasped. "They're here!"»
- Ch24 · L5161 · POV Meetra · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"The dungeon is this way," Scourge said, quickly putting their now-pointless argument behind them. "Follow me."»
- Ch24 · L5179 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The entire incident took less than ten seconds; plenty of time for Scourge to lead Meetra and T3 in another direction. But instead of trying to avoid the melee, the Sith had simply held his ground and watched.»
- Ch24 · L5183 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge grabbed her wrist and shook his head. He stepped back against the wall, dragging her with him. Recognizing Scourge as a friendly target, the Imperial Guards ran past without even a second glance.»
- Ch24 · L5185 · POV Meetra · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"The dungeons are close," Scourge told her once they were alone again.»
- Ch24 · L5191 · POV Meetra · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Nyriss's personal attendant," Scourge noted. "But I don't see Nyriss among the dead."»
- Ch24 · L5197 · POV Meetra · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Her fate is irrelevant," Scourge declared.»
- Ch24 · L5201 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «They rounded a final corner, bringing them face-to-face with a massive durasteel door. Scourge stepped up and punched in a security code, but the door didn't open. He tried again, and the pad responded with a sharp buzz.»
- Ch24 · L5207 · POV Meetra · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"He'd better hurry," Scourge said. "I don't sense guards on the other side of the door."»
- Ch24 · L5225 · POV Revan · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «A few seconds later he heard someone outside the door of his cell. When the door opened he expected to see Scourge, but instead he found himself faced with an unfamiliar guard.»
- Ch24 · L5239 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE · pre-immortality Scourge: «Nobody had been given access to his cell without Scourge being present, and even then the Sith had mostly come to see him alone.»
- Ch24 · L5305 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Lord Scourge!" one of the guards shrieked in terror.»
- Ch24 · L5309 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Meetra Surik (the Exile) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"It's okay," Meetra said, placing a hand on Revan's shoulder. "Scourge is here to help us."»
- Ch24 · L5313 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE · pre-immortality Scourge: «"So I finally get to learn your name," he said. "Scourge. No wonder you didn't want to tell me."»
- Ch24 · L5315 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Make jokes once we're safely away from here," Scourge said.»
- Ch24 · L5319 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (alternation) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Go ahead," the Sith told them, drawing his lightsaber and approaching the guards cowering on the floor. "I'll take care of the witnesses."»
- Ch24 · L5323 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (action beat) · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge gave him a look of utter disbelief. "It's going to be hard enough to get out of here without escorting these pathetic excuses for soldiers."»
- Ch24 · L5333 · POV Revan · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge stepped over to a medkit on the wall and yanked it open. He grabbed a hypodermic filled with a green luminescent fluid.»
- Ch24 · L5339 · POV Revan · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «She nodded at Scourge, who pulled a package from the large pouch on his hip. He tossed it to Revan, who didn't even try to catch it, but just picked it up off the floor.»
- Ch24 · L5359 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"What's happening?" Scourge demanded as Revan collapsed on the floor.»
- Ch24 · L5369 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge turned to the guards still sitting on the floor.»
- Ch24 · L5375 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Get Revan out of the way," Scourge said to Meetra.»
- Ch24 · L5379 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge nodded at the guards. In response to his silent command they crept to the foot of the stairs and peered up toward the door above.»
- Ch24 · L5383 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge took a step back, knowing exactly who had been responsible for unleashing the fury of the dark side against the hapless guards.»
- Ch24 · L5387 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «She ignited her lightsaber and came to stand beside Scourge.»
- Ch24 · L5393 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «She raised her free hand above her head and fired off another burst of lightning. Both Scourge and Meetra threw themselves clear of the deadly electrical bolt, but in doing so they gave Nyriss the early advantage.»
- Ch24 · L5397 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge barely managed to parry the first wave of her assault, unable to even think about countering with an attack of his own. Another quick thrust forced him off balance and he staggered backward.»
- Ch24 · L5401 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «In the awkward position her right flank was exposed, and Nyriss brought her blade in to deliver a crippling cut. At the same time, Scourge lashed out with the Force, catching Nyriss flush in the center of her chest.»
- Ch24 · L5403 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «An ordinary foe would have been thrown clear across the room, but Nyriss instinctively threw up a Force barrier to protect herself, absorbing and redirecting the brunt of the impact. Even so, Scourge's attack knocked her off balance just enough to send her lightsaber wide of the mark, giving Meetra the opportunity she needed to scramble away to safety.»
- Ch24 · L5405 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge rushed forward, hoping to drive Nyriss back into a corner, but she met his charge with an invisible wave of rippling energy. It picked Scourge up and tossed him head-over-heels, sending him crashing to the wall.»
- Ch24 · L5411 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The air around her began to crackle and grow hot as she gathered herself for the killing blow. Scourge felt the energy building inside her, and he knew he would be powerless to stop it. Nyriss was too powerful; her command of the dark side was too strong.»
- Ch24 · L5415 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge braced himself for the end.»
- Ch24 · L5427 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge slowly clambered to his feet as Revan helped Meetra up. In the corner, the upended astromech let out a plaintive whistle and awkwardly managed to rock himself back into an upright position.»
- Ch24 · L5433 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «He stood up and slowly turned to Scourge.»
- Ch24 · L5435 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «There was something unnerving about staring into the faceless mask; it made Revan seem more intimidating, more powerful. Or maybe Scourge just felt that way because he'd watched him destroy Nyriss.»
- Ch25 · L5449 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge led them up the stairs and back to the breach in the wall where the Emperor's Guard had first burst in. Though they could hear the distant sounds of battle echoing faintly through the halls, they didn't encounter combatants from either side.»
- Ch25 · L5455 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «They picked their way through the carnage to where Scourge's speeder stood unharmed near the landing pad. Every vehicle around it had been destroyed by artillery fire.»
- Ch25 · L5459 · POV Meetra · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"The Guard must have been watching our arrival," Scourge said. "They knew which speeder was mine."»
- Ch25 · L5461 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The four of them climbed in, Revan and Meetra helping T3, then headed for the cave where Meetra and Scourge had first met.»
- Ch25 · L5473 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge brought the speeder in to land, and the three passengers disembarked.»
- Ch25 · L5481 · POV Meetra · OWN LINE (action beat) · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge nodded. "I'll be back in a few hours."»
- Ch25 · L5485 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The cave was empty now. While waiting for Scourge to return from his meeting with the Emperor, Meetra and T3 had buried the bodies of the fallen security chief and his soldiers in a bare patch of ground a short hike away from the cave's entrance.»
- Ch25 · L5511 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «A tear rolled down Revan's cheek as he watched the vid, and Meetra quietly retreated into a dark corner of the cave to let him watch in private. She'd stashed her clothes here before she and Scourge had left for Nyriss's stronghold, and the shadows gave her the privacy she needed to change out of her slave's outfit.»
- Ch25 · L5557 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «When scourge arrived back at the cave he found Meetra and Revan huddled side by side on the floor, staring at a holovid projected by T3. He caught a glimpse of a young human female and what Scourge assumed was her child, but as he approached the droid quickly cut the recording off.»
- Ch25 · L5563 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «He stood up stiffly and stretched, and Scourge wondered how long he had been sitting on the floor of the cave watching the holovid. He also noticed that Revan had removed his mask; it was sitting on the ground beside him, seemingly forgotten.»
- Ch25 · L5567 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «When Revan didn't answer, it was clear he had no intention of discussing his personal life with a Sith. They might be allies, Scourge realized, but they were far from friends. Which was as it should be—for a Sith Lord, friends were a liability.»
- Ch25 · L5575 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"I said he killed them all," Scourge replied. "All twelve members of the Dark Council—even those who weren't part of the conspiracy. He wanted to send a message no one would ever forget."»
- Ch25 · L5579 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (alternation) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"The Imperial Guard were only unleashed on Nyriss and two others. The Emperor must have assumed they were the ones least likely to answer his summons. The other nine were called together in the hours before the attack to meet with the Emperor at his citadel. None of them left alive."»
- Ch25 · L5583 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"News of the massacre spread quickly," Scourge said. "As you would expect, the result was chaos. Thousands are fleeing for their lives, fearing we are on the brink of civil war. Others see an opportunity to strike at rivals weakened by the sudden loss of political allies, and armed platoons are roaming the streets."»
- Ch25 · L5587 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (alternation) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"He's declared martial law and imposed a curfew over the entire city. The Guard are enforcing his orders with their typical ruthless efficiency. He also forbade any ship or shuttle to land or leave before he launched his attack, and he shut down all offworld communications."»
- Ch25 · L5595 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"The last time you were here?" Scourge said, pouncing on the phrase. "Have some of your memories returned?"»
- Ch25 · L5599 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Impossible," Scourge declared. "The Guard are bound to the Emperor's will at the end of their training by a powerful ritual. They would never betray him!"»
- Ch25 · L5609 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Meetra glanced over at Scourge, and the Sith could guess what she was thinking. He'd originally allied with them because he feared invading the Republic would be a disaster. With Revan implying the Emperor could actually succeed, she feared he would turn on them.»
- Ch25 · L5611 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Two days earlier she would have been right. However, everything had changed when Scourge met the Emperor in person.»
- Ch25 · L5623 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Nathema was just the beginning," Scourge agreed. "He will destroy world after world, his power and madness growing in concert until he alone is left, Emperor over an empty and lifeless galaxy."»
- Ch25 · L5627 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"You've been to Nathema," Scourge said. "You felt the Void. You know what the Emperor is capable of."»
- Ch25 · L5629 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Revan · pre-immortality Scourge: «"She understands," Revan said, reading her expression more accurately than Scourge. "That's not it."»
- Ch25 · L5633 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge hadn't considered that possibility, and it chilled him to his core.»
- Ch25 · L5641 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge answered on Revan's behalf. "The Emperor had to keep his plans secret because he knew the Dark Council would oppose him. Now they are wiped out. And whoever he picks to replace them will remember what happened to their predecessors, and be too terrified to speak out against him."»
- Ch25 · L5645 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"He won't make his proclamation until order is restored on Dromund Kaas," Scourge noted.»
- Ch25 · L5649 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"The Guard are patrolling the streets, enforcing the curfew," Scourge said. "Only a handful remain stationed at the citadel. Now is our best chance to strike at the Emperor."»
- Ch25 · L5653 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"We should wait until dawn," Scourge said. "There will be fewer people out in the light of day. And most of the Guard will be recovering at the barracks after patrolling the streets all night."»
- Ch25 · L5657 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Both Meetra and Scourge nodded in agreement, though the Sith doubted any of them would get much sleep.»
- Ch26 · L5665 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge hovered on the edge of sleep. His body was exhausted, but his mind was churning. Unable to still his thoughts and let sleep wash over him, he tossed and turned.»
- Ch26 · L5671 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Revan lay motionless on the floor of the Citadel's throne room. Meetra and Scourge lay beside him, their bodies twisted and broken, clinging to the last moments of life.»
- Ch26 · L5673 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The Emperor approached the trio, regarding them with a cold and casual contempt as he loomed above his fallen adversaries. Scourge tried to stand and flee, but his crippled limbs wouldn't support his weight. All he could do was crawl on his belly like a worm.»
- Ch26 · L5675 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «His efforts drew the attention of the Emperor, who didn't speak but came over and lowered himself to one knee. He grabbed Scourge by the shoulder and rolled him over so he was staring up into the twin voids of the Emperor's eyes.»
- Ch26 · L5677 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «As he reached out a hand and placed it on Scourge's forehead, the Sith began to scream.»
- Ch26 · L5679 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge's eyes popped open as his mind snapped to a fully alert state of consciousness. His heart was pounding, and he could still hear the sound of his own scream ringing in his ears.»
- Ch26 · L5683 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge shook his head, trying to push away the remnants of his dream. But the memory stayed with him, and he began to realize that what he had seen was something more than a mere nightmare.»
- Ch26 · L5685 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The experience lacked the hazy, surreal feel of a dream. It had been too vivid, the details too sharp and precise to be a figment manifested by his subconscious. There was only one possible explanation for what had happened: the Force had given Scourge a vision.»
- Ch26 · L5687 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge's hands began to tremble slightly as he realized he had witnessed his own destruction at the Emperor's hand. Even worse, the vision made it clear that both Meetra and Revan would suffer the same fate. He had opened himself up to the Force, and it had shown him that their coming mission would end in failure.»
- Ch26 · L5693 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE · pre-immortality Scourge: «The simplest course would be to tell Revan what he had seen and hear his opinion of it. But Scourge knew his allies" trust in him was already fragile. If he admitted he thought their mission was doomed, it could convince them he couldn't be trusted. They might even decide it was his presence that caused their failure; after all, he was the one who had seen the vision.»
- Ch26 · L5695 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge continued to struggle with what he had seen, trying to understand what it meant and what he should do about it. But after several more minutes of silently talking himself in circles, he realized he simply wouldn't find the answers on his own.»
- Ch26 · L5699 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"May I speak with you?" Scourge asked, taking a seat beside the Jedi without waiting for a reply.»
- Ch26 · L5703 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"I want to know more about the Force," Scourge said. "I want to understand it as you do."»
- Ch26 · L5707 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"This might be our last chance," Scourge said. "I've been thinking about something you said to me the last time we spoke in your cell."»
- Ch26 · L5711 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (alternation) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"You knew Meetra was coming to rescue you because the Force had given you a vision."»
- Ch26 · L5715 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Is that how it happens?" Scourge asked, slightly miffed at Revan's confession. "They come to you in your dreams?"»
- Ch26 · L5719 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «I do now, Scourge thought.»
- Ch26 · L5723 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"That seems a highly unlikely coincidence," Scourge noted.»
- Ch26 · L5727 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"But she started looking for you long before we had our conversation," Scourge protested.»
- Ch26 · L5731 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge silently tried to digest what he was being told. At the same time, he tried to form the questions that would give him the answers he wanted without revealing what he had seen.»
- Ch26 · L5745 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «There was another long period of silence before Scourge asked another question. "Have you had any visions of what will happen when we face the Emperor?"»
- Ch26 · L5749 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (alternation) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Doesn't that terrify you?"»
- Ch26 · L5753 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"We Sith are taught to embrace our fear," Scourge told him. "We transform it into anger and use it to fuel the power of the dark side."»
- Ch26 · L5757 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"And what are your actions driven by?" Scourge asked. "Logic? Reason?"»
- Ch26 · L5761 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (alternation) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Then why did you do it?"»
- Ch26 · L5765 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"And what if we don't stop him?" Scourge said, treading perilously close to the heart of what he really wanted to say. "What if he's too strong?"»
- Ch26 · L5769 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"You're just trying to buy time," Scourge gasped. "You don't care if the Emperor kills us all—you just want to delay him!"»
- Ch26 · L5773 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Time for your son to become a man," Scourge noted bitterly. "Are you hoping he will finish what you might not?"»
- Ch26 · L5777 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (action beat) · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge shook his head. "I'm beginning to think you are as mad as the Emperor. I have no intention of dying tomorrow."»
- Ch26 · L5783 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge got to his feet and walked back to the section of the cave he had been sitting in earlier. He briefly considered talking to Meetra, then realized that would be a waste of time. She would only echo what Revan had said.»
- Ch27 · L5793 · POV Revan · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «As planned, Revan, Meetra, Scourge, and T3-M4 left the cave at dawn, though dawn on Dromund Kaas was a term with little meaning. The black storm clouds completely blocked out the sun, and the sky was only marginally lighter than it had been during the night.»
- Ch27 · L5809 · POV Revan · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Revan knew he didn't have to worry about Meetra or the faithful droid. Scourge was another matter, however. The conversation they'd had during the night left little doubt that the Sith was troubled.»
- Ch27 · L5813 · POV Revan · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «For the Sith, however, there was no such thing as a noble death. Scourge understood the concept of sacrifice, but only when it came to sacrificing others. He had been taught to value survival above all else. Even his willingness to join with Revan and Meetra was driven by his desire for self-preservation; ultimately he wanted victory only for his sake, and not for the sake of others.»
- Ch27 · L5815 · POV Revan · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Perhaps there was no greater illustration of the difference between the light side and the dark, and Revan knew it would make their mission more difficult for Scourge. He had tried to make him understand during their brief conversation, but it was hard to undo years of teaching in a single night.»
- Ch27 · L5819 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"I can't bring the speeder in too close," Scourge said now, taking them in for a landing on the farthest outskirts of Kaas City. "They might have set up ion cannons to shoot down any unauthorized vehicles."»
- Ch27 · L5827 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"If we run into anyone, let me do the talking," Scourge whispered as they mounted the steps.»
- Ch27 · L5833 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"You fool!" Lord Scourge spat at the Guard, his voice rising with arrogant indignation. "Do you know who I am?"»
- Ch27 · L5837 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE · pre-immortality Scourge: «"I need no authorization! My name is Lord Scourge, and I demand a meeting with the Emperor."»
- Ch27 · L5839 · POV Revan · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «From the reaction of the soldiers it was clear they recognized the name. No doubt every member of the Emperor's Guard was aware by now that Scourge had been the catalyst for the Emperor's sudden purging of the entire Dark Council.»
- Ch27 · L5843 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"No," Scourge said. "They will come with me to speak with the Emperor in person."»
- Ch27 · L5849 · POV Revan · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Revan was impressed by Scourge's performance, not to mention relieved. On his last visit to Dromund Kaas, he and Malak had learned everything they could about the Imperial Guard. Though not attuned to the Force in the classical sense, the elite soldiers had a connection with the Emperor, allowing them to draw strength from the dark side. They were formidable opponents, even for a Jedi.»
- Ch27 · L5861 · POV Revan · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Alone, probably not. With the combined strength of Meetra, Scourge, and even T3, however, he believed they stood a real chance of victory.»
- Ch27 · L5865 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Where is your captain?" Scourge demanded, and Revan realized there was nobody there to meet them.»
- Ch27 · L5869 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"I will not be kept waiting," Scourge snarled, continuing to play his part. "I demand you open these doors immediately!"»
- Ch27 · L5871 · POV Revan · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The soldier hesitated, then motioned for two of his men to do as Scourge had commanded.»
- Ch27 · L5873 · POV Revan · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Revan braced himself for what was to come. They had discussed this part of their plan before leaving the cave. The instant the doors were pushed opened, all four would charge inside. While Revan rushed the Emperor, Meetra and Scourge would hang back and hold off the guards long enough for T3 to close and seal the doors.»
- Ch27 · L5881 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Captain Yarri," said the man who escorted them in, snapping off a sharp salute. "Lord Scourge demands another meeting with the Emperor."»
- Ch27 · L5885 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE · pre-immortality Scourge: «"This is not acceptable, Lord Scourge," she said, the heels of her boots clacking as she approached. "If you wish to speak with the Emperor, you must do so alone."»
- Ch27 · L5887 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"I do not take orders from you, Captain," Scourge said.»
- Ch27 · L5893 · POV Revan · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «He slapped the hand away and turned to face them. Yarri was standing beside Scourge, a few meters away from the rest of the group. She had come alone to meet them, bringing their escort up to a total of seven.»
- Ch27 · L5903 · POV Revan · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The second soldier leapt into the fray, forcing Meetra to fall back a step to absorb their coordinated attack. Slightly farther away, Scourge and Captain Yarri were also already engaged in close-quarters combat, his lightsaber clashing against her electrostaff as they battled in the narrow confines of the entrance hall.»
- Ch27 · L5917 · POV Revan · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «T3 had followed him into the throne room, but Meetra and Scourge were still locked in battle with the guards in the hall outside. They were waging a fighting retreat; they had maneuvered themselves so they could back into the throne room while keeping the guards at bay.»
- Ch27 · L5921 · POV Revan · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «It wasn't enough to block the passage, but it did buy Scourge and Meetra a few precious seconds to complete their retreat into the chamber. They crossed the threshold, still engaged with Captain Yarri and the three surviving Imperial Guard that had escorted them to the throne room.»
- Ch27 · L5939 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge was an expert swordsman; at the Academy even the instructors had been reluctant to face him in the training ring. When the dark side flowed through him, his blade was more than a weapon. It became an extension of his will.»
- Ch27 · L5941 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Captain Yarri's skill with her electrostaff was impressive, but ultimately she was no match for a Sith Lord. Knowing this, she had wisely adopted a defensive style to hold off the first few flurries of Scourge's attack, her focus on stalling him long enough for one of her companions to join the fray before switching to a more aggressive form.»
- Ch27 · L5943 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Now Scourge was forced to defend himself on two fronts as he backed into the throne room. In his peripheral vision he saw that Meetra was in a similar situation, retreating while battling a pair of enemies.»
- Ch27 · L5945 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The fact that Revan hadn't come to their aid told Scourge that the Jedi had gone to confront the Emperor, conjuring up images from Scourge's vision of him lying broken and beaten on the floor at the Emperor's feet.»
- Ch27 · L5947 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Yarri's staff slipped through his defenses and clipped him on his right shoulder. Scourge's armor absorbed the worst of the blow, though he felt a painful jolt from the electrostaff's charge that made his hand and arm tingle.»
- Ch27 · L5949 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Even as Scourge cursed himself for allowing thoughts of his vision to distract him, he deftly switched his blade from his temporarily numb right hand to his left. The move was dangerous; it left him momentarily vulnerable as he made the switch. Fortunately his opponents were unprepared for the unorthodox tactic, and neither was able to take advantage.»
- Ch27 · L5951 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «While he and Meetra fought the quartet of guards, T3-M4 was busy sealing the doors. The droid was spraying black foam along the edge where the double doors came together. Scourge recognized the foam as a powerful contact adhesive commonly used to repair starships; seconds after being exposed to air it would harden into a substance that could be cut only with a plasma torch.»
- Ch27 · L5953 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Yarri's blade nearly caught him again, narrowly missing his cheek, and Scourge swore out loud. If he didn't stay focused on the fight, his vision of the Emperor killing him wouldn't even have a chance to come true.»
- Ch27 · L5957 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge pressed his attack, calling on the dark side to transform his uncertainty and fear into white-hot rage. He felt the power coursing through him, the spark of fury deep inside him igniting into a firestorm of death and destruction.»
- Ch27 · L5959 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Left-handed, Scourge unleashed a pair of savage chops at Yarri's partner, using raw brute strength to overpower his physically weaker opponent. The guard parried the blows, but the first knocked him off balance and the second sent him stumbling backward.»
- Ch27 · L5961 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «While the guard struggled to recover, Scourge focused his assault on the captain. Yarri sensed the shift in her opponent too late to switch back to a more defensive form, and the Sith Lord was quick to exploit the tactical flaw.»
- Ch27 · L5963 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge seized the opportunity, his blade biting deep into her hip.»
- Ch27 · L5963 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The other guard leapt to her defense, recklessly throwing himself between his fallen captain and Scourge.»
- Ch27 · L5965 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «At Scourge's feet, Yarri fumbled to reclaim her weapon. The agony of her wound made her desperate and clumsy, giving Scourge time to relish her suffering. As her fingers wrapped around the hilt of her electrostaff, he brought his boot down on top of her hand, crushing the bones.»
- Ch27 · L5969 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Meetra Surik (the Exile) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"We have to help Revan!" Meetra shouted, and Scourge turned to see that she, too, had just finished off her opponents. "He needs us!"»
- Ch28 · L5977 · POV Revan · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «As Meetra and Scourge battled the Guard, Revan charged toward the Emperor.»
- Ch28 · L6027 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Even as she called to Scourge to help, Meetra was already sprinting toward the far end of the throne room. Scourge hesitated before joining her, taking a moment to survey the situation, memories of his vision of their failure still fresh in his mind.»
- Ch28 · L6037 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Suddenly empty-handed, the Emperor took a quick step back. His attention had been focused solely on Revan; Meetra's trick had caught him by surprise. Scourge realized that if she had aimed at the Emperor instead of the blade, she could have ended his life even as he ended Revan's. But her instincts to save her friend overrode her desire to kill her enemy, and Scourge could only lament the lost opportunity.»
- Ch28 · L6041 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Sensing hesitation and uncertainty in the Emperor as he tried to evaluate the strength and weaknesses of his new foe, Scourge rushed forward to join Meetra and Revan.»
- Ch28 · L6043 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Meetra had placed herself between the Emperor and Revan, valiantly protecting her wounded friend. As Scourge reached them, Revan managed to stand up again. He reached out with an open palm and his lightsaber sprang from the floor and into his waiting grasp.»
- Ch28 · L6047 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Vitiate / the Emperor · pre-immortality Scourge: «"I expected better from you, Lord Scourge," the Emperor said.»
- Ch28 · L6049 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge wondered if he was stalling for time so his Guard could break through the sealed door. There wasn't much chance of that, however; by the time they broke into the throne room the battle would already be decided, one way or the other.»
- Ch28 · L6059 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «For Scourge, the universe suddenly seemed frozen in place, as if time itself had stopped. He realized he was at a crux in history; fate and destiny would be forever altered in the next few moments.»
- Ch28 · L6063 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «He had to choose, but there was no way to know which was the most likely outcome, or what actions of his would lead to which results. Revan had said visions could guide the Jedi, but for Scourge they brought nothing but confusion.»
- Ch28 · L6065 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The moment passed and the universe began to move again, though everything seemed to be happening in slow motion. Revan and Meetra stepped forward, ready to initiate the final confrontation. Scourge knew he had to act now; he had to make his choice.»
- Ch28 · L6069 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Instead of advancing with his two companions, Scourge stepped to the side so that he was standing directly behind Meetra. There was a flicker in his consciousness as the universe snapped back to full speed, and he slid the blade of his lightsaber between her shoulders.»
- Ch28 · L6073 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge could smell burning flesh as Revan screamed once then collapsed to the ground, unconscious.»
- Ch28 · L6075 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The Emperor turned to face Scourge, and the Sith Lord dropped to one knee, head bowed in supplication.»
- Ch28 · L6077 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Vitiate / the Emperor · pre-immortality Scourge: «"Explain yourself," the Emperor said, and Scourge knew if he chose his words poorly they would be the last he ever spoke.»
- Ch28 · L6083 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (action beat) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"I didn't know," Scourge lied. "I only found out after the Guard razed her stronghold. The Jedi sought me out. They knew I worked for Nyriss; they never suspected that I was the one who had betrayed her."»
- Ch28 · L6087 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · pre-immortality Scourge: «"I knew they could never defeat you," Scourge said. "So I played along, waiting for my chance to turn on them and prove my loyalty to you once more."»
- Ch28 · L6091 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Scourge nodded, and rose to his feet. He walked over to Revan, bent down, and ripped off his helmet. The Jedi's face was badly burned, the outline of his mask indelibly seared into his cheeks and forehead. He was still unconscious, his body in shock from his wounds; without medical attention he would die soon anyway.»
- Ch28 · L6097 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «Despite his curiosity, Scourge knew better than to ask how. He couldn't risk anything that might make it appear he was concerned about the Jedi's fate. To sell his lie, he had to make it seem as if everything he had done had been for the most obvious and selfish of reasons.»
- Ch28 · L6101 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · pre-immortality Scourge: «The Emperor smiled, and Scourge's entire body went cold.»
- Ch29 · L6113 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · IMMORTAL Emperor's Wrath: «Scourge nodded, though even if he had wanted to refuse it was far too late now.»
- Ch29 · L6117 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · IMMORTAL Emperor's Wrath: «They were still inside the citadel, but this private chamber was much smaller than the throne room. It was unfurnished and, apart from the Emperor, Scourge, and the infernal machinery he was hooked up to, completely empty.»
- Ch29 · L6119 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · IMMORTAL Emperor's Wrath: «In the wake of Revan's defeat, the Emperor hadn't made him a member of the Dark Council after all. Instead, he had created a new position for Scourge: the Emperor's Wrath.»
- Ch29 · L6121 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · IMMORTAL Emperor's Wrath: «The Emperor had believed his explanation about Revan. As a reward Scourge was to become his personal enforcer and executioner, taking his orders directly from the Emperor and answering to no one but him.»
- Ch29 · L6123 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · IMMORTAL Emperor's Wrath: «That wasn't the full extent of his reward, however. For his role in exposing Xedrix, Nyriss, and Revan, the Emperor had promised to grant Scourge the gift of eternal life. He would forever serve at the Emperor's side, an honor far greater than even that of being selected for the Dark Council.»
- Ch29 · L6125 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · IMMORTAL Emperor's Wrath: «Scourge had eagerly accepted, knowing his new position would give him both time and opportunity to find another way to stop the Emperor before his madness and hunger consumed the galaxy.»
- Ch29 · L6127 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Vitiate / the Emperor · IMMORTAL Emperor's Wrath: «"Open yourself to the dark side," the Emperor said, and Scourge felt the air around him begin to swirl with power.»
- Ch29 · L6129 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · IMMORTAL Emperor's Wrath: «Betraying his allies had not altered the inevitable outcome; the Emperor would have won regardless. At least this way Scourge was still alive to carry on their cause.»
- Ch29 · L6131 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · IMMORTAL Emperor's Wrath: «Revan was still alive, too, but he was as good as dead to Scourge. The Emperor was holding him prisoner in a secret facility, and Scourge knew he could never risk trying to find its location. He couldn't do anything that might suggest an ongoing connection between him and Revan. Doing so would expose the truth to the Emperor, making his sacrifice of the Jedi pointless.»
- Ch29 · L6135 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · IMMORTAL Emperor's Wrath: «Scourge felt a sharp burst of heat in his chest. He gritted his teeth in pain as the heat grew more intense.»
- Ch29 · L6139 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · IMMORTAL Emperor's Wrath: «Scourge knew they were wrong. There was no sense in throwing his life away with theirs. Betrayal was the cost of stopping the Emperor, and he alone had been willing to pay it.»
- Ch29 · L6145 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · IMMORTAL Emperor's Wrath: «It would be several decades, maybe longer, before the Emperor revisited the idea of invading the Republic. In that time, much could happen. Revan had spoken of another champion who would rise; Scourge had seen that champion in his final vision. Blessed with eternal life, Scourge would serve faithfully at the Emperor's side, biding his time as he waited for that champion to emerge from the mists of time.»
- Ch29 · L6151 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · IMMORTAL Emperor's Wrath: «Scourge screamed as invisible claws tore at his insides, seemingly shredding his vital organs.»
- Ch29 · L6155 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Vitiate / the Emperor · IMMORTAL Emperor's Wrath: «"The ritual cannot be undone," the Emperor said as Scourge writhed and wept at his feet.»
- Ch29 · L6157 · POV Scourge · NARRATION · IMMORTAL Emperor's Wrath: «Through his torment, Scourge realized with dawning horror what the Emperor was saying. The ritual was over, but the searing heat and the rending of his insides continued unabated.»
- Ch29 · L6165 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution) · IMMORTAL Emperor's Wrath: «"Why?" Scourge asked, his voice something between a sob and a moan.»
- Ch29 · L6201 · POV Revan · NARRATION · IMMORTAL Emperor's Wrath: «It was impossible to know what would have happened if Scourge had not betrayed them in the throne room. They might have lost anyway, but they also might have defeated the Emperor, forever freeing the galaxy from the threat of annihilation at the hands of a madman. There was no way to be sure, and no point in dwelling on the past.»

### Q · Bastila Shan (108 entries: 38 own lines, 70 about/mentions)

- Prologue · L97 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «He turned his head at the sound of Bastila's voice behind him.»
- Prologue · L103 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution): «"Maybe you should speak to the Jedi Council," Bastila suggested. "They might be able to help."»
- Prologue · L107 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution): «"They owe you," Bastila insisted. "If it weren't for you, Darth Malak would have destroyed the Republic, eliminated the Council, and all but wiped out the Jedi. They owe you everything!"»
- Prologue · L115 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Bastila brought her hand up and put it gently but firmly over Revan's lips.»
- Prologue · L121 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Bastila turned away, and Revan instantly regretted his words. He knew she was ashamed of her involvement in his capture and her role in erasing his memory.»
- Prologue · L141 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Twenty minutes later Bastila was fast asleep, but Revan lay on the bed with his eyes open, staring at the ceiling.»
- Prologue · L143 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «He was thinking about what Bastila had said about the Council taking his identity. As his mind had healed, many of his memories had returned, along with his sense of self. But he knew parts were still missing, possibly gone forever.»
- Ch3 · L635 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Canderous Ordo / Mandalore the Preserver: «"You look like death warmed over," Canderous said by way of greeting. "Is being married to Bastila really that bad?"»
- Ch5 · L973 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «His contrariness might have been overlooked had Bastila not chosen a similar path.»
- Ch5 · L975 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Their marriage further exacerbated the situation. The Jedi Order opposed emotional attachments, believing they were a stepping-stone to destruction. They taught that love begat jealousy, which led to the dark side. But Revan had seen its redemptive powers firsthand. It was his love that had brought Bastila back to the light; their emotional bond had wrought salvation for both of them.»
- Ch5 · L989 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «In the end a compromise was reached. The Jedi would not speak out against his marriage to Bastila. Officially, both would still be recognized as Jedi in good standing, with all corresponding rights and privileges. In exchange, Revan promised not to spread his heresy to other members of the Order.»
- Ch5 · L991 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «At first, Bastila wanted to reject their terms. But Revan convinced her that an ideological war with the Jedi Council served no purpose. They had done their part; it was time for them to fade from history and live out the rest of their days in peace.»
- Ch5 · L1045 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Revan rose from his chair and turned to face the speaker. She wore the traditional robes of a Jedi Archivist, though Revan knew she was in fact a Jedi Master. She was young for the position, about Bastila's age, but her hair was platinum white. She had cold blue eyes, and a pale complexion that spoke of a life spent inside the Archives, well sheltered from the rays of the sun.»
- Ch7 · L1413 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Revan: «"Don't forget Bastila," Revan added.»
- Ch7 · L1429 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Bastila was sitting in the living room when he got home, watching holovids while she waited for him to return. Revan wondered if she'd been waiting long.»
- Ch7 · L1455 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Revan couldn't believe he hadn't noticed Bastila's pregnancy earlier. Though there were no visible physical signs of her condition, it should have been obvious. The instant she'd told him, he'd clearly sensed the life growing inside her through the Force.»
- Ch7 · L1459 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution): «"You've had a lot on your mind," Bastila reminded him. "And you haven't been sleeping much."»
- Ch7 · L1461 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «It was still too early to tell if it was a boy or a girl, but it didn't matter to Revan either way. He and Bastila were going to have a child; it was the happiest day of his life. There was just one small problem.»
- Ch7 · L1463 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution): «"Talk about bad timing," Bastila murmured, echoing his own sentiments.»
- Ch7 · L1469 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution): «"What if you don't find out?" Bastila countered. "Your nightmares are fading. Maybe in a few months they'll stop."»
- Ch7 · L1473 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution): «"Haven't you done enough already?" Bastila asked, her voice rising slightly. "You saved the Republic from the Mandalorians. You saved the Republic from Malak. And in return, you had your identity destroyed and were ostracized by the Council."»
- Ch7 · L1485 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Bastila didn't answer. Instead she leaned against him, resting her head on his shoulder, and he knew she felt the same way.»
- Ch7 · L1491 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE: «Bastila reached two fingers up and pressed them gently against Revan's lips. "If I say you're right," she whispered, "will you please shut up?"»
- Ch7 · L1505 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Bastila accompanied Revan and T3 to the spaceport. Canderous was already there, loading supplies onto the Ebon Hawk.»
- Ch7 · L1511 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution): «"Be careful out there," Bastila said.»
- Ch7 · L1515 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «They didn't need to say anything else; they'd said their true goodbyes in private the previous night. Bastila's years of Jedi training had left her uncomfortable with public displays of emotion, but she stood up on her toes and planted a long, hard kiss on Revan's lips. Then she turned away and quickly left the spaceport.»
- Ch11 · L2361 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «They didn't speak again, but Revan couldn't help noticing the irony. When he'd left his wife behind to come here, he'd never imagined that Canderous would be reuniting with his own. He didn't begrudge Canderous his happiness, but it made him miss Bastila all the more.»
- Ch17 · L3505 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «Bastila tucked her son into bed and leaned down to kiss him on the cheek.»
- Ch17 · L3507 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «She sighed and turned away. Bastila often worried about the effect her son's turbulent childhood would have on him. Growing up without a father was difficult enough, but the first few years of his life had been scarred by war and terror.»
- Ch17 · L3509 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «After Malak had been defeated, Bastila, like most other citizens of the Republic, had hoped to enjoy many decades of peace. Instead, a group of rogue Jedi had broken away from the Order, plunging the galaxy once more into civil war.»
- Ch17 · L3513 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «Had Revan returned to face this new threat, Bastila would have eagerly fought by his side. Together they might have been able to quell the uprising, ending it before the horrors of war enveloped the Republic and millions lost their lives. But she had heard nothing of her husband since he had set off with Canderous four years earlier.»
- Ch17 · L3517 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «And now this woman—hero to some, villain to so many others—was sitting in the living room of Bastila's apartment, patiently waiting for her to finish putting her son to bed.»
- Ch17 · L3519 · POV Bastila · OWN LINE (attribution): «"He's asleep," Bastila said as she returned, speaking softly.»
- Ch17 · L3523 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «Bastila nodded at the compliment.»
- Ch17 · L3523 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «She was taller than Bastila, and almost a decade older, though she would still be considered beautiful by any empirical measure.»
- Ch17 · L3525 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «Foolish as it was, Bastila couldn't help but feel some hint of jealousy.»
- Ch17 · L3525 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «Meetra had known Revan long before Bastila; she had answered his call to go to war against the Mandalorians, and in doing so she became one of his most trusted advisers and closest friends.»
- Ch17 · L3525 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «Bastila knew they had shared a special bond not unlike that of Padawan and Master.»
- Ch17 · L3529 · POV Bastila · OWN LINE (attribution): «"You said we needed to speak," Bastila said.»
- Ch17 · L3533 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «The last time Bastila had seen T3-M4 he had been boarding the Ebon Hawk with Revan and Canderous. Her husband was still missing, but the droid had returned. Clearly he had latched on to Meetra, following at her heel as he had once followed Revan—one more small detail to feed Bastila's irrational jealousy.»
- Ch17 · L3537 · POV Bastila · OWN LINE (action beat): «Bastila smiled faintly. "I gave him special instructions the night before he left with Revan. I told Tee-Three if they ever became separated, he had to come find me. I programmed him so he wouldn't tell anyone else what had happened until I heard it first."»
- Ch17 · L3541 · POV Bastila · OWN LINE (attribution): «"I never imagined I'd be in hiding when he returned," Bastila continued. "I'm sorry about that, Tee-Three. If I'd known you were back, I would have tried to contact you."»
- Ch17 · L3547 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «Bastila bit her lip to keep from saying anything. She knew her feelings of resentment were neither justified nor fair, but even her Jedi training couldn't quell her emotions.»
- Ch17 · L3551 · POV Bastila · OWN LINE (attribution): «"The little guy does have a knack for joining up with galactic saviors," Bastila remarked, trying to keep her voice neutral.»
- Ch17 · L3555 · POV Bastila · OWN LINE (attribution): «"I'm sorry," Bastila said again. "You're right. You've been very patient so far. I'm just not sure I'm ready to hear what you have to tell me."»
- Ch17 · L3563 · POV Bastila · OWN LINE (attribution): «Her words were meant as comfort, but they had the opposite effect. "Maybe this would be easier if Tee-Three and I spoke in private," Bastila said.»
- Ch17 · L3567 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «Bastila grimaced. She'd heard rumors that a Mandalorian had aided the Exile in her battle against Darth Traya.»
- Ch17 · L3569 · POV Bastila · OWN LINE (attribution): «"Is it true?" Bastila asked. "Is Canderous the new Mandalore?"»
- Ch17 · L3573 · POV Bastila · OWN LINE (attribution): «"What else do you know that I don't?" Bastila asked, trying to keep the bitterness out of her voice.»
- Ch17 · L3577 · POV Bastila · DIALOGUE: «Bastila swallowed hard, suddenly ashamed. "You have the same right," she said. "You stood by Revan's side at the beginning; he had no truer friend. Whatever Tee-Three has to say, we should hear it together."»
- Ch17 · L3581 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «Taking a deep breath, Bastila sat down on the living room chair, facing her guests. She folded her hands in her lap, mentally bracing herself for what was to come.»
- Ch17 · L3589 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «When he played the holorecording he'd made of the red-skinned man who'd taken Revan off the ship, Bastila gasped.»
- Ch17 · L3593 · POV Bastila · OWN LINE (attribution): «"The Order is wrong again," Bastila muttered. "Big surprise."»
- Ch17 · L3595 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «T3 let out a low whistle, apologizing for his cowardice, but Bastila shook her head.»
- Ch17 · L3601 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «Mollified, T3 continued his story. He told them how Revan was taken onto a waiting shuttle and whisked away. With his master gone, returning to Bastila became the astromech's primary purpose, as per her last-minute instructions before they'd left Coruscant.»
- Ch17 · L3609 · POV Bastila · OWN LINE (action beat): «Bastila blinked in surprise. "No animals? No insects? Not even any plants? How could the entire population of an entire world just be wiped out?"»
- Ch17 · L3611 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «Meetra shifted uncomfortably in her seat, and Bastila knew she was thinking back to her role in the massacre of Malachor V. She felt a sudden burst of empathy for the other woman. Bastila didn't condone what she had done, but she understood what it was like to be ashamed of acts in your past. She herself had let Malak turn her to the dark side; only the power of Revan's love had redeemed her.»
- Ch17 · L3613 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «Bastila sensed that despite all Meetra had done to stop Darth Traya, she was haunted by guilt and remorse. She was still looking for redemption.»
- Ch17 · L3615 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «Bastila was gone; T3 didn't know where to search for her, or whether she was even alive.»
- Ch17 · L3619 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «The chance encounter was the kind of coincidence that Bastila would have chalked up to the influence of the Force had T3 been an organic being.»
- Ch17 · L3625 · POV Bastila · OWN LINE (action beat): «Bastila shrugged. "When he found out Revan had left, HK decided to go after him. But I refused to tell him where my husband had gone."»
- Ch17 · L3629 · POV Bastila · OWN LINE (attribution): «"HK stormed off, swearing he would track Revan down on his own," Bastila continued. "That was the last I heard of him until he showed up again with you."»
- Ch17 · L3633 · POV Bastila · OWN LINE (alternation): «"What do you mean?"»
- Ch17 · L3637 · POV Bastila · OWN LINE (attribution): «Suddenly worried, Bastila asked, "Is there any chance he'll find him?" She directed her question to T3. "Did you tell him anything about what happened to Revan?"»
- Ch17 · L3641 · POV Bastila · OWN LINE (attribution): «Relieved, Bastila muttered, "Someone should try to track him down. Find and disable him before he hurts anyone else."»
- Ch17 · L3647 · POV Bastila · DIALOGUE: «Bastila nodded. "Tee-Three," she said. "Tell us the rest of your story. What happened next?"»
- Ch17 · L3651 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «After finding the disassembled bits of HK-47, he fell in with Meetra, joining her as he had joined Revan many years before. By the time he learned Bastila was alive, he was once again caught up in a battle for the Republic's survival. Despite his instructions, he knew he couldn't abandon Meetra until the safety of the Republic was secured.»
- Ch17 · L3653 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «His confession caused Bastila to feel another surge of bitterness. T3 had chosen to help Meetra instead of following Bastila's instructions. He'd put the Exile's mission above his loyalty to Revan.»
- Ch17 · L3655 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «The emotion passed quickly, replaced by guilt and shame. Bastila's love for Revan had once again momentarily blinded her to logic and reason. Her husband was one man; it was foolish to value his life against the fate of millions. If Revan had been standing in the room, he would have congratulated the droid for putting the greater good above personal wants and desires.»
- Ch17 · L3661 · POV Bastila · OWN LINE (attribution): «"You?" Bastila said, her voice showing more anger and surprise than she intended. "What about me? You expect me to just sit here and wait, not even knowing if he's alive or dead?"»
- Ch17 · L3665 · POV Bastila · OWN LINE (attribution): «"Of course not!" Bastila spat. She almost added, I'll bring him with me, but at the last second she realized how reckless and ridiculous that would be.»
- Ch17 · L3669 · POV Bastila · OWN LINE (attribution): «"I'm sorry," Bastila whispered. "I didn't mean to—I just—I miss him. I feel so helpless. So useless. All I do is wait. You don't understand how hard it's been."»
- Ch17 · L3673 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «Her words offered little comfort, but Bastila appreciated her honesty.»
- Ch17 · L3679 · POV Bastila · SPEECH BY Meetra Surik (the Exile): «"I would be honored if you came," Meetra told him, "as long as Bastila doesn't object."»
- Ch17 · L3681 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «Bastila wanted T3 to stay with her; his holorecordings and data banks were all she had left of her husband. But she was thinking rationally now.»
- Ch17 · L3687 · POV Bastila · OWN LINE (attribution): «"Please, wait just a moment longer," Bastila said.»
- Ch17 · L3695 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «Meetra glanced at her, silently asking permission to unwrap it. Bastila answered with a subtle nod. Meetra unwound the cloth carefully, revealing a worn and scarred metal helmet with a red-and-gray faceplate.»
- Ch17 · L3699 · POV Bastila · OWN LINE (attribution): «"I led that strike team," Bastila reminded her. "I don't know why, but I took it when Revan fell. Perhaps even then I sensed our fates were intertwined. I never told anyone. Not the Council. Not even him."»
- Ch17 · L3703 · POV Bastila · OWN LINE (action beat): «Bastila hesitated, then decided Meetra deserved to know the truth. "Revan wore the mask during the Mandalorian Wars, and during his time as Darth Revan. To me, it symbolizes his dark past—a relic from a time before he became the man I loved. I was afraid that if I showed it to him, it might trigger something inside his mind. It might awaken some dormant evil, rekindle the spark of the dark side."»
- Ch17 · L3711 · POV Bastila · OWN LINE (attribution): «"I don't care," Bastila said defiantly. "Not if that power helps bring him back to me."»
- Ch18 · L3843 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «Revan had left Bastila behind because he feared the greatest threat to the Republic's survival was lurking in the Unknown Regions. The reemergence of the Sith Empire certainly qualified.»
- Ch19 · L3933 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «In the first few months he had hoped that someone would come for him: Canderous, or T3-M4, or maybe even Bastila, drawn to him by the Force. But as time passed, his drug-addled brain finally realized he was truly alone.»
- Ch19 · L3935 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «He had tried reaching out to Bastila with the Force, but the drugs and the vast distance of an entire galaxy must have stopped her from sensing his need. He had almost given up once he realized there would be no rescue; his situation seemed hopeless. And then his muddled mind seized on the Sith interrogator.»
- Ch19 · L4057 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «For most prisoners this would have been an effective tool, but Revan was able to endure the long periods alone by meditating on the Force. At times like these he would try to reach out to Bastila, hoping at least to let her know he was still alive.»
- Ch24 · L5337 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Meetra Surik (the Exile): «"I have something else," Meetra told him. "Bastila asked me to give it to you."»
- Ch24 · L5343 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE: «"You spoke with Bastila?" he asked. "You saw her?"»
- Ch25 · L5467 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «Meetra remembered what Bastila had said to her when she had given her the mask. She said she had hidden it from Revan for all those years because she feared what it represented. She feared it would change him. Now Meetra understood what she meant.»
- Ch25 · L5471 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «Maybe Bastila was right; maybe Revan needed to become what he once had been to survive this. He had easily bested Darth Nyriss, but the Emperor was a much greater opponent. And yet she couldn't help but feel some small tinge of regret knowing the man Bastila loved might have been swallowed up by the weight of Revan's own past.»
- Ch25 · L5493 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «The droid rolled up beside them, projecting a thirty-centimeter-tall image of Bastila cooing over Revan's three-year-old son.»
- Ch25 · L5495 · POV Meetra · OWN LINE (attribution): «"I don't know if you'll ever see this," Bastila said, adjusting a lock of hair on the boy's head as she spoke to the holorecorder. "But I have to believe you'll return someday. And when you do, I thought you'd want to share your son's birthday."»
- Ch25 · L5499 · POV Meetra · OWN LINE (attribution): «"Wave to Daddy," Bastila said, pointing in the direction of the recorder. "Say, "We miss you!—»
- Ch25 · L5501 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «The boy did as instructed, waving his tiny arm vigorously as he repeated Bastila's words.»
- Ch25 · L5505 · POV Meetra · OWN LINE (attribution): «"I know we didn't discuss names before you left," Bastila said. "But I called him Vaner."»
- Ch25 · L5517 · POV Meetra · DIALOGUE: «As the holovid continued to play, she lingered near the back of the cave. She couldn't help but overhear Bastila say, "I love you, Revan," as the recording came to an end.»
- Ch25 · L5521 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «Meetra shifted her feet uncomfortably at the exchange. She wasn't jealous of Bastila; Meetra loved Revan, but not in that way. She'd never had romantic feelings for her mentor. Rather, she regarded him with deep admiration and intense devotion.»
- Ch25 · L5523 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «At this moment, however, she was acutely aware that Bastila and Revan shared a relationship that went far deeper than what Meetra shared with him. She knew she shouldn't begrudge them that, but some small part of her couldn't help but feel her reunion with Revan had been preempted by a holovid.»
- Ch25 · L5547 · POV Meetra · SPEECH BY Revan: «"Would you like to see the holovid of Bastila and my son?" he asked, offering her his hand. "It would mean more to watch it with a friend at my side."»
- Ch29 · L6207 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «But if he managed to delay him for fifty years, Bastila might never have to experience the horrors of another galactic war. A hundred and his son could live his whole life in an era of peace, never knowing the fear of facing utter annihilation.»
- Epilogue · L6219 · POV Bastila · DIALOGUE: «"Why is your hair all gray?" Reesa, the youngest of Bastila's grandchildren, asked.»
- Epilogue · L6221 · POV Bastila · OWN LINE (attribution): «"Because I'm an old, old woman," Bastila replied.»
- Epilogue · L6227 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «She hustled the kids out of the living room, leaving Bastila alone with her son.»
- Epilogue · L6229 · POV Bastila · OWN LINE (attribution): «"I'm glad you came today," Bastila said. "It means a lot to me."»
- Epilogue · L6237 · POV Bastila · OWN LINE (attribution): «"He'd tell you he was proud of you," Bastila assured him.»
- Epilogue · L6241 · POV Bastila · DIALOGUE: «Bastila shook her head. "You've done too much in your life to have those kinds of regrets," she told him. "The Jedi are guardians and protectors of the galaxy, but these past fifty years we've needed so much more. The Republic had to rebuild. We needed leaders to unite us, to help us work together. You saw that need, and you filled it."»
- Epilogue · L6245 · POV Bastila · OWN LINE (action beat): «Bastila shook her head. "You joke, but if you wanted that post you could have it."»
- Epilogue · L6259 · POV Bastila · OWN LINE (attribution): «"I don't know," Bastila admitted. "If he is, why didn't he come back? On the other hand, there are times when I think I can still sense his presence, like he's reaching out to me from somewhere far away."»
- Epilogue · L6271 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «After a few more minutes of silence he spoke again; it was a question Bastila had expected to hear for many years.»
- Epilogue · L6291 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «Her son headed off to the guest room in the back, and Bastila closed her eyes, quickly drifting into sleep. As always, she dreamed of Revan.»

### Q · T3-M4 (151 entries: 2 own lines, 149 about/mentions)

- Ch3 · L613 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Among such a diverse and interesting group, nobody paid any attention to a lone human and his astromech droid.»
- Ch3 · L615 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Unfortunately, the lack of attention meant that many in the crowd accidentally kicked, bumped, or tripped over T3-M4 as he scooted along at Revan's heel. The droid expressed his displeasure with a steady stream of angry beeps and chirps.»
- Ch3 · L617 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Revan: «"Now you know why I told HK-Forty-seven he couldn't come," Revan told T3. "He'd probably try to clear a path through all these "meatbags" with a flamethrower."»
- Ch3 · L619 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Revan: «The astromech responded with a long, low whistle, and Revan laughed out loud before adding, "Let's not and say we did. Besides, we're almost there."»
- Ch3 · L629 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «T3 beeped in surprise.»
- Ch7 · L1293 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «T3 obediently rolled underneath the table to sit patiently at their feet, safely away from where the waitresses might trip over him.»
- Ch7 · L1299 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «T3 chirped his agreement.»
- Ch7 · L1311 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «The astromech droid at Revan's feet beeped twice. It was obvious even to him that Canderous was hesitant to speak.»
- Ch7 · L1385 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (action beat): «T3 whistled loudly, and Revan reached down to give him a reassuring pat on the head. "Don't worry, little fella. You're too useful to leave behind."»
- Ch7 · L1387 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «The astromech droid whistled again.»
- Ch7 · L1411 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Canderous gave T3 a playful kick with one of his heavy boots. The droid beeped angrily in response.»
- Ch7 · L1505 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Bastila accompanied Revan and T3 to the spaceport. Canderous was already there, loading supplies onto the Ebon Hawk.»
- Ch9 · L1775 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «T3 beeped anxiously at Revan's side, crowding the pilot's chair as Revan fought to keep the ship level.»
- Ch9 · L1779 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «The little astromech droid spun around and sped off in search of the third member of their crew.»
- Ch9 · L1793 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Revan muttered a curse under his breath, just as a much louder string of profanity came from Canderous staggering into the cockpit. T3 rolled in after him, beeping indignantly.»
- Ch9 · L1827 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE: «"See if you can do something to give our sensors a boost," he said to T3.»
- Ch9 · L1829 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «The little astromech chirped with pleasure and extended a small probe from a panel in his side to interface directly with the Hawk's systems.»
- Ch9 · L1831 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «While T3 worked, Revan began a standard search pattern with the original coordinates for the camp at the center.
