Taking the Hawk around in ever-widening circles, he spiraled outward, letting the sensors scan the ground for signs of life. Suddenly T3 began beeping excitedly. Canderous leaned forward to look at the scanner's display.»
- Ch9 · L1835 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution): «Revan knew better than to doubt the little astromech. "Can you enhance the image?" he asked T3.»
- Ch9 · L1837 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «T3 responded with a low whistle, and a second later a static-filled thermal image appeared on the screen. The details were difficult to make out, but it appeared to be a small collection of tents and temporary shelters built against the leeward side of a small mountain of ice and snow.»
- Ch9 · L1839 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Canderous Ordo / Mandalore the Preserver: «"Could be them," Canderous admitted, reaching out one of his massive hands to give T3 a friendly pat on the head. The droid squawked an indignant protest, and he quickly pulled his hand back.»
- Ch9 · L1843 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «The display zoomed out as T3 adjusted the Hawk's scanners to pan rapidly back and forth across the snow. A few seconds later they zoomed in again.»
- Ch9 · L1845 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Revan: «"Perfect," Revan said with a smile. "Nice work, Tee-Three."»
- Ch9 · L1855 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Canderous scrambled to lock in his safety belt as Revan sent the Hawk into its descent. T3 scooted across the cockpit to the metal braces anchored to the floor and locked his wheels in with a metallic thunk.»
- Ch9 · L1861 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Revan carefully unbuckled his safety belt, knowing he would have bruises where the straps had dug into him during the collision. Beside him, Canderous was doing the same. T3 simply unlocked his wheels from the braces and rolled free.»
- Ch9 · L1869 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «While the big Mandalorian gathered the gear and supplies for their trek from the cargo hold, Revan and T3 ran diagnostics on the Hawk to determine the full extent of the damage.»
- Ch9 · L1873 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «T3 beeped twice.»
- Ch9 · L1877 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «The astromech reluctantly whistled his consent.»
- Ch11 · L2205 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE: «Scooting back into the warmth of his sleeping bag, Revan activated the device. "Tee-Three, can you read me?"»
- Ch11 · L2211 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «The astromech's response was an excited whistle, though the volume was slightly lower than before.»
- Ch11 · L2215 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «T3 beeped indignantly.»
- Ch11 · L2219 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «There were roughly thirty seconds of silence on the other end before T3 chirped a reply.»
- Ch11 · L2221 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE: «"Great work, Tee-Three. Remember, keep an eye on the ship. I'll call you if we need anything else."»
- Ch11 · L2223 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Revan turned off the holocomm, knowing the easy part was over. T3 might have been slightly annoyed with him, but dealing with the droid was going to be a whole lot easier than getting the snoring giant beside him up and moving.»
- Ch14 · L3151 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «T3-M4 greeted Revan's return to the Ebon Hawk with a shrill stream of beeps and whistles. The astromech was spinning in place so rapidly that Revan feared he might burn out a circuit.»
- Ch14 · L3155 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «T3 stopped spinning and responded with an inquisitive chirp.»
- Ch14 · L3159 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «T3 beeped twice.»
- Ch15 · L3315 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «T3 was at his side, beeping with concern. Revan blinked away the last of his fugue state and glanced down at the Hawk's sensors to see what had the little droid so upset.»
- Ch15 · L3323 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE: «"Tee-Three!" he shouted, but the astromech had already sprung into action.»
- Ch15 · L3325 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «T3 had connected himself to the cockpit's main control panel with a twenty-centimeter-long slicing tool. Lights on the cockpit dashboard began to flicker and flash as T3 rerouted power from damaged circuits. Through the cockpit window, Revan could see the distant outline of a city far below, the skyscrapers seeming to growing rapidly as the Hawk rushed toward them at terminal velocity.»
- Ch15 · L3327 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Inside the control panel something crackled and popped. Smoke poured into the cockpit. T3 squealed in alarm, but his warning was drowned out by the sound of the Hawk's engines roaring back to life.»
- Ch17 · L3531 · POV Bastila · SPEECH BY Meetra Surik (the Exile): «"I wasn't sure if we should come," Meetra admitted. "I understand this might be difficult for you. But Tee-Three insisted." She reached out and patted the little astromech accompanying her on the head.»
- Ch17 · L3533 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «The last time Bastila had seen T3-M4 he had been boarding the Ebon Hawk with Revan and Canderous. Her husband was still missing, but the droid had returned. Clearly he had latched on to Meetra, following at her heel as he had once followed Revan—one more small detail to feed Bastila's irrational jealousy.»
- Ch17 · L3537 · POV Bastila · SPEECH BY Bastila Shan: «Bastila smiled faintly. "I gave him special instructions the night before he left with Revan. I told Tee-Three if they ever became separated, he had to come find me. I programmed him so he wouldn't tell anyone else what had happened until I heard it first."»
- Ch17 · L3541 · POV Bastila · SPEECH BY Bastila Shan: «"I never imagined I'd be in hiding when he returned," Bastila continued. "I'm sorry about that, Tee-Three. If I'd known you were back, I would have tried to contact you."»
- Ch17 · L3559 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «Still, she believed she would have sensed a disturbance in the Force if he had died. Clinging to that gave her hope. Now, however, her belief might be exposed as a mere illusion if T3 told her that Revan was dead. She wanted to hear the truth, of course, but she was determined to hang on to the fantasy for just a few seconds longer.»
- Ch17 · L3561 · POV Bastila · SPEECH BY Meetra Surik (the Exile): «"Take your time," Meetra said. "I know this is difficult. Tee-Three's waited three years for this; he can wait a little while longer."»
- Ch17 · L3563 · POV Bastila · SPEECH BY Bastila Shan: «Her words were meant as comfort, but they had the opposite effect. "Maybe this would be easier if Tee-Three and I spoke in private," Bastila said.»
- Ch17 · L3577 · POV Bastila · DIALOGUE: «Bastila swallowed hard, suddenly ashamed. "You have the same right," she said. "You stood by Revan's side at the beginning; he had no truer friend. Whatever Tee-Three has to say, we should hear it together."»
- Ch17 · L3585 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «In a series of beeps, chimes, and holorecordings T3 relayed his story. He began with Revan returning to the Ebon Hawk on Rekkiad. He told them how he and Revan had left Canderous behind and journeyed to Nathema alone. He described the unexpected attack on the Ebon Hawk and the near-fatal crash landing on Nathema's surface.»
- Ch17 · L3595 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «T3 let out a low whistle, apologizing for his cowardice, but Bastila shook her head.»
- Ch17 · L3601 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «Mollified, T3 continued his story. He told them how Revan was taken onto a waiting shuttle and whisked away. - Ch17 · L3607 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «T3 chirped out a confirmation.»
- Ch17 · L3615 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «Bastila was gone; T3 didn't know where to search for her, or whether she was even alive.»
- Ch17 · L3617 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «It was during this time that the little astromech droid stumbled across the disassembled pieces of HK-47, abandoned on a remote and nameless world. Recognizing his old companion, the little droid gathered up the pieces and stored them on the Ebon Hawk.»
- Ch17 · L3619 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «The chance encounter was the kind of coincidence that Bastila would have chalked up to the influence of the Force had T3 been an organic being.»
- Ch17 · L3637 · POV Bastila · SPEECH BY Bastila Shan: «Suddenly worried, Bastila asked, "Is there any chance he'll find him?" She directed her question to T3. "Did you tell him anything about what happened to Revan?"»
- Ch17 · L3639 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «T3 responded with a negative buzz that sounded almost offended. Clearly the astromech felt the same reservations about involving the hunter-killer droid as his human counterparts.»
- Ch17 · L3647 · POV Bastila · DIALOGUE: «Bastila nodded. "Tee-Three," she said. "Tell us the rest of your story. What happened next?"»
- Ch17 · L3649 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «The astromech continued his tale.»
- Ch17 · L3653 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «His confession caused Bastila to feel another surge of bitterness. T3 had chosen to help Meetra instead of following Bastila's instructions. He'd put the Exile's mission above his loyalty to Revan.»
- Ch17 · L3677 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «T3 beeped twice.»
- Ch17 · L3681 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «Bastila wanted T3 to stay with her; his holorecordings and data banks were all she had left of her husband. But she was thinking rationally now.»
- Ch17 · L3689 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «Leaving Meetra and T3 to in the living room, she rushed into the bedchamber and opened the wooden chest tucked away in the back of her closet. She grabbed two items, then returned to her waiting guests.»
- Ch18 · L3721 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «Meetra didn't know what to expect as the Ebon Hawk dropped out of hyperspace and began the approach toward Nathema. T3-M4 had told her that the planet was deserted, but the little droid had found no apparent cause of the mass extinction. While exploring the surface on his last visit, he'd run tests that confirmed the environment was free of toxins and radiation; beyond that everything else was speculation.»
- Ch18 · L3729 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «It took her a few seconds to put her finger on it, her mind analyzing the problem even as her hands automatically made the necessary adjustments to bring the ship in for a landing near the coordinates T3 had given her.»
- Ch18 · L3733 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «She glanced over at T3 hovering anxiously near her in the cockpit, but the droid seemed unaffected.»
- Ch18 · L3733 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «His lack of reaction merely reinforced the nature of her own suffering; as a droid, T3 could not sense the Force, and he wouldn't notice if it was suddenly missing.»
- Ch18 · L3739 · POV Meetra · DIALOGUE: «"Come on, Tee-Three," she said, unbuckling herself from the pilot's chair. "Let's take a look around and see what we can find."»
- Ch18 · L3741 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «As she stepped off the shuttle she felt like she had been punched in the gut; she doubled over, and T3 beeped in concern.»
- Ch18 · L3751 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «She stood motionless for several minutes, or maybe it was several hours; time had no meaning here. But the incessant squawking of T3 eventually roused her from her stupor.»
- Ch18 · L3761 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «The lights on T3 blinked rapidly as the astromech quickly scanned his memory circuits. A few seconds later he beeped excitedly and took off down the street.»
- Ch18 · L3773 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «She stepped through, T3 following at her heel. It was dark inside; whatever source had once powered the building had long since fallen into disrepair. Meetra pulled a glow rod from one of the many pockets sewn into the wide fabric belt on her waist and ignited it, illuminating their surroundings with its eerie green glow.»
- Ch18 · L3781 · POV Meetra · DIALOGUE: «"Let's check out the upper floors," she said, and T3 beeped in agreement.»
- Ch18 · L3783 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «For some astromech droids stairs could be a problem, but T3 was remarkably versatile. By locking his wheels to keep from rolling backward, he was able to use his front legs to lever himself up the steps one at a time. It took him a little longer to reach the top of the flight than his human companion, but at least Meetra didn't have to try to carry him.»
- Ch18 · L3793 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «T3 rolled up to the wall. A panel on his body slid open to reveal a long, thin electrical probe, which he extended so that it pierced the security pad. There was a brief pause, then the unmistakable zap of a powerful electrical discharge. The keypad lit up and the door slid open.»
- Ch18 · L3799 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «T3 hustled to oblige, inserting his versatile probe into an interface port so he could slice into the defunct network. As he had done with the door panel, T3 gave the data bank a powerful electric jolt to temporarily reactivate it so he could download the relevant files.»
- Ch18 · L3801 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «The entire process took less than five minutes, but for Meetra it might as well have been an eternity. She had managed to keep busy up until this point, but while waiting idly by for T3 to finish she began to notice the absence of the Force once more.»
- Ch18 · L3809 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «She was just about to tell T3 it was time to go when he beeped triumphantly and retracted the probe.»
- Ch18 · L3819 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «She strapped herself into the pilot's chair and fired up the engines just as T3, who had fallen behind, came racing up the boarding ramp.»
- Ch18 · L3825 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «T3 rolled up beside her and let out a worried whistle.»
- Ch18 · L3835 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «It took longer than Meetra expected for T3 to decipher and translate the files from Nathema into something she could scan with the ship's computer.»
- Ch18 · L3841 · POV Meetra · DIALOGUE: «Because of that, it was impossible to tell if the Sith Empire as described in the records still existed. But given T3"s holorecording of the red-skinned being taking Revan, Meetra was willing to bet it still survived in some form.»
- Ch18 · L3861 · POV Meetra · SPEECH BY Meetra Surik (the Exile): «Meetra discovered this only because of T3"s exceptional slicing skills. The astromech had not only copied and translated all the data from the archives, but also decrypted the pass codes to unlock classified government files, which he had then marked as having top priority to help simplify Meetra's investigations.»
- Ch18 · L3883 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «As she punched the hyperspace coordinates from the research team leader's logbook into the nav computer, T3 came over and chirped inquisitively.»
- Ch19 · L3933 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «In the first few months he had hoped that someone would come for him: Canderous, or T3-M4, or maybe even Bastila, drawn to him by the Force. But as time passed, his drug-addled brain finally realized he was truly alone.»
- Ch20 · L4079 · POV Meetra · DIALOGUE: «"He's here, Tee-Three," she informed her companion, trying to contain her excitement. "I can feel it."»
- Ch20 · L4091 · POV Meetra · DIALOGUE: «"Nobody here knows I'm a Jedi," she reminded her astromech companion just before they descended the boarding ramp. "Let's try to keep it that way."»
- Ch20 · L4217 · POV Meetra · SPEECH BY Meetra Surik (the Exile): «"Wait here, Tee-Three," Meetra said. Her voice was sharp as she fought to contain her outrage at the young man's circumstances. Unfortunately, the slave thought her barely contained anger was directed at him, and he began to tremble.»
- Ch20 · L4219 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «She could see the terror in his eyes, and she could only imagine what punishments he would be subjected to if he offended a guest of the club. But he no doubt faced even worse consequences if he were to violate the rules and let T3 accompany her inside.»
- Ch20 · L4251 · POV Meetra · SPEECH BY Meetra Surik (the Exile): «Meetra wasn't foolish enough to admit she was looking for Revan. Without knowing who had taken him or why, even bringing him up would be too great a risk. Thanks to T3"s holorecording, however, she knew what the Sith who had captured him looked like. Hopefully, if she could find his abductor, he might lead her to Revan.»
- Ch20 · L4261 · POV Meetra · DIALOGUE: «She flicked a switch and it displayed a still image she had copied from T3"s holorecording. The image was carefully cropped to remove all traces of Revan or the Ebon Hawk, leaving only a close-up of the Sith who had taken him.»
- Ch20 · L4325 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «The young man was summoned to the table, and she could feel his fear at being singled out by the woman he thought he had offended earlier. He didn't speak as he led her to the door, where T3 was waiting for them.»
- Ch20 · L4333 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «T3 scurried to keep up, beeping out a question.»
- Ch21 · L4471 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «T3-M4 obviously shared her concerns. The droid twittered nervously as she brought the speeder in for a landing on a patch of bare dirt near the other speeder.»
- Ch21 · L4475 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «She climbed out of the speeder and extended a small cargo ramp so T3 could exit as well. The mouth of the cave loomed before them, black and forbidding.»
- Ch21 · L4477 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «Earlier, she had discussed several dozen strategies with T3, laying out contingency plans for the most common conceivable scenarios. Fortunately their planning had included a potential ambush by enemies hiding under the cover of darkness.»
- Ch21 · L4481 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «T3 beeped uncertainly.»
- Ch21 · L4485 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «T3 didn't reply; she took it as a bad sign that he was suddenly speechless.»
- Ch21 · L4491 · POV Meetra · DIALOGUE: «"Stay close, Tee-Three," she whispered, keeping her voice low so only he could hear her.»
- Ch21 · L4505 · POV Meetra · DIALOGUE: «"Now, Tee-Three!"»
- Ch21 · L4511 · POV Meetra · DIALOGUE: «The four soldiers opened fire. Even blinded by the flash of T3"s lamp, they were disciplined enough to react by unleashing a volley of blaster bolts at the last known location of their target. Unfortunately for them, Meetra's reactions were quicker than theirs.»
- Ch21 · L4521 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «With their attention focused on the Jedi wreaking havoc in their ranks, the soldiers forgot about T3-M4. The droid took full advantage of the situation, rolling forward until he was close enough to unleash a jet of flame from the short nozzle jutting out from the center of his torso.»
- Ch21 · L4525 · POV Meetra · DIALOGUE: «At last, Meetra turned to face the Sith. Now that she had a chance to focus her attention more closely, she recognized him from T3"s holovid. Apparently Lord Scourge had decided to show up after all.»
- Ch21 · L4597 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «Her astromech droid rolled up to stand beside her, squawking loudly.»
- Ch21 · L4599 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE: «"Tee-Three's right. I've already walked into one trap today," the Jedi answered. "I think I've hit my quota."»
- Ch22 · L4809 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «Having T3 running long, nervous circles around her certainly didn't help, but she was afraid if she told him to stay still he might have a meltdown. And she understood the droid's anxiety.»
- Ch22 · L4817 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «The little droid was passing by her on one of his many, many laps when she heard the sound of a speeder approaching. T3 stopped and dimmed his light, casting the cave in shadow once more.»
- Ch22 · L4819 · POV Meetra · SPEECH BY Meetra Surik (the Exile): «"I told you he'd come back," Meetra said. "He's alone," she added before T3 could ask the obvious question.»
- Ch22 · L4825 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «Scourge stepped forward and extended his hand, offering her the disks. She hesitated for only a moment before coming close enough to take them from his grasp. She returned to T3, carefully retracing her steps so as not to turn her back on the red-skinned Sith.»
- Ch22 · L4831 · POV Meetra · DIALOGUE: «"I've never come across a code my friend here couldn't crack," she said, and T3 beeped his agreement.»
- Ch22 · L4839 · POV Meetra · DIALOGUE: «"Work fast, T3," she said. She looked up at Scourge. "We'd be more comfortable if you weren't hovering over us.»
- Ch22 · L4843 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «It only took half that time for T3 to decrypt and verify the authenticity of the data. As promised, it confirmed what the Sith had said—he really was plotting to overthrow the Emperor. However, it wasn't just Scourge. Several members of the Dark Council, the Emperor's circle of handpicked advisers, had joined together in a conspiracy to remove him from the throne.»
- Ch22 · L4855 · POV Meetra · DIALOGUE: «"I'm Meetra. And this is Tee-Three-Em-Four."»
- Ch23 · L4903 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «T3 had doctored the data disks, removing all evidence of Scourge's part in the conspiracy. Scourge would claim that he came forward as soon as he learned of the plot—but there was no guarantee the Emperor would believe him.»
- Ch24 · L5113 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «Scourge had also insisted she wear a slave's shock collar around her neck. It was nonfunctional, of course—she'd had T3 carefully inspect it to make sure—but she still rankled at the idea of adorning herself with a symbol so closely linked to the galaxy's most vile practice.»
- Ch24 · L5115 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «However, as distasteful as it was, she knew Scourge was right. Every slave on Dromund Kaas was forced to wear the collar; without it, no one would believe their story. T3 was accompanying them, as well, similarly equipped with a nonfunctioning restraining bolt.»
- Ch24 · L5129 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «He turned on his heel, dismissing the underling as he continued down the hall with long, quick strides. Meetra and T3 scrambled to keep pace, staying a respectful two steps behind their supposed owner.»
- Ch24 · L5135 · POV Meetra · DIALOGUE: «"I'm not letting you out of my sight," she warned him. "If you meet with her, Tee-Three and I had better go with you."»
- Ch24 · L5145 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «T3 echoed her sentiment with a shrill squawk.»
- Ch24 · L5159 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «Meetra reached up and yanked the slave collar from her neck, hurling it across the floor. T3 mimicked her by popping off his restraining bolt.»
- Ch24 · L5179 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «The entire incident took less than ten seconds; plenty of time for Scourge to lead Meetra and T3 in another direction. But instead of trying to avoid the melee, the Sith had simply held his ground and watched.»
- Ch24 · L5193 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «T3 beeped and Meetra shook her head.»
- Ch24 · L5205 · POV Meetra · SPEECH BY Meetra Surik (the Exile): «"Don't worry," Meetra said confidently. "Tee-Three can slice through any security system."»
- Ch24 · L5317 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Meetra Surik (the Exile): «"He's right," Meetra told him. "Tee-Three's keeping watch at the top of the stairs. Come on."»
- Ch24 · L5365 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «From the stairs, T3 let out a piercing wail, several octaves higher than the incessant alarms.»
- Ch24 · L5373 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «As they scrambled to their feet, T3 let out what could only be described as a shriek of terror. An instant later, the little astromech came tumbling down the stairs and bounced across the floor as if he'd been shot from a cannon. He landed in the corner on his back, his wheels still spinning.»
- Ch24 · L5427 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «Scourge slowly clambered to his feet as Revan helped Meetra up. In the corner, the upended astromech let out a plaintive whistle and awkwardly managed to rock himself back into an upright position.»
- Ch25 · L5461 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «The four of them climbed in, Revan and Meetra helping T3, then headed for the cave where Meetra and Scourge had first met.»
- Ch25 · L5483 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «The three of them went into the cave, T3 using his lamp to illuminate the dark interior.»
- Ch25 · L5485 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «The cave was empty now. While waiting for Scourge to return from his meeting with the Emperor, Meetra and T3 had buried the bodies of the fallen security chief and his soldiers in a bare patch of ground a short hike away from the cave's entrance.»
- Ch25 · L5491 · POV Meetra · DIALOGUE: «"We have something to show you first," she said. "Tee-Three, play the holovid."»
- Ch25 · L5525 · POV Meetra · NARRATION: «T3 beeped inquisitively as the video came to an end.»
- Ch25 · L5557 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «When scourge arrived back at the cave he found Meetra and Revan huddled side by side on the floor, staring at a holovid projected by T3. He caught a glimpse of a young human female and what Scourge assumed was her child, but as he approached the droid quickly cut the recording off.»
- Ch26 · L5681 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «Glancing around the cave he realized the scream must have been confined to his mind; neither Meetra nor Revan had reacted in any way. She was sitting in the same cross-legged pose Revan had often assumed during his time in Nyriss's prison. Revan was kneeling in front of T3-M4, hunched forward as he rewatched the holovid of his wife and son.»
- Ch26 · L5697 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «He pushed himself to his feet and went over to where Revan was sitting. T3 paused the playback of the holovid as he approached, but left the still image of Revan's wife and son hovering in the air.»
- Ch26 · L5781 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Revan: «"Start over from the beginning," Revan told T3, and the astromech obediently restarted the recording.»
- Ch27 · L5793 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «As planned, Revan, Meetra, Scourge, and T3-M4 left the cave at dawn, though dawn on Dromund Kaas was a term with little meaning. The black storm clouds completely blocked out the sun, and the sky was only marginally lighter than it had been during the night.»
- Ch27 · L5807 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Even T3 was strangely subdued, the gravity of their situation weighing as heavily on the astromech as it did on his organic companions.»
- Ch27 · L5821 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «They continued on foot, making their way through the empty streets heading toward the citadel. They didn't encounter a single living soul on their journey; apart from the Emperor's Guard, nobody dared to violate the curfew. And three Force-sensitive individuals and an astromech equipped with top-of-the-line optical and audio sensors had no trouble avoiding the handful of patrols still wandering the streets.»
- Ch27 · L5861 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Alone, probably not. With the combined strength of Meetra, Scourge, and even T3, however, he believed they stood a real chance of victory.»
- Ch27 · L5873 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Revan braced himself for what was to come. They had discussed this part of their plan before leaving the cave. The instant the doors were pushed opened, all four would charge inside. While Revan rushed the Emperor, Meetra and Scourge would hang back and hold off the guards long enough for T3 to close and seal the doors.»
- Ch27 · L5899 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «T3-M4, his electrical circuits instantly processing the situation, reacted by firing off his built-in blaster; the beam struck the soldier square in the chest.»
- Ch27 · L5917 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «T3 had followed him into the throne room, but Meetra and Scourge were still locked in battle with the guards in the hall outside. They were waging a fighting retreat; they had maneuvered themselves so they could back into the throne room while keeping the guards at bay.»
- Ch27 · L5925 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE: «"Seal the doors!" he shouted at T3. Then he turned his attention to the other end of the throne room.»
- Ch27 · L5951 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «While he and Meetra fought the quartet of guards, T3-M4 was busy sealing the doors. The droid was spraying black foam along the edge where the double doors came together. Scourge recognized the foam as a powerful contact adhesive commonly used to repair starships; seconds after being exposed to air it would harden into a substance that could be cut only with a plasma torch.»
- Ch27 · L5955 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Meetra Surik (the Exile): «"Go help Revan!" Meetra shouted to T3 as the astromech finished his task.»
- Ch28 · L6005 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Through the haze of indescribable pain, he saw T3-M4 rushing in to help him. The droid let loose with his flamethrower, bathing the Emperor in fire. At the last instant the Emperor cocooned himself in the Force to save himself from being incinerated, breaking his focus on Revan.»
- Ch28 · L6009 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Almost too weak to move, Revan managed to raise his head just in time to see the Emperor turn on the brave little astromech. A tremor rippled through the air as the Emperor unleashed the full power of the Force against the defenseless droid.»
- Ch28 · L6011 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «T3 never stood a chance. The little droid exploded into a million pieces, internal circuits and external casing obliterated in a single instant.»
- Ch28 · L6031 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «Revan's astromech launched a jet of flame at the Emperor, freeing Revan, who collapsed to the ground. In retaliation, the Emperor disintegrated the offending droid, strode over to where Revan lay, and picked the vanquished Jedi's lightsaber up off the floor.»

### Q · HK-47 (9 entries: 0 own lines, 9 about/mentions)

- Ch3 · L617 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Revan: «"Now you know why I told HK-Forty-seven he couldn't come," Revan told T3. "He'd probably try to clear a path through all these "meatbags" with a flamethrower."»
- Ch7 · L1389 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Revan: «"Good point," Revan replied. "HK's a little too trigger-happy to bring on this mission. Things tend to get bloody when he's around."»
- Ch17 · L3617 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «It was during this time that the little astromech droid stumbled across the disassembled pieces of HK-47, abandoned on a remote and nameless world. Recognizing his old companion, the little droid gathered up the pieces and stored them on the Ebon Hawk.»
- Ch17 · L3625 · POV Bastila · SPEECH BY Bastila Shan: «Bastila shrugged. "When he found out Revan had left, HK decided to go after him. But I refused to tell him where my husband had gone."»
- Ch17 · L3629 · POV Bastila · SPEECH BY Bastila Shan: «"HK stormed off, swearing he would track Revan down on his own," Bastila continued. "That was the last I heard of him until he showed up again with you."»
- Ch17 · L3635 · POV Bastila · SPEECH BY Meetra Surik (the Exile): «"I left HK under the supervision of the new Jedi Council. I didn't think it was safe to have him roaming the galaxy, and I assumed he would be content to stay with the Jedi, awaiting further orders. But he disappeared soon after I left. Now I realize he's probably gone in search of Revan again."»
- Ch17 · L3643 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «There was little conviction behind her words; as dangerous as HK was, he was only one droid. She had more important things on her mind. Her husband was still missing, and for the first time in years, she was on the verge of being able to do something about it.»
- Ch17 · L3645 · POV Bastila · SPEECH BY Meetra Surik (the Exile): «"The Jedi are already searching for HK," Meetra assured her. "Don't worry about him."»
- Ch17 · L3651 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «After finding the disassembled bits of HK-47, he fell in with Meetra, joining her as he had joined Revan many years before. By the time he learned Bastila was alive, he was once again caught up in a battle for the Republic's survival. Despite his instructions, he knew he couldn't abandon Meetra until the safety of the Republic was secured.»

### Q · Canderous Ordo / Mandalore the Preserver (230 entries: 94 own lines, 136 about/mentions)

- Ch3 · L621 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «Scattered among the Rodians, Chevin, and Kubaz were a handful of humans, including the man Revan had come looking for: Canderous Ordo.»
- Ch3 · L625 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «A scantily clad Twi'lek dancer was giving Canderous a private performance as he sipped on a blue-tinged drink. Despite the distraction, he noticed Revan immediately. He raised a meaty hand in a wave and shooed away his entertainment.»
- Ch3 · L635 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"You look like death warmed over," Canderous said by way of greeting. "Is being married to Bastila really that bad?"»
- Ch3 · L637 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Revan · Canderous (pre-mask): «"I'm not getting much sleep lately," Revan admitted. "Bad dreams," he added as Canderous arched an eyebrow. "Besides, you're one to talk. Looks like you haven't shaved in three days."»
- Ch3 · L643 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «Canderous shrugged and raised his glass to his lips. He took a long swig, closed his eyes, and shuddered.»
- Ch3 · L649 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «Revan didn't need to clarify; for Canderous there was only one war that mattered. He and Revan had fought on opposite sides, mortal enemies who knew each other only by reputation long before they joined forces against Malak and became friends.»
- Ch3 · L651 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"Not much to say. We lost. You won," Canderous said with a shrug. "We thought we could conquer the Republic, but instead we ended up a broken people."»
- Ch3 · L659 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «Revan knew that Canderous wasn't referring to the original founder of his people.»
- Ch3 · L661 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"Mandalore felt the Republic was weak," Canderous continued. "Vulnerable. He summoned the warriors of the clans, and we followed him into what we thought would be our greatest conquest."»
- Ch3 · L663 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «There was no need to ask if Canderous or any of his fellow warriors had hesitated. When Mandalore called, the clans answered. While there might be battles and disputes among those seeking to be Mandalore's successor when he fell, once the decision was made there was never any dissent or debate.»
- Ch3 · L665 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"Things were going fine until you came along," Canderous said with a grim smile. "You and your followers turned the entire tide of the war against us. Eventually you killed Mandalore, and everything changed."»
- Ch3 · L667 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «Revan couldn't actually remember any of his battles against the Mandalorians; they were buried in the part of his mind that had been locked away when the Jedi Council turned him against Malak. But he had studied up on his own history enough to fill in the missing details from Canderous's narrative.»
- Ch3 · L675 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «Canderous had spoken of this once during the time they'd spent together stopping Malak.»
- Ch3 · L681 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (action beat) · Canderous (pre-mask): «Canderous tilted his head to the side and squinted one eye. "This have anything to do with those bad dreams you mentioned?"»
- Ch3 · L689 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"Doesn't sound familiar," Canderous said after a few moments of thought. "What do you think it means?"»
- Ch3 · L697 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"It does seem like sort of a strange coincidence," Canderous agreed. "You think you ran across this storm-covered planet in the Unknown Regions?"»
- Ch3 · L701 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (alternation) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"And you think whatever this thing is, it's still out there? And it's still dangerous?"»
- Ch3 · L705 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «Canderous barked out a laugh. "After everything we've been through, this just feels like old times." He looked at Revan. "So what is it you want me to do?"»
- Ch3 · L709 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «There was a long silence while Revan waited for Canderous to reply. He noticed that the Mandalorian's fingers were gripping his glass so hard, they were turning white.»
- Ch3 · L715 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «Canderous took a deep breath and downed the rest of his drink, closing his eyes and shuddering just as he had with the previous gulp.»
- Ch3 · L719 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE · Canderous (pre-mask): «"I knew I could count on you, Canderous."»
- Ch5 · L995 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «That was why he was there now. Canderous was out among his own people, seeing if he could find some connection between the war and a planet shrouded in the darkness of eternal storms. He'd been gone several weeks, and Revan had yet to hear back. But rather than sit around and do nothing, he'd decided to do a little investigation of his own.»
- Ch7 · L1291 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"You couldn't have just contacted me via holocomm?" he asked Canderous as he took a seat.»
- Ch7 · L1301 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"You still having those nightmares?" Canderous asked.»
- Ch7 · L1311 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «The astromech droid at Revan's feet beeped twice. It was obvious even to him that Canderous was hesitant to speak.»
- Ch7 · L1315 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (action beat) · Canderous (pre-mask): «Canderous shifted uncomfortably, then leaned forward to speak in a low whisper. "I probably shouldn't be telling you this, you being a Jedi and all, but I think you have a right to know."»
- Ch7 · L1327 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"I got in contact with some of my people, just like you asked," Canderous said finally. "I found out that dozens of the strongest chiefs are gathering their clans at Rekkiad."»
- Ch7 · L1331 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE · Canderous (pre-mask): «"They're planning another invasion," he guessed, assuming that was why Canderous was worried about the Jedi or the Republic finding out.»
- Ch7 · L1333 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"No, they're not," Canderous assured him. "Not yet, at least. They're searching for Mandalore's Mask. They think you hid it somewhere on Rekkiad."»
- Ch7 · L1335 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «An image flickered through Revan's mind: he and Malak standing on the top of a glacier, surrounded by a swirling blizzard. - Ch7 · L1339 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «Canderous was silent, obviously expecting him to say more. But there wasn't anything he could add. The memory was gone.»
- Ch7 · L1341 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"You know what the Mask means to my people," Canderous said. "Without it we are lost, vagabonds wandering the galaxy without a purpose. Recovering the Mask could be the key to restoring Mandalorian honor—and power."»
- Ch7 · L1345 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"Whoever finds it will be hailed as the new leader of the clans," Canderous continued. "Mandalore will rise again, and the Mandalorians will follow."»
- Ch7 · L1347 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «Revan knew that Canderous was sharing this knowledge with him out of loyalty. He was still a Mandalorian, and he feared for the future of his people.»
- Ch7 · L1351 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «In their disorganized and depleted state, it was unlikely the Mandalorians would be able to resist. - Ch7 · L1355 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"Depends who finds it," Canderous answered candidly. "Some of the clan leaders want nothing more than to avenge our defeat. We were great warriors before we started conquering Republic worlds; it's possible we can restore our honor without violating the treaty terms we agreed to."»
- Ch7 · L1359 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE · Canderous (pre-mask): «It was ironic that Canderous was sharing all this with the architect of the Mandalorians" greatest defeat.»
- Ch7 · L1365 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE · Canderous (pre-mask): «A broad grin spread across Canderous's scarred, square jaw, and he reached across the table and slapped the Jedi on the shoulder. "I knew I could count on you."»
- Ch7 · L1375 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"They would if you asked them to," Canderous noted. "Wouldn't even think twice about it."»
- Ch7 · L1379 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (alternation) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"Okay, scratch the Twi'lek kid. But what about Zaalbar? That Wookiee knows how to handle himself when things get rough."»
- Ch7 · L1383 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (action beat) · Canderous (pre-mask): «Canderous rolled his eyes. "We're getting a little short on bodies here."»
- Ch7 · L1391 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"You realize we're going to a planet overrun with Mandalorians?" Canderous reminded him. "Bloody is probably unavoidable."»
- Ch7 · L1395 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"We're a little short on bodies," Canderous repeated. "What about that other Jedi who helped you during the war? Not Malak. The one they call the Exile."»
- Ch7 · L1399 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (alternation) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"I heard she and the Council had a falling-out."»
- Ch7 · L1403 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"Might be worth tracking her down," Canderous pressed. "She proved herself during the war."»
- Ch7 · L1405 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «Revan wasn't sure how much Canderous knew about Malachor V and the mass-shadow generator.»

- Ch7 · L1431 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «He hadn't told her where he was going, and he hadn't told her about sending Canderous off to investigate the Mandalorians—he just hadn't seen any point in worrying her if there was nothing she could do to help. - Ch7 · L1465 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «Once he'd gotten over the joyful shock of her news, he'd told her about his meeting with Canderous.»
- Ch7 · L1505 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «Bastila accompanied Revan and T3 to the spaceport. Canderous was already there, loading supplies onto the Ebon Hawk.»
- Ch7 · L1517 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «Canderous raised a curious eyebrow but showed enough restraint not to ask why she wasn't coming.»

- Ch9 · L1769 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «Neither Revan nor Canderous thought it was wise to take the Ebon Hawk to the communal landing strip. - Ch9 · L1777 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Revan · Canderous (pre-mask): «"Get Canderous up here," Revan barked. "Tell him to check those grid coordinates again."»
- Ch9 · L1793 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «Revan muttered a curse under his breath, just as a much louder string of profanity came from Canderous staggering into the cockpit. T3 rolled in after him, beeping indignantly.»
- Ch9 · L1795 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"You trying to smash us into gree pulp back there?" Canderous grumbled, plopping down into the copilot's seat. "I thought you knew how to fly this rusted slag-heap."»
- Ch9 · L1799 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"Maybe they moved to another location," Canderous said with a shrug. "Can't have gone too far, though. Not in these conditions. Do a ground scan of the area and they'll probably turn up."»
- Ch9 · L1803 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (action beat) · Canderous (pre-mask): «Canderous glanced over at the warning light. "That why that red light's blinking?"»
- Ch9 · L1811 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (action beat) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"Go down for another look," Canderous advised after a few moments of strained silence. "Clan Ordo's gotta be close by."»
- Ch9 · L1815 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"You're a smart guy," Canderous answered, shifting to get comfortable in his seat. "You'll think of something."»
- Ch9 · L1817 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «There wasn't much point in continuing the argument, so Revan let it drop. Yet he couldn't help but wonder at the recent change he'd noticed in Canderous.»
- Ch9 · L1823 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «To be fair, Revan had no intention of abandoning their quest, either. There was too much at stake to turn back. Which meant Canderous was right: the only real option was to keep looking for Clan Ordo's camp and hope they got lucky.»
- Ch9 · L1831 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «While T3 worked, Revan began a standard search pattern with the original coordinates for the camp at the center. - Ch9 · L1839 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"Could be them," Canderous admitted, reaching out one of his massive hands to give T3 a friendly pat on the head. The droid squawked an indignant protest, and he quickly pulled his hand back.»
- Ch9 · L1847 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"Uh—that's not a landing strip," Canderous cautioned. "It's a giant snowdrift."»
- Ch9 · L1851 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (alternation) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"You really think this'll work?"»

- Ch9 · L1861 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «Revan carefully unbuckled his safety belt, knowing he would have bruises where the straps had dug into him during the collision. Beside him, Canderous was doing the same. T3 simply unlocked his wheels from the braces and rolled free.»
- Ch9 · L1863 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (action beat) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"I guess sometimes it's not so bad being a droid," Canderous groaned as he stood up, rubbing his right shoulder with his left hand.»
- Ch9 · L1867 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «Canderous only grunted in reply.»
- Ch9 · L1879 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE · Canderous (pre-mask): «"You get started on repairs; I'll go give Canderous a hand."»
- Ch9 · L1883 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «Canderous had armed himself with a heavy repeating blaster carbine. He offered a similar weapon to Revan, but the Jedi shook his head.»

- Ch9 · L1889 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"Suit yourself," Canderous said with a shrug. Then he added, "When we get to the camp, let me do the talking. Remember: these are my people."»
- Ch9 · L1893 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «The swirling snow almost blinded them, but Revan had entered the camp's coordinates on a portable locater to keep them on track, and he used hand gestures to communicate their route to Canderous.»
- Ch9 · L1895 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «He signaled to Canderous, indicating that the camp was on the other side.»

- Ch9 · L1913 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «Out of the corner of his eye, the Jedi could see that Canderous was holding his ground, careful to avoid any sudden movement but not making any effort to obey the order. Revan decided the smart thing to do would be to follow his lead.»
- Ch9 · L1915 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE · Canderous (pre-mask): «"My name is Canderous of Clan Ordo," the big man shouted. "And I don't lay down my weapons for anyone!"»

- Ch9 · L1921 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"Well, Edric," Canderous replied, "I could punch you in the face until I straightened out that crooked beak of yours, but we'd probably all freeze to death before I finished."»
- Ch9 · L1923 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE · Canderous (pre-mask): «The sentry barked out a laugh, slung his gun over his shoulder, threw his arms wide, and ran to enclose Canderous in a fierce hug. "It's good to see you again, brother!" he shouted.»

- Ch9 · L1927 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «After a few minutes the one Canderous had called Edric spoke up again.»

- Ch9 · L1947 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «Unlike everyone else they had come across, she didn't rush over to greet Canderous. Instead, she glared at him without saying a word.»

- Ch9 · L1963 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"Is that any way to greet a clan-brother?" Canderous asked.»

- Ch9 · L2003 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE · Canderous (pre-mask): «There was another round of stifled laughter. Veela pretended not to hear it as she turned back to Canderous. "Welcome home, brother," she said flatly.»

- Ch11 · L2297 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE · Canderous (pre-mask): «Veela didn't say anything at first. Instead she turned and fixed her gaze on Canderous. "Avner is your friend," she said, her words almost an accusation. "Can we trust him?"»
- Ch11 · L2299 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"I wouldn't have told him of our search if I didn't trust him with my life," Canderous answered without hesitation. "And I wouldn't have brought him if I didn't believe he could help us."»

- Ch11 · L2411 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"Welcome to the party!" Canderous shouted to Revan. "Got any bright ideas?"»
- Ch11 · L2421 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «Revan nudged Canderous with his elbow, drawing the big man's attention as he dropped the blaster from his hand and moved his open palm to cover the lightsaber hilt under his belt. Canderous responded with a faint nod.»
- Ch11 · L2451 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «He looked around for Canderous and found him perched atop one of the Basilisks, screaming out a Mandalorian war cry as he arced back and forth across the field, butchering his enemies.»
- Ch11 · L2453 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «His thoughts were interrupted when a great shadow passed over him, followed a second later by the heavy thud as Canderous brought his Basilisk in for a landing a few meters away.»
- Ch11 · L2463 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"No," Canderous said.»
- Ch11 · L2467 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (action beat) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"They fled the battle." Canderous grinned. "It's our territory now." His grin grew wider. "Felt good to fly into battle again."»
- Ch11 · L2471 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (alternation) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"Belongs to a young man named Grizzer. He still hasn't been tested in battle, so Veela told me I could use it if we ran into any trouble."»
- Ch11 · L2475 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (alternation) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"The other night."»
- Ch11 · L2479 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «Canderous shrugged.»
- Ch11 · L2487 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"Guess we're going to find out," Canderous said as Veela's Basilisk swooped in to land beside them.»
- Ch13 · L2737 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «He wasn't sure if Veela had ordered them to stay silent out of respect for what he had done during the battle, or because she thought they still needed him to find Mandalore's Mask, or even because of her feelings for Canderous. But whatever the explanation, his secret seemed safe—for now.»
- Ch13 · L2739 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «When he finally climbed into bed late that night he was surprised to hear Canderous come stumbling into the tent a few minutes later.»
- Ch13 · L2743 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"She's not too happy with me right now," Canderous explained. "I'll let her cool down for the night."»
- Ch13 · L2751 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"Veela doesn't like Jedi," Canderous admitted. "But she's hard to read. Hopefully she'll just hold a grudge for a few days." The big man rolled over onto his side. "Either that, or she'll try to kill us on tomorrow's climb."»
- Ch13 · L2763 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"Bad conditions for an ascent," Canderous remarked as they stood at the base of the first Spear.»
- Ch13 · L2767 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"The old man would probably have a heart attack halfway up," Canderous answered with a grin.»
- Ch13 · L2771 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (alternation) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"But I'm like a fine wine," he replied. "I get better with age."»
- Ch13 · L2773 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «The playful exchange eased some of Revan's concerns about the mission, though he still wasn't thrilled by the makeup of the climbing team. There were eight of them in total: Revan, Canderous, Veela, and the five other Basilisk riders, including Grizzer—the young man who'd given up his mount to Canderous.»
- Ch13 · L2777 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «Yet Revan couldn't help noticing that all of the climbers chosen knew he was a Jedi. And Edric, Canderous's oldest and most loyal friend, was being left behind. He wished he'd had a chance to talk to Canderous before they had left. Now all he could do was keep his guard up throughout the ascent, just in case.»
- Ch13 · L2779 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «They broke into two teams of four, the members of each team connected by a long length of climbing rope. Canderous, Revan, and two of the pilots made up the first group, Veela and the other three pilots the second. In addition to their winter clothing and gear, each climber had a twenty-kilo pack of supplies and rations strapped across his or her shoulders.»
- Ch13 · L2805 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «Two hours later Revan's team reached the top. Canderous was first; planting his feet firmly, he reached down to grab Revan's arm and haul him up. Revan did the same for the woman trailing behind him, and she did the same for the man behind her.»
- Ch13 · L2809 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"Now what?" Canderous shouted over the roar of the wind.»
- Ch13 · L2813 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (alternation) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"An entrance to what?"»
- Ch13 · L2821 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"You stay here and wait for Veela," Canderous ordered the other two Mandalorians. "We'll go down and check it out."»
- Ch13 · L2829 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «Canderous walked over to the hatch and dropped one of the glow sticks into it. It tumbled down, illuminating the length of the shaft as it fell. It stopped some thirty meters below, bouncing, rolling, and then settling on the ground.»
- Ch13 · L2831 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"After you," Canderous said.»
- Ch13 · L2835 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «He had an overwhelming sense of d?j? vu; he knew with certainty he and Malak had explored the dark chamber beneath the ice just as he and Canderous were exploring it now.»
- Ch13 · L2839 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"You okay?" Canderous asked from a few meters above. His voice echoed loudly off the rough-hewn rock walls.»
- Ch13 · L2843 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «He waited a few more seconds, and when he opened his eyes again everything had returned to normal. Taking a deep breath, he continued downward until he reached the bottom. The shaft ended in a tight, twisting tunnel that continued horizontally. Resisting the urge to draw his lightsaber, Revan pulled out another glow stick and started down the passage. Canderous followed close behind.»
- Ch13 · L2845 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «The tunnel was narrow, forcing them to walk single-file, but the ceiling was high enough that even Canderous didn't have to duck. It didn't take long for Revan to realize that they were walking on a slight decline, going ever deeper into the heart of the Spear. The air around them grew warmer, causing them to unbutton their jackets and lower their hoods.»
- Ch13 · L2851 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"What is this place?" Canderous whispered.»
- Ch13 · L2855 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (alternation) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"Why would they bury him here in this frozen wasteland?"»
- Ch13 · L2883 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"What?" Canderous asked anxiously. "What do you remember?"»
- Ch13 · L2909 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «The memory ended, rudely snapping Revan back to the present. He lifted the Mask and held it aloft so Canderous could see.»
- Ch13 · L2919 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"Veela!" Canderous demanded. "What do you think you're doing?"»
- Ch13 · L2925 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"Avner fought beside us," Canderous protested. "He led us to Mandalore's Mask. And you repay him with betrayal?"»
- Ch13 · L2929 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"When did you figure it out?" Canderous asked, not bothering to deny the truth.»
- Ch13 · L2933 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"This isn't about him," Canderous said. "It's about me, isn't it?"»
- Ch13 · L2937 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"I'm not here to claim the Mask for myself," Canderous assured her. "You're the rightful leader of Clan Ordo. I'm not here to challenge you."»
- Ch13 · L2941 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"I'm sorry," Canderous said softly. "When our clan fell apart, I was lost. I had to get away. I didn't know what else to do."»
- Ch13 · L2945 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"Cin vhetin," Canderous said. "I can't undo the past. But I'm here now."»
- Ch13 · L2949 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"You didn't tell them because you're afraid they would agree with me," Canderous countered. "Revan is not our enemy. Not now. Without him, Clan Jendri would have slaughtered us. Without him, we would never have found Mandalore's Mask. Revan has proved himself to be our brother; and what you are doing brings dishonor on our clan!"»
- Ch13 · L2953 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (alternation) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"There's only one way to be sure. We let the whole clan decide."»
- Ch13 · L2957 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"You know Revan's reputation," Canderous warned. "And mine. There may be six of you, but do you really think you have a chance against us both?"»
- Ch13 · L2961 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (alternation) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"And you expect me to stand by and do nothing?"»
- Ch13 · L2965 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"It doesn't have to be this way," Canderous said evenly. "Lower your weapons. End this madness. We'll take Mandalore's Mask back down to the camp together."»
- Ch13 · L2967 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Veela · Canderous (pre-mask): «"This is your last chance, Canderous," Veela said. "Choose!"»
- Ch13 · L2977 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"Veela," Canderous pleaded, "please don't do this."»
- Ch13 · L2983 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «One of the deflected bolts struck its mark, taking down the woman on Veela's left. Canderous and Revan dived for cover behind the sarcophagus just as the other Mandalorians opened fire. Canderous popped up briefly to fire, sending the Mandalorians breaking for cover. There were precious few places to hide in the open chamber, however, and Canderous took two of them down before they made it to safety.»
- Ch13 · L2989 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «The explosion was deafening, though; the concussive force strong enough to knock both Canderous and Revan off their feet. As Revan struggled to stand up, the only sound he could hear was a high-pitched ringing in his ears.»
- Ch13 · L2993 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «From the corner of his eye he saw Canderous lying on his stomach, arms stretched out in front of him to brace his pistol on the floor as he took careful aim. An instant later, Veela went down from a clean kill shot through her heart.»
- Ch13 · L2997 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «Revan adeptly caught his lightsaber by its hilt as it returned to his hand, then slowly stood up straight, his ears still ringing. Nearby, Canderous still lay on the floor, frozen in the same position he had been in moments earlier. Slowly, Revan approached him, trying to see if he was injured.»
- Ch13 · L2999 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «The big man didn't move until Revan reached down and placed a hand on his shoulder. Then Canderous snapped his head around in surprise. He mouthed something, but Revan couldn't hear what he was saying, so he only shrugged in response.»
- Ch13 · L3001 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «Canderous pushed himself up off his stomach and onto his feet, leaving his pistol on the ground. He walked over to where Veela lay facedown on the floor and rolled her over.»
- Ch13 · L3007 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE · Canderous (pre-mask): «"I'm sorry." His voice sounded strange to him. His hearing was still distorted by the grenade, and he wasn't sure if Canderous had heard him. "I'm sorry," he repeated, this time more loudly.»
- Ch13 · L3009 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE · Canderous (pre-mask): «Canderous turned his head to look at him. "Me, too," he answered before turning to stare back at the wall, his words hollow and flat. "Me, too."»
- Ch14 · L3017 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «Canderous continued to stare at the cavern wall while Revan stood by in respectful silence. Eventually he turned back to Revan and said, "We shouldn't just leave them lying here like this. It's disrespectful."»
- Ch14 · L3021 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «Together the two men gathered them up one by one and lay them down side by side in the center of the room. As he had done with Veela, Canderous closed their eyes and crossed their hands over their chests.»
- Ch14 · L3025 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"What am I going to tell the others?" Canderous wondered once they were done arranging the bodies.»
- Ch14 · L3027 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «Revan understood his dilemma. There would be a lot of questions when they returned alone with Mandalore's Mask, and Canderous didn't want to bring shame onto Veela's name.»
- Ch14 · L3031 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «Canderous nodded, then slowly walked over to the sarcophagus. He took out Mandalore's Mask, then, almost as an afterthought, picked up the datacron.»
- Ch14 · L3043 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «Revan knew Canderous was hoping there would be something in the history that would help him understand why Veela had turned on him. - Ch14 · L3047 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"So it has nothing to do with Mandalore or his Mask?" Canderous asked, shaking his head. "You just decided to hide it here, too?"»
- Ch14 · L3051 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «Canderous had a right to know the truth, but first Revan had to put all the pieces back together for himself. Coming to the underground burial chamber had triggered the return of a host of lost memories. They had come to him in disconnected scraps and momentary flashes of insight. He needed time to process the information—to sort it into something that made some kind of sense.»
- Ch14 · L3055 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE · Canderous (pre-mask): «Canderous studied Revan's face, seemed about to say something, but then nodded. "Let's get some rest," he suggested. "We can't make it back down the mountain tonight, anyway. We can talk in the morning."»
- Ch14 · L3059 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «Neither man slept well. Revan could hear Canderous tossing and turning. Once Revan thought he heard him whisper Veela's name.»
- Ch14 · L3067 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «Canderous was already up, pacing slowly back and forth from one side of the chamber to the other, staring at the Mask he held in his hands.»
- Ch14 · L3085 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"Mandalore the Ultimate wouldn't lead us into war against the Republic just because some stranger told him we'd win," Canderous protested.»
- Ch14 · L3089 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"This doesn't make any sense," Canderous said. "You say the Sith tricked Mandalore into attacking the Republic. But why?"»
- Ch14 · L3093 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (alternation) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"But you don't know for sure?"»
- Ch14 · L3097 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (alternation) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"Nathema?"»
- Ch14 · L3101 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"Is Nathema the world you keep dreaming about? The one covered in storms and darkness?" Canderous asked.»
- Ch14 · L3117 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"You don't think going to Nathema again is a little risky?" Canderous asked.»
- Ch14 · L3121 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (alternation) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"What if the same thing happens again?"»
- Ch14 · L3125 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (alternation) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"Do you think that's going to make a difference?"»
- Ch14 · L3129 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (alternation) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"So when do we leave?"»
- Ch14 · L3133 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"You need my help," Canderous insisted. "I turned my back on Veela when she needed me. I'm not going to make the same mistake with you."»
- Ch14 · L3137 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution) · Canderous (pre-mask): «"If the Sith are planning another invasion of the Republic, they'd have to come through Mandalorian space first," Canderous muttered. "Maybe they were trying to get us out of the way."»
- Ch14 · L3139 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Revan · Canderous (pre-mask): «"Maybe. Or maybe they wanted to twist your culture and beliefs in the hope you'd join them. Many of the Mandalorians are bitter, and hungry for revenge. Without a new Mandalore, how hard would it be for someone to manipulate them into going to war again?" Revan frowned. "Your people have lost their way, Canderous. You need to help them find it again. The fate of the galaxy could depend on it."»
- Ch14 · L3141 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Canderous (pre-mask): «Canderous stared at Revan, and then down at the Mask in his hands. He stood stock-still for a moment. Then, slowly, he raised the Mask and slipped it over his head.»
- Ch14 · L3143 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE · Mandalore the Preserver: «"Mandalore has returned," he declared. "I am Mandalore the Preserver, and I will restore the honor and glory of my people!"»
- Ch14 · L3157 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Revan · Mandalore the Preserver: «"Canderous is staying here," Revan explained. "These are his people. This is where he belongs."»
- Ch17 · L3513 · POV Bastila · NARRATION · Mandalore the Preserver: «Had Revan returned to face this new threat, Bastila would have eagerly fought by his side. Together they might have been able to quell the uprising, ending it before the horrors of war enveloped the Republic and millions lost their lives. But she had heard nothing of her husband since he had set off with Canderous four years earlier.»
- Ch17 · L3533 · POV Bastila · NARRATION · Mandalore the Preserver: «The last time Bastila had seen T3-M4 he had been boarding the Ebon Hawk with Revan and Canderous. Her husband was still missing, but the droid had returned. Clearly he had latched on to Meetra, following at her heel as he had once followed Revan—one more small detail to feed Bastila's irrational jealousy.»
- Ch17 · L3565 · POV Bastila · DIALOGUE · Mandalore the Preserver: «It was clear the request had caught Meetra off guard, but she quickly regained her composure. "I understand you want to be cautious," she said sympathetically, "but Canderous told me all about Revan and his search for the storm-covered world."»
- Ch17 · L3569 · POV Bastila · SPEECH BY Bastila Shan · Mandalore the Preserver: «"Is it true?" Bastila asked. "Is Canderous the new Mandalore?"»
- Ch17 · L3585 · POV Bastila · NARRATION · Mandalore the Preserver: «In a series of beeps, chimes, and holorecordings T3 relayed his story. He began with Revan returning to the Ebon Hawk on Rekkiad. - Ch17 · L3627 · POV Bastila · SPEECH BY Meetra Surik (the Exile) · Mandalore the Preserver: «"A wise move," Meetra said. "The last thing Revan needed while helping Canderous and the Mandalorians was a homicidal droid following him around."»
- Ch18 · L3845 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · Mandalore the Preserver: «The theory also fit with what Canderous had told her. - Ch19 · L3933 · POV Revan · NARRATION · Mandalore the Preserver: «In the first few months he had hoped that someone would come for him: Canderous, or T3-M4, or maybe even Bastila, drawn to him by the Force. But as time passed, his drug-addled brain finally realized he was truly alone.»
- Ch20 · L4075 · POV Meetra · NARRATION · Mandalore the Preserver: «She knew the storm-ravaged world had to be the world Canderous had spoken of; the one Revan had seen in his dreams. ### Q · Mandalore the Ultimate (26 entries: 0 own lines, 26 about/mentions)

- Ch3 · L657 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE: «"It was Mandalore's idea."»
- Ch3 · L659 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «For centuries, each successive leader of the Mandalorian clans had symbolically taken up the name of Mandalore as a way to simultaneously honor his cultural heritage and reinforce his own authority.»
- Ch3 · L659 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «To distinguish among rulers, each chose an honorific to define his or her reign, such as Mandalore the Conqueror or Mandalore the Indomitable.»
- Ch3 · L659 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «The most recent ruler had called himself Mandalore the Ultimate.»
- Ch3 · L661 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Canderous Ordo / Mandalore the Preserver: «"Mandalore felt the Republic was weak," Canderous continued. "Vulnerable. He summoned the warriors of the clans, and we followed him into what we thought would be our greatest conquest."»
- Ch3 · L663 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «There was no need to ask if Canderous or any of his fellow warriors had hesitated. When Mandalore called, the clans answered. While there might be battles and disputes among those seeking to be Mandalore's successor when he fell, once the decision was made there was never any dissent or debate.»
- Ch3 · L665 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Canderous Ordo / Mandalore the Preserver: «"Things were going fine until you came along," Canderous said with a grim smile. "You and your followers turned the entire tide of the war against us. Eventually you killed Mandalore, and everything changed."»
- Ch3 · L669 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «In battle after battle, Revan had led the Jedi and Republic forces to victory. Realizing defeat was inevitable, Mandalore the Ultimate had challenged Revan to single combat, and Revan had accepted.»
- Ch3 · L671 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «In Mandalorian culture, the death of one leader was merely an opportunity for another warrior to seize control of the clans by claiming the fallen Mandalore's helmet.»
- Ch3 · L673 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Denied the sole item recognized as the symbol of leadership, the Mandalorians could not choose a new Mandalore.»
- Ch3 · L675 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «He blamed Mandalore for not being strong enough to win their battle; he blamed the brothers and sisters of his clan for being too weak to pick up the pieces so they could rebuild their society.»
- Ch3 · L679 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE: «"Is there anything else you can tell me? About what happened before Mandalore declared war on the Republic? Anything unusual that might have been a catalyst for the war?"»
- Ch3 · L695 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Revan: «"Think about it," Revan explained. "Mandalore the Ultimate decides to do something none of his predecessors even considered: launch an all-out war on the Republic. Malak and I defeat you. But after that, we mysteriously take our troops and disappear into the Unknown Regions beyond Mandalorian space. When we return, we decide to launch a war against the Republic, too."»
- Ch3 · L699 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Revan: «"I'm not sure. But something happened to us out there. Something made us turn against the Republic. Maybe it's connected to Mandalore's decision to attack the Republic in the first place."»
- Ch3 · L707 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE: «"I want to know more about Mandalore the Ultimate. But nobody's going to talk to an outsider like me. I need someone who can talk to the clans and get answers."»
- Ch5 · L1009 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Revan had defeated Mandalore shortly after Meetra's victory at Malachor V, effectively ending the war. Then he and Malak had set off into the Unknown Regions, while Meetra had returned to face the judgment of the Jedi Council. She hadn't spoken to Revan since; he didn't even know where she was.»
- Ch5 · L1025 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Revan split his fleet in two, giving command of one half to Meetra. While he led his forces against Mandalore's flagship, he ordered his most trusted general to use her fleet as bait to lure the bulk of the Mandalorian ships within range of the mass-shadow generator.»
- Ch7 · L1343 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «That was why he had hidden the Mask after slaying Mandalore the Ultimate—a final act to demoralize a defeated foe.»
- Ch7 · L1345 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Canderous Ordo / Mandalore the Preserver: «"Whoever finds it will be hailed as the new leader of the clans," Canderous continued. "Mandalore will rise again, and the Mandalorians will follow."»
- Ch11 · L2285 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE: «On that day the new Mandalore will call upon the armies of our people, and we will answer!"»
- Ch11 · L2451 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «If Mandalore ever rose again and called them to fight alongside Clan Ordo, they would answer without hesitation.»
- Ch13 · L2863 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE: «"You mean someone like Mandalore?"»
- Ch13 · L2867 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Mandalore the Ultimate lay dying at his feet. Coughing on the blood welling up in his lungs, he reached up and peeled off his Mask, the most sacred symbol of his people.»
- Ch13 · L2897 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Darth Malak: «"So Mandalore was telling the truth," Malak said.»
- Ch13 · L2939 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Veela: «"You still don't get it," Veela said, shaking her head. "You should be our leader, not me! You were our greatest warrior. You were our champion. Our hero. When Mandalore fell, you should have been the one to take his place!" She looked at him sadly. "Instead, you abandoned us. You abandoned me."»
- Ch14 · L3085 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Canderous Ordo / Mandalore the Preserver: «"Mandalore the Ultimate wouldn't lead us into war against the Republic just because some stranger told him we'd win," Canderous protested.»

### Q · Darth Nyriss (316 entries: 72 own lines, 244 about/mentions)

- Ch1 · L185 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «More important, he was here at the personal request of Darth Nyriss, one of the most senior members of the Emperor's Dark Council.»
- Ch1 · L197 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «But never before had he encountered one of his own kind with as feeble an attunement to the Force as the man huddled at his feet. The fact that Darth Nyriss had sent someone so vile and unworthy to greet him was unsettling. He'd expected a more substantial and impressive welcome.»
- Ch1 · L201 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE: «Sechel quickly scrambled to his feet. "Darth Nyriss sends her apologies for not coming to meet you personally," he said quickly. "There have been several attempts on her life recently, and she only leaves her palace under the rarest of circumstances."»
- Ch1 · L237 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Sechel: «"If that is your wish, my lord," Sechel said. "However, I must remind you that Darth Nyriss is expecting you."»
- Ch1 · L241 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «Like every member of the Dark Council, Darth Nyriss was allowed access to the Emperor's citadel.»
- Ch1 · L243 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «This didn't strike Scourge as cowardly in any way; Nyriss was simply being practical. Like any high-ranking Sith, she had many enemies. Until she discovered who was behind the assassination attempts, exposing herself unnecessarily was a foolish and unwarranted risk.»
- Ch1 · L245 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «If Nyriss appeared weak or ineffective—if she was unable to take firm and decisive action against whoever was plotting her death—others would sense it.»
- Ch1 · L245 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «Darth Nyriss would not be the first of the Emperor's inner circle to lose her life.»
- Ch1 · L249 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «Given the importance of his mission, he couldn't understand why Nyriss hadn't sent a full honor guard to escort him through the city.»
- Ch1 · L255 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «The east end was open to the street; the west was bordered by what Scourge assumed was Darth Nyriss's stronghold.»
- Ch1 · L255 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «Like his citadel, this building would serve both as Nyriss's dwelling and as a fortress she could fall back to in times of trouble, and it had been designed to be simultaneously ornate, imposing, and easily defensible.»
- Ch1 · L257 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «The woman had her hood thrown back to reveal fierce Sith features; if the sculptor's work was accurate, Scourge knew this was his first glimpse of what Darth Nyriss actually looked like.»
- Ch1 · L259 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «The other statues were abstract pieces, though each incorporated Nyriss's household emblem—a four-pointed star inside a wide circle.»
- Ch1 · L267 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «A flickering image materialized on the holoscreen—a human male of about forty. He appeared to be wearing the standard uniform of an Imperial security officer, and Scourge surmised he was the head of Nyriss's personal guard.»
- Ch1 · L289 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE: «"You dare insult me by making me wait out in the rain like some beggar?" he spat at the screen. "I am a guest! Darth Nyriss herself invited me!"»
- Ch1 · L297 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Lord Scourge: «Scourge cut him off. "What did he mean when he told me to check my facts? Was I invited by Darth Nyriss, or not?"»
- Ch1 · L307 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE: «"It wasn't Darth Nyriss's idea to hire you," he explained, his voice still raw and rough from the choking. "After the second assassination attempt, the Emperor suggested that her own people could be involved. He suggested she bring someone in from the outside."»
- Ch1 · L309 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE: «Darth Nyriss had invited him here because she'd had no choice.»
- Ch1 · L309 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE: «That was why he'd received such a meager reception, and why Nyriss's security chief had reacted to him with such hostility.»
- Ch1 · L363 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «Turning, Scourge saw half a dozen guards standing in the courtyard near the door leading into the stronghold. Among them was a human wearing a commander's uniform. He was short, broad-shouldered, and barrel-chested, with close-cropped blond hair and a neatly trimmed blond beard that contrasted sharply with his dark brown skin. Scourge recognized him from the holo: Murtog, Darth Nyriss's head of security.»
- Ch1 · L373 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE: «Satisfied, the security chief slung his weapon over his shoulder and nodded in Scourge's direction. "Darth Nyriss will see you now."»
