- Ch5 · L985 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «The Council was stuck in the old ways.»
- Ch5 · L985 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Yet he had been unprepared for the sheer hostility of the Council's reaction.»
- Ch5 · L987 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Not only did they reject his offer, but a handful of Councilors had wanted to banish him from the Order.»
- Ch5 · L987 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «The wiser members of the Council understood that the legend of Revan was far too valuable to throw away simply because they no longer had any use for the man himself.»
- Ch5 · L991 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «At first, Bastila wanted to reject their terms. But Revan convinced her that an ideological war with the Jedi Council served no purpose. They had done their part; it was time for them to fade from history and live out the rest of their days in peace.»
- Ch5 · L997 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «This tower was home to the Council of First Knowledge, a collection of five Jedi Masters and their underlings who specialized in the history and lore of the entire Order.»
- Ch5 · L1009 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Revan had defeated Mandalore shortly after Meetra's victory at Malachor V, effectively ending the war. Then he and Malak had set off into the Unknown Regions, while Meetra had returned to face the judgment of the Jedi Council. She hadn't spoken to Revan since; he didn't even know where she was.»
- Ch5 · L1011 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «He knew some of the details of what had happened. On her return, the Jedi Council had declared her a traitor for following Revan. They had stripped her of her rank and banished her, branding her as the Exile. According to the rumors, she had left Republic space and simply disappeared. Yet Revan felt there was more to the story.»
- Ch5 · L1039 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «All he could glean was that she had returned of her own free will to face the Council, which summarily banished her from the Jedi Order and Republic space.»
- Ch5 · L1047 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Revan: «"Atris," Revan said with a nod and a forced smile, silently cursing.»
- Ch5 · L1049 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Once a close friend of Meetra's, Atris had refused to join those who had gone to battle the Mandalorians. A staunch traditionalist, she had shared the unfavorable opinion of Revan common to the older, more conservative Masters. Of all the people who could have interrupted his search, he could think of few he wanted to encounter less.»
- Ch5 · L1053 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Atris must have tagged the report he'd been reading so it would alert her whenever it was referenced. There were no rules or regulations against this kind of security feature, but it was rarely done. As a rule, those who served the Council of First Knowledge respected the right to personal privacy of Jedi visiting the Temple Archives.»
- Ch5 · L1059 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «He saw Atris bristle and he knew he'd guessed right: not only had she tagged the report, she'd also prepared it.»
- Ch5 · L1063 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Revan smiled. Despite all the Jedi teachings about peace and serenity, he'd always had a knack for riling up overly sanctimonious members of the Order like Atris.»
- Ch5 · L1071 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE: «"What more is there to tell? She made the mistake of following you. You led her down the path to the dark side. She committed an unforgivable act, and for this the Council banished her."»
- Ch5 · L1073 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Revan: «"It was a desperate act during a desperate time," Revan said. "And the mass-shadow generator was an experimental prototype. How could the Council be sure Meetra even knew what would happen? What if it was all a mistake? A terrible accident?"»
- Ch5 · L1075 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution): «"The mass-shadow generator was a weapon of war," Atris replied with a cool, rational calm. "Its sole purpose was death and destruction, and she gave the order to activate it. How is that an accident?"»
- Ch5 · L1077 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Revan: «"But she obviously regretted her actions, and she surrendered voluntarily to the Council. Why wouldn't they show her mercy?"»
- Ch5 · L1079 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (action beat): «"They needed to make an example of her." Atris made no effort to hide the bitterness in her voice. "She became a symbol for all those who had defied the will of the Council. Mercy was not an option."»
- Ch5 · L1081 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Revan: «"It can't be that simple," Revan pressed. "My crimes were far worse, yet the Council gave me a second chance."»
- Ch5 · L1083 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (alternation): «"You could still be of use to us."»
- Ch5 · L1085 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Revan: «Revan sensed there was something she wasn't saying. "What does that mean? Meetra was a powerful Jedi. Why didn't the Council try to redeem her?"»
- Ch5 · L1091 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Atris bit her lower lip and glared at him. Then, perhaps realizing that answering his questions was the quickest way to get him to leave, she began to speak.»
- Ch5 · L1097 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution): «"Really?" Atris replied angrily. "Then why did you and Malak leave her behind when you went into the Unknown Regions? You realized she was of no further use to you, and you abandoned her. That's why she came back to the Order to face judgment."»
- Ch5 · L1111 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution): «"Haven't you done enough already?" Atris demanded. "It's your fault she defied the Council and betrayed the Order. It's your fault she fell to the dark side and was branded the Exile. It's your fault she cut herself off from the Force. For a Jedi, that's a fate worse than death!"»
- Ch5 · L1115 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (action beat): «Atris snorted in contempt. "That is the difference between us. I live for the Force. You live for yourself."»
- Ch5 · L1119 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution): «"I haven't spoken to her since her trial," Atris answered through gritted teeth, and Revan knew she was telling the truth. "I do not know where she went, and I hope I never see her again. The Exile betrayed the Order, as did you.»
- Ch5 · L1121 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (continued speech): «"You're not welcome here. Go back home to your wife." Atris spoke the last word with such venom, she nearly choked on it.»
- Ch5 · L1127 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «With Atris gone, he could let his sarcastic mask slip.»
- Ch5 · L1127 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «He'd refused to give Atris the satisfaction of seeing his guilt and grief, but now that he was alone, the emotions came flooding to the surface.»
- Ch6 · L1235 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE: «"I hope your restored confidence will serve you well on your next mission," she said. "The files Sechel recovered from UDM proved quite fruitful. He traced the payment for the custom droid sent to assassinate me back to a group of radical human separatists from Bosthirda dedicated to freeing their world from the tyranny of the Emperor and the Dark Council."»
- Ch6 · L1245 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «Humans could rise to the highest ranks of the Imperial military; a number of worlds were even ruled by wealthy and powerful human families; and the Emperor had appointed many humans to serve on the Dark Council. Of the twelve current members, five were human, including Darth Xedrix—the Councilor with the longest active service.»
- Ch6 · L1251 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Nyriss: «"The Emperor is too well protected," Nyriss said. "Since they cannot get to him, one of the longest-serving members of the Dark Council is the next best thing.»
- Ch6 · L1257 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Nyriss: «Killing one of the Dark Council on Dromund Kaas—the Imperial capital—makes more of a statement.»
- Ch6 · L1257 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Nyriss: «Ever since I joined the Dark Council there has been animosity between us.»
- Ch6 · L1259 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «Nyriss wasn't telling Scourge anything new. It was common knowledge that members of the Dark Council typically viewed one another as dangerous rivals, and there were always rumors of shadowy feuds being fought behind the scenes. Scourge believed the Emperor actually encouraged the infighting, since it dissuaded the various members from uniting their resources against him.»
- Ch6 · L1267 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «Her logic was sound, but the reasons hardly mattered. The separatists had tried to kill a member of the Dark Council. There had to be retribution.»
- Ch7 · L1317 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE: «"If you're worried I'll go running to the Council with your secret, don't be."»
- Ch7 · L1349 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «The wounds of the Mandalorian Wars were still fresh in the minds of the Jedi and the Republic. The looming specter of a Mandalorian army unified by a single war-like leader would not be ignored. Even if the Jedi Council refused to take action again, the Senate would send its fleets to crush the potential threat before it could begin.»
- Ch7 · L1363 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Revan: «"I'm not going to say anything about this to the Senate or the Council," Revan assured his friend. "But whoever finds the Mandalore's Mask will shape the destiny of your people for the next thousand years. I think it might be a good idea for us to be there when that happens."»
- Ch7 · L1369 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Revan: «"Not everyone," Revan countered. "Juhani and Jolee are Jedi; they still answer to the Council. They might feel obligated to say something about this."»
- Ch7 · L1399 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Canderous Ordo / Mandalore the Preserver: «"I heard she and the Council had a falling-out."»
- Ch7 · L1407 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE: «"She may have had a falling-out with the Council, but she's still a Jedi," he lied, doing his best to ignore the twinge of guilt he felt for his role in her ultimate fate.»
- Ch7 · L1473 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Bastila Shan: «"Haven't you done enough already?" Bastila asked, her voice rising slightly. "You saved the Republic from the Mandalorians. You saved the Republic from Malak. And in return, you had your identity destroyed and were ostracized by the Council."»
- Ch8 · L1677 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «Darth Xedrix was the longest-serving member of the Dark Council, having joined a full decade before Nyriss. He had risen to the penultimate position in the Empire, and while Scourge could understand his desire to eliminate Nyriss or other potential rivals, it was hard to imagine that he would be bold enough to challenge the immortal, all-powerful Emperor.»
- Ch8 · L1681 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Nyriss: «He knows those of us currently on the Dark Council would oppose him in his bid for power.»
- Ch8 · L1681 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Nyriss: «He thinks he will be able to manipulate them and seize control of the entire Council, so that they will follow him when he finally moves against the Emperor."»
- Ch8 · L1717 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE: «It was obvious whom she was referring to, but Scourge was still reluctant. "Asking me to kill a member of the Dark Council is not as simple as you make it sound."»
- Ch8 · L1743 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE: «"Strong enough to kill a member of the Dark Council?"»
- Ch8 · L1751 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «He wanted to test himself against a member of the Dark Council; he wanted to prove to himself and to Nyriss that he was worthy of this task.»
- Ch8 · L1753 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «It was unlikely he would be chosen to replace Xedrix on the Dark Council.»
- Ch8 · L1753 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «And when another vacancy opened on the Council down the road—in five years, or maybe ten—he would be the leading candidate.»
- Ch10 · L2039 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «Yet Scourge could sense the Councilor's enormous power. Darth Xedrix was still a member of the Dark Council, and underestimating him would be a fatal mistake.»
- Ch10 · L2081 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Xedrix: «Xedrix laughed. "Are you really that stupid, Scourge? Has Nyriss actually convinced you that you have the strength to stand against a member of the Dark Council? Has she promised you riches and power if you defeat me?"»
- Ch12 · L2607 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «Unlike Darth Xedrix, she was a Sith Council member in the prime of her powers.»
- Ch12 · L2625 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Nyriss: «"No," Nyriss admitted. "He is no fool. He is arrogant. He is powerful. And he is mad." She looked directly at Scourge. "Some of us on the Dark Council learned of his plan. To save the Empire—to save our entire species—we formed an alliance, vowing to work together to bring the Emperor down."»
- Ch12 · L2637 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Nyriss: «"If the Emperor suspected the members of the Dark Council of allying against him, he would kill us all. We had to take steps to protect ourselves. To throw off suspicion, we had to distance ourselves from the separatists who openly oppose the Emperor."»
- Ch12 · L2647 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Nyriss: «Allowing Xedrix to take the blame will confirm the Emperor's suspicion that the separatists were working with someone on the Dark Council.»
- Ch12 · L2671 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE: «"Even with all the evidence pointing in your direction, it's possible the Emperor would still believe you over a member of the Dark Council, but honestly, he would probably kill us both just to be safe.»
- Ch15 · L3215 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Darth Nyriss: «"At thirteen he presented himself to Marka Ragnos, the Lord of all Sith and the ruler of the Sith Council. His position as ruler of Nathema officially recognized, Lord Vitiate returned to his home to conduct his research into the depths of the dark side's power.»
- Ch17 · L3635 · POV Bastila · SPEECH BY Meetra Surik (the Exile): «"I left HK under the supervision of the new Jedi Council. I didn't think it was safe to have him roaming the galaxy, and I assumed he would be content to stay with the Jedi, awaiting further orders. But he disappeared soon after I left. Now I realize he's probably gone in search of Revan again."»
- Ch17 · L3699 · POV Bastila · SPEECH BY Bastila Shan: «"I led that strike team," Bastila reminded her. "I don't know why, but I took it when Revan fell. Perhaps even then I sensed our fates were intertwined. I never told anyone. Not the Council. Not even him."»
- Ch19 · L3977 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE: «"She tells me we must be patient, but her energies and resources are focused on besting her rivals on the Dark Council."»
- Ch19 · L3985 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «Scourge nodded, remembering how Nyriss had done the same thing to eliminate Darth Xedrix. At the time he had believed her when she said it was for the good of the cause, but now he suspected it had just been an excuse to remove a rival from the Dark Council.»
- Ch19 · L3997 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Revan: «"You need to find another ally to your cause," Revan said. "Someone powerful, but who is not caught up in the politics of the Dark Council."»
- Ch21 · L4589 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «Nyriss would never move against the Emperor; he knew that now. He had come to accept that neither she nor any of the other Dark Council members who had plotted with her would ever actually dare to strike.»
- Ch22 · L4759 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE: «"The ones implicating Nyriss and the other Dark Council members. I want everything you've gathered that could be used to expose them as traitors."»

- Ch22 · L4869 · POV Meetra · SPEECH BY Meetra Surik (the Exile): «"She's on the Dark Council," Meetra said, recalling the name from the data disks. "She's the one who brought you into the conspiracy."»
- Ch23 · L4899 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «He'd briefly considered approaching one of the other members of the Dark Council, hoping to convince him or her to help him get rid of Nyriss the same way she had used him to eliminate Darth Xedrix. - Ch23 · L4915 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE: «"Only those on the Dark Council can speak with the Emperor," the second soldier told him, her tone curt and official.»
- Ch23 · L5037 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE: «"They show that Darth Xedrix was not the only member of the Dark Council to betray you. He was merely sacrificed to keep the involvement of the others secret. Darth Nyriss was also involved in the plot, along with several others."»
- Ch23 · L5067 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE: «"You are bold to speak to me in this way," he stated. "And because you are right, I will reward your initiative—this time. When Nyriss falls, you will be first in line for her seat on the Dark Council."»
- Ch23 · L5087 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Captain Yarri: «"You took a great risk," Yarri said, though it was hard to tell if she thought him admirable or foolish. "But if your information is good, it sounds like you'll be on the Dark Council the next time we meet."»
- Ch24 · L5165 · POV Meetra · SPEECH BY Meetra Surik (the Exile): «"I would have expected someone on the Dark Council to put up better resistance," Meetra said as they turned a corner and raced down another hall.»
- Ch24 · L5413 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE: «"Gaze upon me and see your doom!" she declared. "I am Darth Nyriss, Lord of the Sith. I am the conqueror of Drezzi, the destroyer of Melldia, and a member of the Dark Council!"»
- Ch25 · L5573 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Meetra Surik (the Exile): «"The files you showed me listed five current members of the Dark Council plotting against him," Meetra said, looking to clarify. "Are you saying the Emperor's Guard wiped out all five in the space of a single day?"»
- Ch25 · L5575 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Lord Scourge: «"I said he killed them all," Scourge replied. "All twelve members of the Dark Council—even those who weren't part of the conspiracy. He wanted to send a message no one would ever forget."»
- Ch25 · L5589 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Revan: «"He's quarantined the entire planet," Revan said. "He wants to get everything here back under control before any other worlds hear that he slaughtered the entire Dark Council."»
- Ch25 · L5641 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Lord Scourge: «Scourge answered on Revan's behalf. "The Emperor had to keep his plans secret because he knew the Dark Council would oppose him. - Ch25 · L5643 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Revan: «"He can also use this to rally the will of the people," Revan added. "He can claim the Dark Council was working with agents of the Republic, and that is why he destroyed them. He will claim the Sith Empire has been rediscovered by its old enemy. He will convince his subjects that the only hope of survival is to strike first."»
- Ch27 · L5805 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «As much as things had changed, however, he still felt the old stirrings of glory as they set off—a faint echo from the impetuousness of youth that had caused him to defy the Council and lead his fellow Jedi into war so many years before.»
- Ch27 · L5839 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «From the reaction of the soldiers it was clear they recognized the name. No doubt every member of the Emperor's Guard was aware by now that Scourge had been the catalyst for the Emperor's sudden purging of the entire Dark Council.»
- Ch28 · L6099 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE: «"Twice I have stopped those who sought to defeat you," he said, extinguishing his blade and bowing before the Emperor. "I trust you will remember this when you select the members of the new Dark Council."»
- Ch29 · L6119 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «In the wake of Revan's defeat, the Emperor hadn't made him a member of the Dark Council after all. Instead, he had created a new position for Scourge: the Emperor's Wrath.»
- Ch29 · L6123 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «That wasn't the full extent of his reward, however. - Ch29 · L6143 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «The Dark Council would have to be rebuilt. ### Q · Darth Malak (57 entries: 6 own lines, 51 about/mentions)

- Prologue · L107 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Bastila Shan: «"They owe you," Bastila insisted. "If it weren't for you, Darth Malak would have destroyed the Republic, eliminated the Council, and all but wiped out the Jedi. They owe you everything!"»
- Prologue · L109 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Revan didn't answer right away. What she said was true—he had stopped Darth Malak and destroyed the Star Forge. But it wasn't that simple. - Prologue · L111 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Revan and Malak had both sought to destroy the Republic. But Malak had betrayed his Master, and Revan had been captured by the Jedi Council, barely alive, his body and mind shattered. - Prologue · L117 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE: «"Don't talk like that. They can't blame you for what happened. Not anymore. You're not the same man you were. The Revan I know is a hero. A champion of the light. You redeemed me after Malak turned me to the dark side."»

- Prologue · L151 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «He and Malak had found something. He couldn't remember what it was, or where it was, but he feared it on a deep, primal level. - Ch13 · L2827 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «But where was here, exactly? Why was there a secret underground chamber built into the Spear, and how had he and Malak found it in the first place?»
- Ch13 · L2835 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «He had an overwhelming sense of d?j? vu; he knew with certainty he and Malak had explored the dark chamber beneath the ice just as he and Canderous were exploring it now.»
- Ch13 · L2861 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Revan: «Revan shrugged. "I just know. Malak and I came here looking for this crypt. Someone must have told us about it."»
- Ch13 · L2891 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «There were no remains to be seen. The enemies of the anonymous Sith Lord in the tomb must have found him after all, stealing his mummified corpse for some dark and twisted purpose. The missing body didn't come as a surprise to Revan, and he suddenly remembered that he and Malak had also found the sarcophagus empty.»
- Ch13 · L2897 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (attribution): «"So Mandalore was telling the truth," Malak said.»
- Ch13 · L2901 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (alternation): «"Now what?"»
- Ch13 · L2905 · POV Revan · OWN LINE (alternation): «"What about the Mandalorians?"»
- Ch14 · L3035 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Revan: «"It's a chronicle of the Sith Lord who was buried here," Revan said. "I think Malak and I found it hidden in the tomb the last time we were here."»
- Ch14 · L3079 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Revan was speaking slowly, the words coming out only as fast as the details came into focus. His recollections were still hazy and jumbled. The original time and place of each specific memory was unclear. Mandalore had told him some of this. Other details had come from the datacron in the tomb. Most of it he had learned much later, after he and Malak had journeyed into the Unknown Regions themselves.»
- Ch14 · L3099 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Revan: «"The hyperspace coordinates are on the datacron. I think Malak and I went there to try to learn more."»
- Ch14 · L3115 · POV Revan · SPEECH BY Revan: «"But Malak and I were Jedi. It would take more than some persuasive words and a subtle push from the Force to turn us to the dark side. Something else happened to us out there. We found something that changed us."»
- Ch15 · L3313 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «He knew with absolute certainty that he had been to this world before. He remembered its deserted city and its lifeless surface. He remembered searching the empty buildings with Malak, looking for archives, records, and astrogation charts that would guide them on the next step of the journey. But most of all, he remembered the horror of a dead planet entirely stripped of the Force.»
- Ch16 · L3379 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE: «"Our existence is still hidden," she assured him. "Revan and another Jedi—a man named Malak—discovered Dromund Kaas by accident. They were captured before they could return and report their findings to the Republic."»
- Ch16 · L3433 · POV Revan · DIALOGUE: «"What happened to your partner?" he asked. "Malak?"»
- Ch17 · L3509 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «After Malak had been defeated, Bastila, like most other citizens of the Republic, had hoped to enjoy many decades of peace. Instead, a group of rogue Jedi had broken away from the Order, plunging the galaxy once more into civil war.»
- Ch17 · L3511 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «Led by a woman named Kreia, the rogue Jedi turned to the dark side teachings uncovered by Malak and Revan.»
- Ch17 · L3611 · POV Bastila · NARRATION: «Meetra shifted uncomfortably in her seat, and Bastila knew she was thinking back to her role in the massacre of Malachor V. She felt a sudden burst of empathy for the other woman. Bastila didn't condone what she had done, but she understood what it was like to be ashamed of acts in your past. She herself had let Malak turn her to the dark side; only the power of Revan's love had redeemed her.»
- Ch19 · L3939 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Over the course of many months, Revan fed that ambition with tiny crumbs meant to draw the Sith Lord in. He spoke of his past, knowing his triumphs over Malak and other powerful individuals would feed the young Sith's desire to rise above his current station.»
- Ch19 · L3983 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Revan: «"I was betrayed by Malak," Revan reminded him. "Nyriss is afraid the same thing could happen to her. If she steps forward as leader, she can no longer hide in the shadows with the others. She will be exposed, and it would only take one ambitious rival to betray her to the Emperor and bring everything crashing down."»
- Ch25 · L5597 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Revan: «"Malak and I learned the Sith still survived.»
- Ch25 · L5597 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Revan: «When Malak and I learned of his preparations, we tried to stop him.»
- Ch25 · L5603 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Revan: «"But though we had underestimated the Emperor's power, he underestimated us, as well. Our wills were stronger than he thought; our minds twisted and perverted his instructions until we thought we were acting of our own accord. Malak and I were turned to the dark side, but in doing so we found the strength to block out all memory of the Sith and the Emperor, partially freeing us from his control."»
- Ch25 · L5605 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Meetra Surik (the Exile): «"But you still called yourself Sith," Meetra said, puzzled. "You still attacked the Republic and brought it to the verge of collapse before the Jedi captured you. And even after you stopped Malak, the Republic was still as vulnerable as it's ever been. Why didn't the Emperor just invade then?"»
- Ch26 · L5767 · POV Scourge · SPEECH BY Revan: «"That is a possibility," Revan admitted. "But even if we fail to defeat the Emperor, there is still hope. My return will give him pause. He will wonder how I threw off the chains of his will. He will wonder why I have returned, and how much the Republic now knows of his plan. He will even wonder about Malak. For all the Emperor knows, Malak is still out there, plotting to take the Emperor down if I fail."»
- Ch27 · L5849 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Revan was impressed by Scourge's performance, not to mention relieved. On his last visit to Dromund Kaas, he and Malak had learned everything they could about the Imperial Guard. Though not attuned to the Force in the classical sense, the elite soldiers had a connection with the Emperor, allowing them to draw strength from the dark side. They were formidable opponents, even for a Jedi.»
- Ch27 · L5853 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «They were led down a twisting maze of corridors, a long and winding journey that Revan remembered from his last visit to the citadel. He and Malak had followed the same route, led by a Guard they had bribed for access, completely unaware that they were being led into a trap.»
- Ch27 · L5855 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «It was possible the same thing was being done to them this time, as well, but Revan didn't think that was the case. The guard who had betrayed him and Malak had met with them numerous times before leading them into the citadel, no doubt reporting back to the Emperor after each visit. This time, however, events had moved too quickly and too spontaneously for the Emperor's patient hand to be behind them.»
- Ch27 · L5883 · POV Revan · NARRATION: «Revan was standing with his back to the captain, but he didn't need to see her face to recognize the name: Yarri—the Guard who had led him and Malak into the Emperor's trap.»

### Q · Sechel (253 entries: 63 own lines, 190 about/mentions)

- Ch1 · L187 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE: «"Lord Scourge," a figure called out over the wind, running up to greet him. "I am Sechel. Welcome to Dromund Kaas."»
- Ch1 · L191 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «Sechel's hood was pulled up against the rain, covering his features, but during his approach Scourge had noticed the red skin and dangling cheek tendrils that marked him as a pureblood Sith, just like Lord Scourge himself.»
- Ch1 · L201 · POV Scourge · DIALOGUE: «Sechel quickly scrambled to his feet. "Darth Nyriss sends her apologies for not coming to meet you personally," he said quickly. "There have been several attempts on her life recently, and she only leaves her palace under the rarest of circumstances."»
- Ch1 · L205 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution): «"Y-yes, my lord," Sechel stammered. "Of course. That's why you're here. Excuse my stupidity."»
- Ch1 · L207 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «A crash of thunder nearly drowned out Sechel's apology, heralding an increase in the storm's intensity. The driving rain started to come down in stinging sheets.»
- Ch1 · L215 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «While some in the crowd cast sharp glances at Sechel as he tried to force a path through, the throng quickly parted upon catching sight of the towering figure behind him.»
- Ch1 · L229 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «As the rest of the crowd parted, the mercenaries remained in place, staring defiantly at Scourge as he approached. The Sith Lord bristled at the continued lack of respect. Sechel must have felt it as well, because he quickly rushed ahead to confront the pair.»
- Ch1 · L231 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «But Sechel was speaking frantically, gesturing and waving his arms while the humans stared at him with cold contempt.»
- Ch1 · L231 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «Satisfied, Sechel turned and waited for Scourge to arrive.»
- Ch1 · L237 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution): «"If that is your wish, my lord," Sechel said. "However, I must remind you that Darth Nyriss is expecting you."»
- Ch1 · L239 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «Scourge decided to let the matter drop. They climbed into the waiting speeder; Sechel at the controls. Scourge settled into the luxurious seat, pleased to note that the vehicle had a roof—many of the hovercabs were open to the elements. The engines engaged, and they rose to a height of ten meters before the speeder accelerated, leaving the spaceport behind.»
- Ch1 · L251 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «They passed by the Emperor's citadel and made their way to the western edge of the city. After several more minutes, Scourge felt the speeder begin to slow as Sechel brought it in for a landing.»
- Ch1 · L253 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution): «"We're here, my lord," Sechel said as the vehicle touched down.»
- Ch1 · L261 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «Sechel scrambled out of the vehicle and raced around to open the exit hatch on the other side for his passenger. Scourge stepped out of the speeder and into the rain, which had lessened only slightly during their journey.»
- Ch1 · L263 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution): «"This way, my lord," Sechel said, heading down the path.»
- Ch1 · L265 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «Scourge followed him, fully expecting the doors to swing wide at their approach. To his surprise, the entrance remained sealed. Sechel didn't seem taken aback, however. Instead, he turned to the small holoscreen on the side and pressed the call button.»
- Ch1 · L269 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution): «"Our guest has arrived, Murtog," Sechel explained, nodding in Scourge's direction.»
- Ch1 · L273 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution): «"W-what are you talking about?" Sechel stammered.»
- Ch1 · L277 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «The questions seemed to catch Sechel completely off guard.»
- Ch1 · L283 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (action beat): «Sechel glanced back over his shoulder at Lord Scourge, his expression a mix of humiliation and fear. Then he leaned in close to the holocomm and, in a low voice, said, "This is completely inappropriate. You've overstepped your authority!"»
- Ch1 · L287 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «Scourge stepped forward, grabbing Sechel by the shoulder and yanking him aside.»
- Ch1 · L293 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «The holoscreen clicked off abruptly. Scourge turned around to find Sechel cowering against the wall.»
- Ch1 · L301 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «Scourge raised his hand toward Sechel and reached out to the Force. The servant began to gasp and clutch at his throat as his body was lifted slowly up into the air by an invisible hand.»
- Ch1 · L305 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «Sechel tried to speak but could only cough and sputter. Instead he nodded frantically. Satisfied, Scourge released his hold. Abruptly Sechel dropped the full meter to the ground, where he landed in a heap, grunting in pain before scrambling to his knees.»
- Ch1 · L315 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «He drew his lightsaber and glanced up at the sky. At his feet, Sechel cried out and covered his face, assuming the lightsaber was meant for him. Scourge ignored him.»
- Ch1 · L365 · POV Scourge · OWN LINE (attribution): «Before Scourge could say anything, Sechel exclaimed, "About time you got here."»
- Ch2 · L385 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «Murtog set a quick pace, giving Scourge little time to study the works. However, Sechel—trailing a few steps behind—provided a running commentary on significant pieces as they marched past.»
- Ch2 · L393 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «Realizing he wasn't going to gain any real insight from Sechel's descriptions, Scourge tuned him out. The material treasures were a symbol of her own worth; a reminder to any visitors that she was a being of rank and power.»
- Ch2 · L405 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «Sechel had similar self-preserving motives.»
- Ch2 · L405 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «Sechel had managed to find himself a niche in Sith society by clinging to his role as an adviser to Nyriss.»
- Ch2 · L407 · POV Scourge · NARRATION: «Scourge had witnessed Sechel speaking to the mercenaries at the spaceport earlier.»
